335482.description: Rabbi Shear Yashuv Cohen, Chief Rabbi of Haifa, Israel, visits the Rebbe: The Priestly blessings you perform every day in Israel, are for the benefit of all Jews throughout the entire world.

335483.title: The Mitteler Rebbe’s Kapelye
335483.description: This Niggun was sung by the choir of the Mitteler Rebbe, Rabbi Dovber of Lubavitch.

335485.title: Steadfast
335485.description: Anticipating his brother’s hostility, Jacob sent Esau a message of peace. Jacob’s message, however, began not with words of conciliation, but with the declaration, “I lived with Laban for 22 years, yet I scrupulously fulfilled all 613 Mitzvos.”

335486.title: Chossonim and Kallos – Collage
335486.description: The Rebbe gives blessings and distributes dollars to many brides and grooms. “A Chosson is a king, so you have the ability now to bless the entire world.”

335487.title: A Child’s True Role Models – His Parents
335487.description: When your children see you following G-d, they will emulate you. A mother has even greater influence in educating children than a father.
path: A Child’s True Role Models – His Parents

335488.title: Daled Bavos
335488.description: A deep meditative Niggun attributed to the Alter Rebbe. It is sung only on special occasions.

335490.title: True Charity
335490.description:
The Talmud explains that the verse, “He redeemed my soul in peace from battles against me, because of the many who were with me,” refers to, “One who works in Torah and charity…”
A business owner isn’t satisfied with the clientele who find him; he publicizes his goods and services. His work also has no end; it is constantly on his mind. To work in Torah and charity means going beyond the realm of ‘obligation’ – developing self-motivation for personal growth, and exerting relentless effort to improve the spiritual and physical welfare of others.

335491.title: Sharing the Talmud
335491.description: Pledge cards are distributed to divide the study of Talmud for the next year. The Rebbe pledges to study a Tractate of Talmud and then returns the pen to Rabbi Efraim Eliezer Yalles, Av Beis Din of Philadelphia.

335492.title: Tanya – A Guide for Living
335492.description: You are a professor who has authored a book on Tanya. Therefore, you must be a living example that Tanya can and must be applied in our daily lives.

335493.title: Vaani Evtach Boch
335493.description: “But I will trust in You.” The Alter Rebbe was reciting this Psalm when he was informed of his release from prison on 19 Kislev, 5559. (Psalms 55:24)

335495.title: A Brilliant Victory
335495.description: Chanukah celebrates the Jews’ battle for G‑d’s Torah to prevail. But the mitzvah which they established to immortalize their triumph—the kindling of the Chanukah menorah—sheds light on the true nature of “Jewish victory.”

335496.title: Chanukah Rally
335496.description: The Rebbe joins in a Chanukah rally at 770 for public school children.

335497.title: The Chanukah Lights Illuminate the Darkness
335497.description: As long as Moshiach has not yet come, you must help increase the number of public Chanukah Menorahs and illuminate the world.
path: The Chanukah Lights Illuminate the Darkness

335498.title: Haneirot Hallalu
335498.description: The words of this Niggun recount the miracles of G-d, which are evoked by the Chanukah lights. It is sung each night of Chanukah, after lighting the Menorah.

343052.title: A Home Full of Holy Books
343052.description: As our Sages teach, a beautiful home is important. But what brings out the true beauty of one’s home are the beautiful Mitzvos and holy books found within.
path: A Home Full of Holy Books

343053.title: Hey Teves
343053.description: On the anniversary of Lubavitch’s court victory, for the return of the books of the Agudas Chasidei Chabad Library, the Rebbe distributes an extra dollar to be used for Jewish-book-related expenses.

343054.title: Spreading the Wellsprings
343054.description: Publish the remaining manuscripts which you have in your possession, so that all Jews may benefit from them. Speak about Moshiach to those around you, until Moshiach himself will come and thank you.

343055.title: Didan Notzach
343055.description: “Victory is Ours” (--quoted from Midrash). This Niggun was adapted to these words to express the desire for the return of the holy books to their rightful place and refers more broadly to the "victory" of all things holy.

343057.title: Growing Out of Confinement
343057.description: In Egypt, Joseph named his firstborn son, Menashe – “G-d has made me forget...” Although Joseph’s struggles were now little more than distant memories, Menashe’s name served as a reminder of a difficult past. On the other hand, his second son, Ephraim – “G-d has made me fruitful...” – indicates a fresh outlook entirely focused on the positive potential to be found in his circumstance.

343058.title: Torah Reading
343058.description: At 7:05 AM, after receiving 150 visitors in private audiences through the night, the Rebbe enters the upstairs synagogue at 770 to hear the Torah reading before departing for home.

343059.title: Once Chabad, Always Chabad
343059.description: Don’t forget that you once studied in Chabad. May those experiences impact all your undertakings with spiritual and material success.

343060.title: Kemofet Hayiti
343060.description: “I am a wonder to many; but You are my strong refuge.” (Psalms 71:7) The Chassidim sing a Niggun composed for the Rebbe’s seventieth birthday.

343062.title: The Divine Orchard
343062.description: “Bosi L’Gani – I have come to My garden.” G-d created this world to be a glorious Divine orchard for His presence. Man is charged with planting and tending this orchard by creating a “fruit-bearing tree” out of his own portion of the world.

343063.title: The Children’s Pan
343063.description: At a Chanukah children’s rally in 770, the children present their petitions for blessing to the Rebbe.

343064.title: Utilize Your Influence
343064.description: Through your newspapers, you have the ability to influence the public opinion. May you utilize this influence in the proper manner with joy and gladness of heart.

343065.title: Uforatzta
343065.description: “And you shall spread out westward and eastward and northward and southward.” (Genesis 28:14) This lively Niggun was composed to honor the Rebbe’s campaign to spread Torah Judaism to all four corners of the globe.

343067.title: A Rebbe’s Priority – Helping Jews Return
343067.description: There are two spiritual paths for the Jewish soul: the Torah scholar, who is completely engrossed in, and surrounded, by Judaism, or the supporter of Torah, “the businessman,” who is in constant contact with the influences of the world.
path: A Rebbe’s Priority – Helping Jews Return

343068.title: Yud Shevat Farbrengen
343068.description: In honor of the Rebbe’s 30th anniversary of leadership, Rabbi J.B. Soloveitchik joins in the Yud Shevat Farbrengen.

343069.title: Chabad: Applied Intellect
343069.description: Chassidism must affect one’s heart and emotions, but first it must enter through the brain – through intellect. This is the meaning of the acrostic of ‘Chabad’: understanding and learning – in action.

343070.title: Aimosai Kaasi Mar
343070.description:
“When will the Master come?” This question was asked of Moshiach by the Baal Shem Tov, founder of Chassidism, during a visit to his chamber On High.
“When your Wellsprings (of Chassidism) will spread to the outside,” was Moshiach’s response.

353774.title: Torah’s Mandate: Defend Yourselves!
353774.description: “The Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps” – at all times Jews are protected by G-d. But we are commanded to also take part in our own security.

353775.title: Charitable Cause
353775.description: The Rebbe introduces Rabbi Chaim Yehuda Paldi to speak about his work for Halachic conversion in Israel.

353776.title: A Strong Prime Minister
353776.description: The Prime Minister must not be satisfied with his strong position for Israel’s security until now. He must be even stronger and not be afraid that it makes the opposition uncomfortable.

353777.title: Utzu Eitza
353777.description: “Do not fear sudden terror, nor the destruction of the wicked when it comes. Contrive a scheme, but it will be foiled; conspire a plot, but it will not materialize, for G-d is with us.” From the daily prayers

354607.title: Atomic Goodness
354607.description: It has recently been discovered how the most minute quantity of matter, an atom, can unleash the most immense power in nature. Although it can be used for destructive purposes, atomic energy can be harnessed for the good. By simply pressing a button, one can achieve immediate positive transformation across the globe.

354608.title: 10 Shevat, 5752
354608.description: On the 42nd Yahrzeit of his father-in-law, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch, the Rebbe spends many hours at the Ohel.

354609.title: An Oasis of Torah for the World
354609.description: Eilat is a coastal city, so you have the mission to export the Torah of Israel to every other place in the world.
path: An Oasis of Torah for the World

354610.title: Nyet Nyet
354610.description: A song in Russian: “G-d is One, His name is One, besides Him there is no one.”

355453.title: The Jewish Woman – Part 1
355453.description: Torah and Mitzvos are the foundations of every Jewish household. The three most fundamental Mitzvos of Jewish family life – Family Purity, Kosher food preparation, and Shabbos and Festival candles, were given especially to the Jewish woman, as it is she who is the solid pillar of the home.

355454.title: Funeral of Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka
355454.description: Funeral of the Rebbe’s wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, of righteous memory.

355455.title: Moshiach Must Comfort Us
355455.description: After all that has befallen the Jewish people in recent history, we cannot begin to rationalize G-d’s reasons behind these tragedies. Moshiach must come immediately and answer all our questions.

355456.title: Atem Shalom
355456.description: A traditional song of the Bukharian Jews. The stanzas are lead by Rabbi Refoel Chudidaitov, a ninety-nine year old Bukharian Jew, and all join in to sing the chorus: “Peace to you, peace to your home, peace to all of yours.”

355458.title: The Jewish Woman – Part 2
355458.description: Jewish women are entrusted by G-d to ensure the continuity of the Jewish people. Despite the pains and hardships involved in pregnancy, labor, birth and child rearing, they have always fulfilled this essential role with joy and a deep sense of mission.

355459.title: The Annual Jewish Women’s Convention
355459.description: The Rebbe addresses the annual Jewish Women’s Convention, and distributes dollars to representatives of the organization, to be given to charity.

355460.title: Chassidic Feminism
355460.description: Among Chassidim there are “equal rights” for women, and in some things they are expected to do even more than the men!

355461.title: V’Ata Amarta
355461.description: God’s promise to Jacob: “I will do good to you, and I will make your offspring as the sand of the sea which is too numerous to count.” (Genesis 32:13)

363039.title: The Jewish Woman – Part 3
363039.description:
Torah establishes that a child’s People is traced through the mother – who carries and nourishes the growing baby, and who devotedly struggles through the pains of pregnancy, labor and childbirth.
There are those who wish to steal the child from its mother, by “voting” that a child can belong to the father’s People instead. All women should object to such a possibility.

363040.title: Charity Box
363040.description: On Shabbos, Erev Rosh Chodesh, the Rebbe announced a new campaign for every Jewish child to have a charity box in their bedroom. The next day, the Rebbe gives out nickels to the children to put into their new charity boxes.

363041.title: Serving G-d through Song – Collage
363041.description: A number of Jewish singers and an orchestra conductor receive the Rebbe’s blessings.

363467.title: “America Is No Different”
363467.description: In 1940, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, was miraculously saved from the Nazis and brought to the safe shores of America. Upon his arrival he declared: “America is not different;” he would continue all the activities to strengthen Judaism which he began overseas.

363468.title: The Previous Rebbe’s Arrival to America
363468.description: The Previous Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch, arrives in America after his miraculous rescue from Nazi-occupied Poland.
path: The Previous Rebbe’s Arrival to America

363469.title: From Russia to America to Redemption
363469.description: To exchange Russia for America is to exchange one exile for another. The Jewish immigrants from Russia should exchange all exile for Redemption.
path: From Russia to America to Redemption

363470.title: Zol Shoin Zein Di Geulah
363470.description: “May the Redemption take place; Moshiach must come already!” A lively Chassidic Niggun.

363472.title: What Can King Achashverosh Teach You?
363472.description: Why does the Megillah describe the extravagance of Achashveirosh’s feast in such great detail, which is irrelevant to the miracles or themes of Purim?
path: What Can King Achashverosh Teach You?

363473.title: Visit by President Zalman Shazar
363473.description: Israeli President Zalman Shazar visits the Rebbe on Taanis Esther, and stays for the Megillah reading in 770.

363474.title: Queen Esther – A Proud Jewish Woman
363474.description: The Hadassah Women’s Organization carries the name of Queen Esther. She is an example of a truly proud Jewish woman – who is not afraid to show her Jewish pride, and who lives her everyday life in the same way.
path: Queen Esther – A Proud Jewish Woman

363475.title: Napoleon’s March
363475.description: This march was played by the armies of Napoleon. When the Alter Rebbe, who opposed Napoleon, heard the tune, he transformed the tyrant’s anthem into a tool for spiritual victory, by designating it a Chassidic Niggun.

363477.title: Torah Business Lessons
363477.description: Maimonides rules that the single action of a single person has the power to redeem the entire world. It is analogous to a balance sheet in business. If the profit column has even a single unit more than the debt column, that outweighs everything on both sides of the balance.

363478.title: Groundbreaking for Campus Chomesh
363478.description: A month after the passing of the Rebbe’s wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka of righteous memory, a new Beis Rivkah Girls’ School, named “Campus Chomesh,” begins to rise in her memory. On his way to visit her resting place, the Rebbe stops at the groundbreaking and participates in the dedication.

363479.title: Friends of Chabad Help Even More
363479.description: Blessings for all the members of the Jewish Federation. If you are happy with your Shliach, you will certainly help him in all ways possible.
path: Friends of Chabad Help Even More

363480.title: Nye Zhuritzi Chloptzi
363480.description: Sung by Chassidim as they traveled to the town of Lubavitch to visit the Mittler Rebbe, the words allude to their hopeful yearnings: When they reach the Rebbe, they will drink from “the well of Torah and Chassidism,” and lack nothing.

372580.title: Ten Mitzvah Campaigns
372580.description: It is the responsibility of every Jew to bring others close to Torah and Mitzvos. The Ten Mitzvah Campaigns form the basis for this effort. But they all begin with the Mitzvah of Ahavas Yisroel – to love one’s fellow Jew. When we reach out to others with love, then both we and those we reach are deeply inspired to strengthen the observance of all Mitzvos.

372581.title: Dollars to Tankists
372581.description: At the conclusion of a weekday Farbrengen, the Rebbe distributes packets of dollars to the “Tankists” – Chassidim who run the Mitzvah Tanks, to give out to the rest of those present.

372582.title: Ten Mikvahs – As a Start!
372582.description: Your uncle built many, many Mikvahs, but since he has passed on, no one has taken his place. Here are ten dollars for the first ten Mikvahs you will build.

372583.title: Uforatzta
372583.description:
From G-d’s blessing to Jacob, “And you shall spread forth to the west, to the east, to the north and to the south.”
These words became a slogan for the Rebbe’s call to reach every Jew, wherever he may be.

372585.title: 70 Years, 71 New Institutions
372585.description:
I have been asked: “Now that you’ve reached 70 years isn’t it time to slow down and enjoy some rest?
The number of one’s years is irrelevant; the real question is: were those years utilized to the fullest? Every honest person knows he could have accomplished more in his youth, so now is the time to work with greater strength to double one’s achievements.

372586.title: Sunday Dollars
372586.description: Every Sunday, beginning in 1986, thousands of people would come to see the Rebbe, seeking his blessings and advice. The Rebbe gave each person a dollar bill to be given to charity.

372587.title: Every Person, A Tzaddik
372587.description:
The publisher of Lifestyles magazine asks for a message for the world, in honor of the Rebbe’s 90th birthday:
“The number 90 in Hebrew is “Tzaddik.” Every person, both Jew and non-Jew, must become a true Tzaddik, a righteous person.

372588.title: V’somachto
372588.description: “And you shall rejoice in your Festival… and you will be only happy.” (Deuteronomy 16:14, 15)

372590.title: Lessons From the Exodus
372590.description:
Two essential lessons from the Exodus for every Jew:
Pharaoh, the mightiest king in the world, ruthlessly oppressed the Jewish People. Yet his behavior completely reversed, and, instead of afflicting the Jews, “Pharaoh sent the people away...”.
Then the Torah relates: “G-d did not lead the Jews through the Land of the Philistines… lest they see war, reconsider, and return to Egypt.” G-d does not command us to follow a path in which we cannot succeed. “G-d prepares the steps of man” – when G-d leads a person to a certain place, and, through the teachings of the Torah, gives him a mission to accomplish, this, itself, proves that he has all the capabilities he needs to succeed.

372591.title: The Rebbe’s Matzos
372591.description: The Rebbe distributes Matzah before Passover, at his home on President Street.

372592.title: This Year in Jerusalem
372592.description: Our Seder eve wish, “Next year in Jerusalem,” doesn’t mean that we wish to wait a year before Moshiach comes. Rather, we anticipate the Redemption today, and then certainly by “next year” we will be “in Jerusalem!”

372593.title: Al Achas
372593.description:
In the Haggadah, after listing the many miracles and gifts G-d gave the Jewish People after their exodus from Egypt, we recite:
“How much more so should we be grateful to the Omnipresent One for the doubled and redoubled goodness that He bestowed upon us, for He has brought us out of Egypt.”

372595.title: Hashem’s Presence, through Love
372595.description:
Even after a week of consecration for the Holy Tabernacle, the Jews still did not merit for G-d Himself to consecrate the Tabernacle. Only when Aaron brought his sacrifice on the eighth day, did G-d finally manifest His awesome Glory.
The sages teach: “Be a student of Aaron: love peace, pursue peace, love all creatures, and bring them close to Torah.” These virtues of Aaron accomplished more than all the Seven Days of Consecration.

372596.title: Motzaei Acharon Shel Pesach
372596.description: At the conclusion of Passover, 1967, the Rebbe distributes Kos Shel Brachah, “Wine of Blessing,” late into the night.

372597.title: I Remember You
372597.description: A few years ago I received a letter from you. As chaplain, may G-d bless you to be successful with all the soldiers under your guidance.

372598.title: We Want Moshiach Now
372598.description: “Jewish nation have no fear, Moshiach will be here this year. We want Moshiach now, we don’t want to wait!” Chassidim sing a song introduced by children, and beloved by the Rebbe.

377116.title: Jewish Time Management
377116.description: From Passover through Shavuos, we count the days of the Omer, reminding ourselves to utilize every possible moment to prepare for receiving G-d’s Torah anew. This Mitzvah teaches us to count and value every day of our lives.

377117.title: Kos Shel Brachah
377117.description: The Rebbe distributes wine from his Kos Shel Brachah, Cup of Blessing, at the conclusion of Passover.

377118.title: Halachic Banking
377118.description: Consult a Rabbi to inquire about the Halachic specifications to operate a bank on Shabbos and Festivals. May you have much Jewish livelihood.

377119.title: Lechatchila Ariber
377119.description: This Chassidic Niggun is attributed to the Rebbe Maharash. Its tune and its name represent his famous adage on dealing with challenges: "The world says, 'If you can't crawl under an obstacle, try to climb over,' but I say, 'At the outset, climb over!

377121.title: Two Jews, One Soul
377121.description: Every Jew, regardless of his background or situation, is “truly a part of G-d above,” for “we all share one Father.” But differences of opinion and outward appearances may sometimes obscure this unity. Therefore, we are commanded to “love your fellow” specifically, “as yourself,” bringing this unity to the fore.

377122.title: Lag B’omer Parade
377122.description: The Rebbe participates in an early Lag B’omer Parade.

377123.title: Teach Every Jew to Love Their Fellow
377123.description: Lelover Chassidim were well-known for their exceptional love for fellow Jews. You must teach all Jews, non-observant and observant alike, to have great love for one-another.
path: Teach Every Jew to Love Their Fellow

377126.title: The Jewish Woman: Pillar of Her Home
377126.description: G-d instructed Moses to begin preparing the Jews for life in Israel, by teaching them the Laws of Shmitah – that the Land should observe “a Shabbos for G-d.” But the first Shmitah would only be observed in the seventh year of their settlement; shouldn’t they first learn the laws necessary upon their arrival?
path: The Jewish Woman: Pillar of Her Home

377127.title: Visit by Israel’s Chief Rabbis
377127.description: The Rebbe receives the Chief Rabbis of Israel, Rabbi Mordechai Eliyahu and Rabbi Avraham Shapira.

377128.title: Educating Oneself
377128.description: Those in the Ministry of Education should continue to increase their own education, as well. One may have missed something in his youth, but, as Pesach Sheni teaches us, “It is never too late.”

377129.title: Wake Up Yidden
377129.description: Upon the Rebbe’s request, campers from Camp Gan Israel begin a camp song. “Wake up, Yidden, from the dream of Golus, get ready to greet our Righteous Moshiach. Redemption is coming swiftly towards us; ‘Behold he is standing right outside our door.’”

377131.title: Profession of the Jewish Child
377131.description: Lag B’omer celebrates the Yahrzeit of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai, and is a time to draw inspiration from his life’s work. Rabbi Shimon’s Torah study was so great that it was his “occupation,” a level unattained even by his greatest peers. But how, then, is a young child to attempt to emulate him?

377132.title: Last but not Least
377132.description: At the conclusion of the Lag B’omer Parade in 1987, the Rebbe extends a thank-you to the guests of honor: “The boys and the girls, children of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and Sarah, Rebecca, Rachel and Leah.”

377133.title: To Awaken Every Jew
377133.description: To succeed in benefiting the community, a leader relies on others to help implement the plan. A Rebbe doesn’t make demands, his role is to awaken every Jew to his essential bond with G-d, Torah and the Jewish People.

377134.title: Hinei Mah Tov
377134.description: “How good and how pleasant it is when brothers dwell together.” (Psalms 133:1)

387869.title: Man as Creator
387869.description: Why didn’t G-d create us to enjoy gifts given to us freely?

387870.title: Walking to 770
387870.description: The Rebbe walks along Eastern Parkway to 770.

387871.title: From One Thousand to Two Thousand
387871.description: Our sages state that “He who has one hundred, wants two hundred.” This desire continues to grow in proportion to one’s achievements. Now that you have one thousand students, you must strive for two thousand.
path: From One Thousand to Two Thousand

387872.title: Hoshia Es Amecha
387872.description: “Deliver Your people and bless your heritage; tend them and exalt them forever.” (Psalms 28:9).

387874.title: A Voice with No Echo
387874.description: At the Giving of the Torah, G-d’s voice was heard throughout all of creation proclaiming, “I am the L-rd your G-d Who took you out of Egypt.” Is this really G-d’s greatest accomplishment? Why didn’t He say, “I have created heaven and earth?”

387875.title: Torah Reading
387875.description: The Rebbe is called to the Torah.

387876.title: The Jewish Land
387876.description: The name of your newspaper, Haaretz, refers to the land of the Jewish People. See to it that they add Yisrael to the name of the newspaper, and ensure that it be a Land about which can be reported: This is the land of the Jewish people who received the Torah on Shavuos.

387877.title: Ubyom Simchaschem
387877.description: “You shall sound the trumpets over your burnt-offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings.” From the Musaf prayer of Rosh Hashanah.

387879.title: Wealth – A G-dly Vote of Confidence
387879.description: Rabbi Yehudah Hanassi honored wealthy people. It was not their money which impressed him, but G-d’s confidence in them; G-d entrusts the finances of the Jewish People and of the entire world to those He is positive can use them in the best interest of the community.
path: Wealth – A G-dly Vote of Confidence

387880.title: Havdalah
387880.description: The Rebbe recites Havdalah at the conclusion of Shavuos.

387881.title: New Torah, New Strength
387881.description: All Jews just received the Torah anew on Shavuos. This means that every Jew receives new powers and abilites to achieve even more than in the past.

387882.title: Sheyiboneh
387882.description: “May it be Your will, L-rd our G-d and G-d of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in your Torah.” From the daily prayers.

387884.title: Following G-d’s Lead
387884.description: After camping at the foot of Mount Sinai, studying their newly received Torah, the Jewish People suddenly saw G-d’s Clouds of Glory lift, signaling that it was now His command that they journey toward the Land of Israel.

387885.title: Rabbonim from Israel
387885.description: The Rebbe distributes L’chaim to Rabbis visiting from Israel.

387886.title: Spreading Judaism in Hungary
387886.description: Don’t be afraid of the current conditions in Hungary. The government and economy there are now very conducive to spreading Yiddishkeit.

387887.title: Ana Avda
387887.description: “I am the servant of the Holy One, blessed be He, before Whom, and before Whose glorious Torah, I bow at all times.” From the prayers preceding the Torah reading.

394453.title: The Jew’s Natural Habitat
394453.description: G-d promises every Jew: “You shall be for Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.” This is not only a request, but also an assurance that no Jew will ever be lost. No matter how far a Jew may wander, his true place remains with G-d, Torah and the Jewish People. Simply by doing a Mitzvah, a Jew comes home.

394454.title: Kuntres Chof-Ches Sivan
394454.description: The Rebbe gives out a booklet on the 50th anniversary of his and the Rebbetzin’s safe arrival from war-torn Europe, to the shores of America.

394455.title: Hesder Yeshiva: A Great Responsibility
394455.description: Hesder Yeshivos need it to be known that their students are scholars. When you are tested, it should be obvious that you were in Yeshiva.

394456.title: Tune of Zol Shoin Zein Di Geulah
path: Tune of Zol Shoin Zein Di Geulah

394458.title: A Living Legacy
394458.description: The Jewish People are “a wise and understanding people.” Nevertheless, each year, Jews from all walks of life gather to commemorate the Rebbe’s passing. Clearly, then, we are not celebrating the past, but rather, something very real, in the present.

394459.title: Erev Rosh Hashanah
394459.description: On Erev Rosh Hashanah, the Rebbe visits the Ohel, resting place of his father-in-law and predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn of Lubavitch.

394460.title: Maintaining the Teacher’s Good Name
394460.description: You will certainly show an example that I have been successful in teaching, because my pupils, my followers, are doing even more than their teacher asked of them.

394461.title: Tzomo L’cha Nafshi
394461.description:
“My soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You; (as one) in a desolate and dry land without water, so (I thirst) to see You in the Sanctuary, to behold Your might and glory.” (Psalms 63:2, 3)
This song was first taught by the Rebbe on 28 Nissan, 5714 – 1954.

394463.title: Imprisonment and Liberation
394463.description: The Previous Rebbe worked tirelessly to strengthen all areas of Jewish observance under communist oppression. Still, the primary charge for which he was imprisoned and exiled, was for his underground network of education for Jewish children. Clearly, then, the Rebbe’s liberation, as well, was mainly a victory for Jewish education.

394464.title: Visit by the President of Israel
394464.description: A visit to the Rebbe by the President of Israel, Zalman Shazar.
path: Visit by the President of Israel

394465.title: Tammuz – A Month of Deliverance
394465.description: Tammuz, the month of deliverance of my father-in-law, the Rebbe, is an auspicious time to achieve greater success for G-d’s plan.

394466.title: Nyet Nyet
394466.description: A song in Russian: “G-d is One, His name is One, besides Him there is no one.”

394468.title: America’s Mandate: Energy Independence – Part 1
394468.description: “Evil will come from the north.” The Soviet Union is a clear manifestation of this prophecy. At the same time, G-d bestowed the United States with the mission and the moral and material might to counter this evil. To succeed, however, America must be free of economic pressure from immoral dictatorships. If we rely on them for oil, this nation’s strength and influence is compromised.

394469.title: Incentive to make a Farbrengen
394469.description: “We will distribute Mashke to whoever takes upon himself to use it at a Farbrengen and mention the 12th and 13th of Tammuz.”

394470.title: Israel – The Safest Investment
394470.description: Israel is one of the surest places on the globe. To invest money in Israel, that is the surest bank that exists in our time.

394471.title: Ki Elokim
394471.description: “G-d will redeem Zion and build the cities of Judah, and they will dwell there and possess it. The descendants of His servants will inherit it and those who love His name will establish themselves there.” (Psalms 69:36, 37)

408957.title: America’s Mandate: Energy Independence – Part 2
408957.description:
There is a solution to America’s energy crisis: Solar Energy. Solar technology requires far less time to develop than other energy sources.
What can a small group of Jews accomplish by discussing this issue amongst themselves? Maimonides rules that even a single statement based on Torah, has the power to tip the scales for salvation. Past experiences have shown that issues discussed here, have reached Washington.

408958.title: Sheyiboneh
408958.description: “May it be Your will, L-rd our G-d and G-d of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in your Torah.” From the daily prayers.

408959.title: Israel and the U.S.: Friendship through Strength
408959.description: The only approach which has succeeded so far is when Israel makes clear to the United States through its actions, that it will not compromise on security issues, and that the US needs a strong partner in the Middle East.
path: Israel and the U.S.: Friendship through Strength

408960.title: “A Rabbi that Gives”
408960.description: Dr. Luis Alberto Lacalle, former president of Uruguay, describes his meeting with the Rebbe at Sunday dollars, shortly before his election.

408962.title: A Torah of Peace
408962.description: The exile was caused by a lack of love and unity amongst Jews. The Evil Inclination tries to convince a person that quarreling can achieve some good. But Maimonides states that Torah was given, “only to bring peace to the world” – “Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.” Division cannot lead to peace between man.

408963.title: Visit by Israel’s Prime Minister
408963.description: Israeli Prime Minister, Menachem Begin, visits the Rebbe.

408964.title: The Rebbe’s Smile
408964.description: Your painting shows me laughing! May G-d bless you with happiness and healthy, long years.

408965.title: “A Rabbi for Life”
408965.description: Rabbi Hollander, a well-known rabbinic activist and past president of the Rabbinical Council of America, informs the Rebbe of his plans for retirement.

408967.title: The Tefillin Campaign
408967.description:
Some ask: “What benefit results from the Tefillin campaign? You put Tefillin on a Jew only one time, and you have no idea if it has any lasting effect on him?”
Every Mitzvah forges an eternal bond between a Jew and his Creator. In addition, the Talmud teaches that a Jew who dons Tefillin even once, becomes worthy of his share in the World to Come; his entire eternal future, depends on it.

408968.title: Magineinu
408968.description: See our shield, O G-d, and look upon the face of Your anointed one. (Psalm 84:10) Chassidim sing a Niggun composed in honor of the Rebbe’s 83rd birthday.

408969.title: A Gift from the Rebbe
408969.description: Buy him a pair of Tefillin as a gift in my name, and be sure to send me the bill.

408970.title: “The Typewriter”
408970.description: Rabbi Yosef Goldstein relates a story from his days working in the Rebbe’s office in the 1940s.

408972.title: Reaching Bar and Bat Mitzvah
408972.description:
May G-d grant success to all the Bar and Bat Mitzvahs. On one’s birthday, one is born anew; may it be with new Mazel in Torah, Mitzvos and all areas of your lives. 
Every Bar and Bat Mitzvah resolves to constantly grow especially in the commandment to “Love your fellow as yourself.” This inspires them to gather other Jews together and draw them closer to Judaism.

408973.title: At the Torah
408973.description: Bar Mitzvah boys are called up to the Torah in 770. The Rebbe is called up to the Torah.

408974.title: Bar and Bat Mitzvah Blessings
408974.description: The Rebbe gives personal guidance to Bar Mitzvah boys and Bat Mitzvah girls.

408975.title: “Cookies and Milk”
408975.description: Robert Steingut shares a heartwarming childhood account, of what it was like to be the Rebbe’s neighbor.

412662.title: The Tzaddik’s Eternal Influence
412662.description: My father gave his life helping to preserve Judaism in communist Russia; thus his Yahrzeit has great significance for all Jews – especially when we see the fruits of his self-sacrifice continuing to bear fruit today, with countless Jews from the Soviet Union observing Torah and Mitzvos.

412663.title: Afternoon Prayers
412663.description: The Rebbe leads the Afternoon Prayers on the Yahrzeit of his father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson, of righteous memory. Children visiting from Camp Gan Israel join the Rebbe’s Minyan.

412664.title: Partners in Bringing Moshiach
412664.description: I am ready for Moshiach, but I need your help. May you have success in building up the Yeshiva and Chabad House, but do it now; Moshiach may come tomorrow or the day after.

412665.title: “He Created Leaders”
412665.description: Chief Rabbi of Great Britain and the Commonwealth, Dr. Jonathan Sacks highlights some unique aspects of the Rebbe’s leadership.

412667.title: The King in the Field
412667.description: The Alter Rebbe teaches that during the month of Elul, G-d is like a “King in the field” – He goes out from his lofty palace to find each and every Jew, wherever they may be. He greets them with a smiling countenance and eagerly hears their requests.

412668.title: Children’s Rally
412668.description: Children sing a Niggun for the months of Elul and Tishrei: “May you be inscribed and sealed for a good year.”

412669.title: Bringing Jews Closer through Love
412669.description: Chabad Chassidim have always been working with Russian Jewry. Even under communism they drew Russian Jews close to Torah with love. Now that Jews are free to leave Russia, many have gone to Israel instead of other countries because they were encouraged by Chabad Chassidim.

412670.title: “It’s Good to Pray with the Child” – 1950
412670.description: Rabbi Chaskel Besser tells a story illustrating the Rebbe’s gentle attention to children.
path: “It’s Good to Pray with the Child” – 1950

412672.title: Return
412672.description: Our Sages extol the virtue of “Teshuva and good deeds.” But why do they praise the path of repentance before the path of purity? Shouldn’t repentance for misdeeds be enumerated after we speak of doing good deeds?

412673.title: Machne Israel Development Fund
412673.description: The Rebbe addresses a meeting of the Machne Israel Development Fund. The Rebbe distributes Lekach for the new year, and addresses the Shluchim.

412674.title: To ‘Wonderful’ there is No Limit
412674.description: May your son be a source of pride for the Jewish People as a US Senator in Washington. If he has been a wonderful son until now, he can surely become even more wonderful in the future.

412675.title: “On the Way to Washington”
412675.description: US Senator Joseph Lieberman tells of his first experience at 770 and of his last stop on the way to Washington to take his oath for the Senate.

412677.title: Discovering Your Inner Jewish Child
412677.description: “And all your children shall be disciples of G-d.” G-d blesses children with a unique nature for their journey on the path of G-dly discovery. Thus, there is much that adults can learn from them, in their own service of G-d.

412678.title: A Lively Song
412678.description: Chassidim sing a lively Chassidic Niggun.

412679.title: Mezuzah Protection
412679.description: It is customary to check the Mezuzahs from time to time, but especially if there is some problem. The Mezuzah brings G-d’s protection upon all the members of the household, even when they are outside the home.

412680.title: “In Record Time”
412680.description: Rabbi Yisroel Gordon shares an amusing story, driving the Rebbe back to Crown Heights from the Ohel.

424354.title: A New Soul, A New World
424354.description:
The 18th of Elul is the birthday of two “great luminaries,” the Baal Shem Tov and the Alter Rebbe.
From the moment of birth, a person’s mission begins. He becomes an active force in the lives of others, and day by day his ability to interact with the world increases. Those blessed with exceptional spiritual capacities immediately radiate holiness around them; they are destined to elevate the world to remarkable divine heights.
path: A New Soul, A New World

424355.title: A Farbrengen
424355.description: A Farbrengen on the birthday of the two “Great Luminaries” of the Chassidic Movement: the Baal Sham Tov and the Alter Rebbe.

424356.title: There’s a Great Thirst
424356.description: I am happy that your book, This is My G-d has been translated into Hebrew. Jews brought up in Israel have a great thirst to know more about Judaism.

424357.title: “Look Up A Professor in Your Field”
424357.description: Professor Herman Branover, a renowned scientist in the field of Magnetohydrodynamics, left the Soviet Union in 1972. A year later, he received an extraordinary, and perplexing, instruction from the Rebbe.
path: “Look Up A Professor in Your Field”

424359.title: A Load of Precious Gems
424359.description: G-d depends on each and every individual to carry out Torah’s mandate. To be entrusted with this mission by G-d Himself, should fill a person with the greatest sense of worth and joy. But what if this responsibility makes him feel more overwhelmed than overjoyed?

424360.title: Yahrtzeit Prayers
424360.description: The Rebbe leads the Morning Prayers on the Yahrzeit of his mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson.

424361.title: Sweet Cake for a Sweet Year
424361.description: May you have a healthy and sweet year, and may your eating this sweet cake bring sweetness to the entire school.
path: Sweet Cake for a Sweet Year

424362.title: "Deep Down, A Spark"
424362.description: Rabbi Zalman Posner was a young yeshivah student when the Rebbe arrived in the United States in 1941. He describes an event early in the Rebbe’s presence on these shores, which was truly characteristic of the Rebbe.

424364.title: A Three-Part Vow
424364.description: Tanya begins with a passage from the Talmud: “An oath is administered to the soul before it is born into the world: Be righteous and be not wicked.” The root of the Hebrew word for “oath” connotes not only G-d’s entreaty to the soul; it reveals that through this oath, G-d fills the soul with brimming capacity to accomplish its mission below.

424365.title: Birchas Habonim
424365.description: Just before Kol Nidrei, the Yeshiva students pack the upstairs synagogue in 770, to receive the Rebbe’s blessing.

424366.title: Good Changes in Russia
424366.description: Jewish artifacts and property were stolen and stored away by the Soviet Government. Now changes are sweeping across Russia, and this should make it easier to retrieve what has been lost.

424367.title: "It Wasn't Me, It Was Him"
424367.description: Mr. Robert Abrams served as New York State attorney general from 1978 to 1994. He and his wife, Diane, an attorney herself, would come to the Rebbe for Lekach on Hoshana Rabbah. In 1985, the Rebbe gave them an unexpected blessing for an addition to their family.

424369.title: All Refugees
424369.description: During World War I, Jews in Russia were forced to relocate, and our city was flooded with refugees. My mother headed the committees to organize aid and shelter. Her incredible devotion day-in and day-out has been etched in my memory for all my life.

424370.title: Motzaei Yom Kippur
424370.description: Havdala and Sanctification of the Moon after Yom Kippur.

424371.title: Transmit the Message
424371.description: Transmit this message to my followers: Moshiach is coming very soon, and they must be prepared to receive him properly!

424372.title: “My Son, May He Be Well”
424372.description: Rabbi Shmuel Lew discovers a Farbrengen of elder Chassidim with the Rebbe’s mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson.

433692.title: One Scroll, One People
433692.description: My father-in-law, the Rebbe, writes: Every Jewish soul is bound to a letter in Torah. Whenever a new Torah scroll is to be completed, the announcement of the upcoming celebration reawakens a Jew to this deep-rooted core of his soul.

433693.title: Hoshana Rabba
433693.description: Hallel and Hoshanos in 770, on Hoshana Rabba.

433695.title: Sukkos with the Rebbe-to-Be
433695.description: Rabbi Yitzchak Groner is a Shliach of the Rebbe in Melbourne, Australia for over 50 years. He recalls warm anecdotes of the Rebbe’s interaction with the students at 770 during the lifetime of the Previous Rebbe.

433697.title: Parting Together
433697.description: As the month of Tishrei comes to an end, our togetherness does not end. Our month spent together drawing new inspiration, is extended into every day of the year, as we bring this inspiration back with us to our families and communities.

433698.title: Until Next Time
433698.description: The Rebbe sees off the guests who traveled from afar, to be with him for the month of Tishrei.

433699.title: From Mir to Mexico
433699.description: You merited to study in renowned Yeshivos back in Europe. Now you have the great merit to bring those Torah studies “across the sea” to the Jews of Mexico.

433700.title: A Chassid Is Born
433700.description: Rabbi Moshe Feller was a non-Lubavitch Yeshiva student from Minneapolis. He speaks here of the first Farbrengen he attended in 1955. Today, he is the Head Shliach of the State of Minnesota.

433702.title: A Moment to Save the World – Part 1
433702.description: Civilized society depends on proper education built on a healthy foundation. But the only true foundation for education is the same as that of all of creation: “In the beginning, G-d created the Heavens and the Earth.”
path: A Moment to Save the World – Part 1

433703.title: Auction of Honors
433703.description: The 770 “synagogue honors” for the new year are auctioned off during the Rebbe’s Farbrengen.

433704.title: For the Soul to Find Peace
433704.description: A Rav can help you approximate the date of your brother’s passing. Observe his Yahrzeit on that date, and when his soul will be at peace, the tragedy of his death will no longer haunt you.
path: For the Soul to Find Peace

433705.title: To Be a Jew
433705.description: Former Prime Minister of Israel, Ariel Sharon describes part of his first Yechidus with the Rebbe shortly after the Six Day War.

433707.title: A Moment to Save the World – Part 2
433707.description: Parents rely on the Public School System to rear their children into mature, responsible adults. Their children are imbued with the values of this country’s sense of pride: That “My own power and the strength of my hand have brought me my success.” But with this approach unchecked, they will grow up to use their education to achieve their own selfish desires.
path: A Moment to Save the World – Part 2

433708.title: A Chassidic Nigun
433708.description: “Contrive a scheme, but it will be foiled; conspire a plot, but it will not materialize, for G-d is with us…” From the daily prayers

433709.title: My Line of Work
433709.description: In my line of work I also must get involved in the personal lives of those who turn to me. May you utilize every opportunity to spread true Judaism joyfully and happily, including also good tidings in your personal life.

433710.title: So Serene!
433710.description: After finding safety on American shores in 1941, the Rebbe helped the war effort, working at the Brooklyn Navy Yard. Mr. Milton Fechter’s desk in the electrical engineering section was not far from the Rebbe’s.

443372.title: A Moment to Save the World – Part 3
443372.description: Those who oppose silent prayer in public schools, cite the separation of religion and state as the basis to eliminate religion from the public arena. However, this ignores the reason the law was established in the first place: to protect the freedom of religious expression of the original settlers in this country. This modern-day repression of democracy goes against the intention of the authors of the Constitution.
path: A Moment to Save the World – Part 3

443373.title: Funeral Procession
443373.description: The Rebbe joins the funeral procession of Rabbi Shmaryahu Gurary of Tel Aviv, Israel, as it passes 770.

443374.title: Consistency in Education
443374.description: When children are taught secular studies five times a week, but Torah only three times a week, they pick up a subconscious message that Judaism is less important. They must be taught about G-d, Torah and Mitzvos every single day.

443375.title: City of Torah Light
443375.description: Eliyahu Schochetman is a professor of Law at Hebrew University in Jerusalem. His father, Meir, knew the Rebbe while living in Paris in the 1930s.

443377.title: The Partnership
443377.description: The tribe of Zevulun, whose business ventures took them far and wide, agreed to support Yissachar, the tranquil tribe of scholars; in turn, Yissachar shared the merit of their Torah study with Zevulun. The special relationship of these two tribes was blessed by Moses himself: “Rejoice, Zevulun in your excursions, and Yissachar, in your tents,”

443378.title: Uforatzta
443378.description:
G-d’s blessing to Jacob, “And you shall spread forth to the west, to the east, to the north and to the south.”
These words became a slogan for the Rebbe’s call to reach every Jew, wherever he or she may be.

443379.title: Good for the Jews
443379.description: May you be successful in spreading Judaism in South Africa. Despite the political changes, South Africa is still good for the Jews. Once Moshiach comes, it will be good for the Jews to go with him to the Holy Land.

443380.title: Hiskashrus
443380.description: While living in France in the 1930s, the Rebbe and Rebbetzin would often visit the Previous Rebbe in Poland. Rabbis Yitzchak Hakohen Hendel and Menachem Zev Greenglass were students in the Lubavitcher Yeshiva in Warsaw and Otwock.

443382.title: A Time to Build
443382.description: We have spoken recently that now is “a time to build,” especially in the realm of Judaism. This is the special mission of every Jew, but especially of those whom G-d has blessed with special means. Therefore, each supporter should work with their Shliach – not as a sponsor, but as a true partner – to realize the dream of owning a local Chabad House building.

443383.title: Annual Conference of Shluchim
443383.description:
Afternoon prayers in 770 on the 4th day of the Annual Conference of Shluchim. The Rebbe leads the prayers during the first year of mourning for his wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, of righteous memory.
The Rebbe addresses the assembled: “Thank you to all who expressed their blessings in conjunction with this special gathering of Shluchim. ‘May all who bless, be blessed’ with G-d’s infinite blessings, in all their needs.”

443384.title: The Community’s Success: Through You
443384.description: The Shluchim’s activities world-wide succeed only through the help and dedication of their local community members. The Shluchim’s ability to achieve great things depends on them.

443385.title: “I am a Shliach”
443385.description: Asher Heber’s family moved to Paris in the early 1930s. His father, Leibish, was a businessman who assisted the Rebbe.

443387.title: Building a Jewish Family
443387.description: May G-d bless each of you, that the preparations, the wedding, and the long, good years which will follow should all be with abundant success and Chassidic joy.

443388.title: Marriage Ceremonies
443388.description: Until 1963, the Rebbe would officiate at weddings of Chassidim. A collection of vintage films from weddings at which the Rebbe officiated./

443389.title: Wedding Blessings
443389.description: Brides and grooms receive dollars and blessings from the Rebbe in honor of their upcoming special day.

443390.title: “You’re Related to the Lubavitcher Rebbe?”
443390.description: David Bezborodko was a businessman from a non-Chassidic family, who directed his family’s glass and mirror factory in Paris.

454535.title: Chalukas Hashas
454535.description: “Every person should take upon himself to learn a tractate of Talmud – and learn it with joy! Begin learning it this Yud-Tes Kislev, and complete it by next Yud-Tes Kislev.”

454536.title: The Professor
454536.description: Professor Yisroel Hochberg presents to the Rebbe a small box which had belonged to the Alter Rebbe. The Rebbe says: “You are a professor, and that is very important! May the Alter Rebbe’s merit stand you in good stead to fulfill all the Alter Rebbe’s teachings of Jewish law, and may you raise your children as true ‘professor’s children.’”

454537.title: “He Saw My Pain”
454537.description: While on business in Japan, Mr. Ephraim Steinmetz, a businessman from Venezuala, received a mysterious package and note from the Rebbe.

454539.title: One Small Candle; One Giant Light for Mankind
454539.description: On Chanukah, Jewish children increase in spiritual light, adding an additional candle in the menorah, and inspiring their neighbors to join in illuminating the world.
path: One Small Candle; One Giant Light for Mankind

454540.title: Menorah Lighting in the Rebbe’s House
454540.description: Afternoon Prayers and Menorah lighting in the Rebbe’s house on President Street.
path: Menorah Lighting in the Rebbe’s House

454541.title: Learn from the Lights
454541.description: May you and your partners in the Chabad House building campaign truly reflect the lights of the Chanukah Menorah – increasing each day in your efforts and contributions for Judaism.

454542.title: The Rebbe and the Rav – Part 1: A Visit in New York
454542.description: Rabbi Sholom Kovalski shared a close relationship with Rabbi Joseph Ber Soloveitchik. Here, he recalls taking Rav Soloveitchik to visit the Rebbe upon the passing of the Rebbe’s mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson, of blessed memory.
path: The Rebbe and the Rav – Part 1: A Visit in New York

454544.title: Shabbos-Chanukah Light
454544.description: There is a special lesson when both the first and last days of Chanukah fall out on Shabbos. It teaches us that every aspect of a Jew’s life must be completely permeated and saturated with “the Shabbos spirit,” with extra holiness and transcendence over the mundane.

454545.title: Haneiros Hallalu
454545.description: At a Farbrengen on the last night of Chanukah, Chassidim sing Haneiros Hallalu.

454546.title: Shining from Sea to Sea
454546.description: Artist and sculptor Yaakov Agam presents the Rebbe with a small model of his newly designed public Menorah. The Rebbe says: “Thank you for designing the Menorah according to the opinion of Maimonides. You will be lighting the full-sized versions of your Menorah in Los Angeles and New York – may this be a good beginning for the entire United States and the entire world.”

454547.title: Rebbe and the Rav – Part 2: Coffee in Berlin
454547.description: Rabbi Sholom Kovalski continues his account of taking Rabbi Joseph Ber Soloveitchik to visit the Rebbe in 1964. During the drive home, Rav Soloveitchik shared some personal recollections of the Rebbe, from their time together in Berlin.
path: Rebbe and the Rav – Part 2: Coffee in Berlin

454549.title: How Do You Beat an Evil Spirit?
454549.description: A Talmudic sage was once approached by a good spirit which guarded the local river. It told the sage that an unholy spirit intended to wrest control of the river, and make trouble for the Jews who came to use it. The good spirit instructed the sage: “Gather all the local Jews. When the evil spirit approaches, I will alert you. All the assembled should then stand in its path and shout: ‘Didan Notzach – Victory is ours!’” When the Jews did this a drop of blood appeared on the face of the water, illustrating their victory over the evil spirit.
path: How Do You Beat an Evil Spirit?

454550.title: Victory in the Seforim Case
454550.description: Days of rejoicing at 770, after US Federal Court ruled that important books and manuscripts stolen from the Previous Rebbe’s Library be returned to the Chassidim. (5 Teves, 5747 • January 6, 1987; 7 Teves, 5747 • January 8, 1987; 2 Cheshvan, 5748 • November 23, 1987)

454551.title: Manuscripts – Historic but New
454551.description: The manuscripts you found written by the Rebbes of Chabad, and by my father, may have been written years and ages ago, but the teachings are absolutely fresh and new. Thousands of Jews have learned these new teachings, and this merit should bring you success in all that you do.

454552.title: “My Father Belonged to Chassidim”
454552.description: Attorney Nathan Lewin was one of Chabad’s main lawyers in the federal court case over ownership of the Previous Rebbe’s library. He tells the events which led up to the case, and the vital roles of the Rebbe and Rebbetzin in that court victory (1985 – 1987).

462827.title: Jewish Stature
462827.description: The Sages teach: “The deeds of the Patriarchs are a guide for their descendants.” A Jew can look to the lives of our forefathers, and learn how to act in his daily life.

462828.title: Dollars for “Tankisten”
462828.description: The Rebbe hands packets of dollar bills to the “Mitzvah Tankists,” to distribute to Chassidim.

462829.title: The Most Special Office
462829.description: You may not be running for any government office like the others here, but you have a very special office: To spread Judaism around you.

462830.title: “You’re a Good Salesman, Right?”
462830.description: Mayer Zeiler is the owner of Flocktex Industries in Israel, one of the world’s leading textile manufacturers.

462832.title: Bring Moshiach Now!
462832.description: The Talmud, 1,500 years ago, already stated, “All ‘end-times’ for the Redemption have passed, it now awaits only repentance.” In 1941, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, launched an intense campaign that “Immediate repentance will bring immediate Redemption.”

462833.title: We Want Moshiach Now
462833.description: Chassidim sing a lively Niggun: “We Want Moshiach Now.”

462834.title: Take Advantage Now
462834.description: Take advantage of the time now to do your holy work. When Moshiach comes we will all go to Israel, and the work in Australia will be over.

462835.title: Build, Build, Build!
462835.description: Ron Nachman is the mayor of Ariel, Israel.

462837.title: Everyone in Your Surroundings
462837.description: The true and complete Redemption depends on “bringing the entire world to recognize the sovereignty of G-d.” Every person must hasten this, and help prepare the world to serve G-d as one.

462839.title: Reach Out to the Non-Jews
462839.description: I am very occupied now with spreading the Seven Noahide Laws for all mankind. When all people will follow these laws, it will also make easier our work as Jews.

462840.title: The King and the Pawn
462840.description: Rabbi Leibel Posner was a student at 770 during the 1940s, and would attend the Rebbe’s monthly Shabbos-Mevorchim Farbrengen. An illuminating lesson in the game of life.

462842.title: Leadership
462842.description: Every person is expected to become a ‘ruler’ over his surroundings – to make it a proper dwelling place for G-d. At first, a person is ruler only over himself. Later, he becomes ‘ruler’ and leader of his family. Then he goes on to become a leader in his community and so on. At each stage he must accustom himself to place the new majority’s needs before the previous “individual’s” needs.

462843.title: Sefer Torah to Greet Moshiach
462843.description: Completion ceremony for the “Sefer Torah to Greet Moshiach,” commissioned by the Previous Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch, in 1942.

462844.title: Super-responsibility
462844.description: Visit by US Senator Rudy Boschwitz. The Rebbe blesses the Senator: “May you have a good, sweet and complete year – full of good action for the benefit of all Jewish people, all people of the United States and all people of the entire world.”

462845.title: Jewish Counterculture
462845.description: Rabbi Yosef Krupnik shares a Sixties Yechidus.

471223.title: In Answer to Your Questions…
471223.description: The Sages instruct us: “Appoint for yourself a spiritual mentor.” It is essential that every person have a personal mentor, who will provide him with sound guidance in all areas of life, beginning with the most important area of one’s life – one’s service of G-d.

471224.title: Nyet, Nyet, Nikavo…
471224.description: “Nyet, Nyet, Nikavo… – No, no, there is no one, besides our one G-d.” A Nigun in Russian sung by Chassidim under Soviet oppression.

471225.title: Love of G-d
471225.description: There are many holy books which discuss how to internalize “fear” of G-d. But the main thing is to focus on love of G-d, and the appropriate fear of G-d will come as a result.

471226.title: From Brooklyn to Jerusalem
471226.description: Rabbi Shaar Yashuv Cohen is the Chief Rabbi of Haifa, Israel. Once, in Yechidus, he asked the Rebbe why he did not move to the Holy Land.

471228.title: The Shluchos
471228.description: A strong Jewish family is the bedrock of a strong Jewish nation. As the pillar of the home, the Jewish woman is G-d’s main emissary to enhance Jewish observance and joy amongst the Jewish People.

471229.title: Kuntres Chof-Beis Shevat
471229.description: The Rebbe distributes Kuntres Chof-Beis Shevat on the 4th Yahrzeit of his wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka Schneerson, of righteous memory.

471230.title: Not an Only Child
471230.description: It is not good to be the only religious Jewish politician. You must cause there to be others.

471231.title: The Jewish Woman’s Courage – 1960s
471231.description: Rabbi Chaim Yaakov Shlomei was dean of the Bais Rivka Girl’s Seminary in France for over twenty years. He shares a special letter sent by the Rebbe to the seminary students.

471233.title: Taming the Ox
471233.description: In Talmudic law, when an ox has shown repeated signs of aggression, its legal status changes: if it subsequently damages another person’s property or person, it receives no leniency. However, through specific changes – even very minor changes in behavior – its legal status as being “tame” can be restored.

471234.title: Ki Elokim
471234.description: “G-d will redeem Zion and build the cities of Judah, and they will dwell there and possess it. The descendants of His servants will inherit it and those who love His name will establish themselves there.” (Psalms 69:36, 37)

471235.title: Crime Prevention
471235.description: Judge Jack B. Weinstein speaks to the Rebbe, together with Rabbi Lipskar of the Aleph Institute. "May you merit to see the day when there will be no need for sentencing criminals, because crime will have become abolished through preventive education. When you speak to the Federal Sentencing Commission, do not only report my views, but I hope you will adopt them and support them as your own views, as well."

471236.title: A Visit with the Rebbetzin - 1987
471236.description: Mrs. Danièle Gorlin Lassner’s parents and grandparents knew the Rebbe and Rebbetzin from Europe. On this occasion in 1987, she accompanied her parents to visit the Rebbetzin.

471238.title: The Source of Might
471238.description:
The verse states: “Out of the mouths of children and infants You, G-d, have established strength to silence the enemy and the avenger.”
When a Jew strives to grow in Torah and Mitzvos, the evil inclination approaches him in one of two ways: As an open “enemy” – clearly trying to convince him to stray from G-d’s path, or as “an avenger” – hiding his evil intentions in a veil of concern: “If you do just this one sin, it will actually make it easier for you to come closer to G-d.”

471239.title: The Previous Rebbe Accepts US Citizenship
471239.description:
US citizenship proceedings for the Previous Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch.
Vintage color film footage from 1949.
path: The Previous Rebbe Accepts US Citizenship

471240.title: Like The Baal Shem Tov
471240.description: You humbly call yourself a “teacher’s assistant” to the Shliach, but even the Baal Shem Tov started as a teacher’s assistant. May you be like the Baal Shem Tov!

471241.title: The Essence of Things
471241.description: Former Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu shares some of the personal experiences he had with the Rebbe during his tenure as Israel’s Ambassador to the United Nations.

481222.title: Free to Serve
481222.description: In modern times, G-d has blessed the Jewish People, and the majority of Jews live in countries where they are not persecuted or segregated. But with this comes a new challenge

481223.title: Hupp Cossack
481223.description: “Jump, Cossack, Jump”. Rabbi Aryeh Leib of Shpoleh, the “Shpoler Zeide” danced to this song in competition against a cossack to gain the freedom of a poor, Jewish innkeeper.

481224.title: Moshiach – It’s a Matter of Law
481224.description: A visit by Rav Yochanan Sofer, Av Beis Din of Erloy. The Rebbe says: “Issue a rabbinic ruling that the world cannot proceed without Moshiach, and the Heavenly Court will be forced to comply.”
path: Moshiach – It’s a Matter of Law

481225.title: Loans for Education
481225.description: Mr. Sam Feiglin’s father, Moshe Zalman, was a founder of the Jewish community in Australia. A glimpse into the Rebbe’s personal involvement for Australian Jewry.

481227.title: Esther, Model for Jewish Women
481227.description: Mordechai and Esther are the heroes of Purim, yet the Megillah is named only after Esther. And the initiative that the Megillah be included among the books of the Bible came specifically from Esther. Why is Esther given the spotlight, when her success depended on Mordechai’s plan?

481228.title: Purim Services
481228.description: Purim Morning with the Rebbe at 770.

481229.title: Keep in Touch
481229.description: While on Merkos Shlichus in Germany you surely got to know Jews there. Make sure to send them letters for the Jewish holidays. Today is Purim Katan, so you can already send them Purim greetings. Also send them Shmurah Matzah for Passover, at least enough for the Seders – I will cover all the expenses.

481230.title: They Will Not See Us” – A Story of the Fifth Rebbe
481230.description: Asher Heber’s father, Laibish, was present at the last Purim Farbrengen of Rabbi Sholom Dov Ber, the fifth Rebbe of Chabad, several years after the beginning of Communist rule.
path: They Will Not See Us” – A Story of the Fifth Rebbe

481233.title: The Birthday Campaign – Part 1
481233.description: My father-in-law, the Rebbe, taught that a birthday is a time for introspection – to take the purpose of one’s life to heart and make resolutions for the future. It is a most propitious time, for on one’s birthday his ‘Mazel’ – his ‘fortune,’ radiates with extra strength.

481234.title: Bcho Botchu
481234.description: “In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You saved them. They cried to You and were rescued; they trusted in You and were not shamed.” (Psalms 22:5, 6)

481235.title: A Member by Birth
481235.description: A Jew, by his very birth, is not only connected to Judaism – it is his essence. You must only reveal this by removing the dirt or sand which might cover it up. And that depends on his observant relatives.

481236.title: If a Jew is Challenged
481236.description: Rabbi Fabian Shoenfeld had a private audience with the Rebbe along with fellow members of the Rabbinical Council of America. A fascinating exploration by the Rebbe of the biblical story of Elijah on Mount Carmel.

481238.title: The Birthday Campaign – Part 2
481238.description: One should always begin to implement birthday resolutions on the birthday itself. And for best results, include your family when you make the resolutions, so they can help you and offer feedback on your progress.

481239.title: Shacharis in Rashag’s apartment
481239.description: Morning Prayers held at the apartment of Rabbi Shmaryahu Gurary in the weeks after his passing.

481240.title: Happy Birthday!
481240.description: Children receive dollars from the Rebbe to be given to charity in honor of their birthdays.

481241.title: A Nation that Dwells Alone
481241.description: Yitzchak Rabin was Prime Minister of Israel, and served as Israel’s ambassador to the United States in the early 1970s. In 1972, he was sent to convey Israel’s blessings to the Rebbe in honor of his 70th birthday.

490059.title: Education Day, U.S.A.
490059.description: As representative of the Lubavitch Movement, I was honored to receive a letter from the President of the United States, together with a Declaration to all US citizens, proclaiming the 11th of Nissan as “Education Day.”

490061.title: A Supporter and Member
490061.description: Your family has a long tradition as dedicated supporters of Lubavitch. But if you wish to bless your children, bless them to not only be “supporters” of Lubavitch, but to be “members” – personally involved, as well.

490062.title: “Only 14 years-old!?”
490062.description: Nochum Goldschmidt attended the same Cheder in Dnepropetrovsk as the Rebbe and the Rebbe’s brother, Leibel. Nochum’s cousin, Rabbi Mordechia Ashkenazi, heard these memories him.

490064.title: The Fifth Son
490064.description: The Haggadah speaks of the “Four Sons” at the Seder table, demonstrating that every Jewish child needs to be given the full experience of Passover; if need be, search him out, find him, and invite him together with his family to your Seder table, to celebrate the freedom of our People.

490065.title: Biur Chametz
490065.description: On the eve of Passover, the Rebbe burns the Chametz and recites Kol Chamira.

490066.title: Who Will Ask the Four Questions?
490066.description: May your entire family have good preparations for a wonderful Passover. All the children who are old enough should prepare the four questions for the Seder.
path: Who Will Ask the Four Questions?

490067.title: The Chief Rabbi’s Son
490067.description: Yona Kesa grew up in Dnepropetrovsk in the early 1900s. He shares his fond memory of the Rebbe and of the Rebbe’s father, Reb Levik.

490069.title: Maybe You Should Skip It?
490069.description:
In the laws of ritual purity, Maimonides’ appears to make contradictory statements:
First, he rules that one who is not eating sacrificial food, should not concern himself whether he or his food becomes impure. But in the next law, he makes a statement that seems to be at odds with this: Maintaining purity through restraint, even where it is not ritually necessary, is one of the greatest virtues.

490070.title: Kos Shel Brachah
490070.description: At the conclusion of Passover, the Rebbe distributes Kos Shel Brachah.

490071.title: Acts of Goodness and Kindness
490071.description: To a CNN reporter: “Moshiach is ready to come now, we all must only do something additional in the realm of goodness and kindness.” To a child who comes to the Rebbe by Sunday dollars: “This dollar is for bringing Moshiach. Give it to charity for Moshiach to come faster.”

490072.title: He Didn’t Change
490072.description: While living in Berlin, the Rebbe made the acquaintance of a Jewish businessman named Yitzchok Meir Ferstenberg. Rabbi Chazkel Besser of Agudas Yisrael of America later heard these recollections from Yitzchok Meir.

490074.title: The Wonder in Counting
490074.description: Immense waves of energy flood Earth twenty-four hours a day; they have done so without stop since the beginning of creation. Both the sun and moon have a constant, powerful influence on the entire earth – on every man, woman and child, and on every animal, plant and mineral – throughout the entire day.

490075.title: Funeral Procession
490075.description: The Rebbe joins the funeral procession for Reb Schneur Zalman Duchman.

490076.title: The Good Fire
490076.description:
To the Editor-in-Chief of the Russian “Ogonyok – Small Flame” magazine:
May yours be a flame that reaches higher and shines stronger, to inspire good change in a country which now shows support for the Jews who live there.

490077.title: 11 Hours of Torah
490077.description: Every year, from Berlin, the Rebbe and Rebbetzin would visit the Rebbetzin’s father, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchok, for the festive month of Tishrei. Rabbi Moshe Eliyahu Gerlitzky was a student at the Lubavitcher Yeshiva in Lodz, Poland. He was present when, upon the Previous Rebbe’s instruction, the Rebbe Farbrenged with the Chassidim for Simchas Beis Hashoevah.

498517.title: Consolation After the Sacrifice
498517.description: In Kfar Chabad, there will soon begin the Bar Mitzvah celebration for the orphans of Israel’s fallen heroes. They commemorate their sacrifice, for their fathers gave their lives defending the Holy Land and its Holy Nation.

498518.title: Hoshea Es Amecha – Prozos Teishev
498518.description: “Deliver Your people and bless Your heritage; tend them and exalt them forever.” (Psalms 28:9) “Jerusalem shall be as inhabited as vast unwalled cities.” (Zechariah 2:8)

498519.title: Stand Tall
498519.description: In Hebrew, “Israel” is an acronym for “Li Rosh – To Me, a head.” This means to say that every Jew must be a “head”, standing tall and strong in all matters of Judaism, Torah and Mitzvos. Then the Torah will be complete, the Land of Israel will be complete and the Jewish People will be complete.

498520.title: The Lubavitcher Rebbe's View on Zionism
498520.description: Rabbi Yehudah Leib Posner and his brother were students in 770 during the 1940s. One week, their father came in from Pittsburgh and spent Shabbos with them. Friday night after the prayers, their father asked the Rebbe how he should respond to the controversial topic of the day – the creation of a Jewish State.
path: The Lubavitcher Rebbe's View on Zionism

498522.title: Justice through Charity
498522.description: Torah juxtaposes the laws of the Festivals with the laws of charity to teach a lesson: Don’t think that when a Festival ends, the obligation to bring joy to the needy ends with it. Charity is a constant Mitzvah, and it must always be done with renewed enthusiasm.

498523.title: Coins for Charity
498523.description: Before the morning prayers on Chol Hamoed Sukkos, the Rebbe hands out coins to children to be given to charity.

498524.title: An Independent Mind
498524.description: The Rebbe tells Professor Paul Rosenbloom: “I had a younger brother who passed away many years ago. He left this unfinished mathematical paper. If you will supervise someone to prepare it for publication, I will be very happy to pay for it.”

498525.title: Brothers
498525.description: Rabbi Chazkel Besser of Agudas Yisrael of America, befriended the Rebbe’s brother, Leibel, while living in Tel Aviv during the 1940s.

498527.title: Parade of Good
498527.description: Torah instructs Jewish children: If you see another person who is in need, whether spiritually or physically, reach out to him with love and help him get free of his predicament. Then proceed together, growing from each other’s successes.

498528.title: Lag B’omer Parade
498528.description: The Rebbe participates in a Lag B’omer parade.

498529.title: “It’s Just My Nature”
498529.description: If you want me to have Nachas from you, that depends on you. And as much as you will do, I will ask for more. That’s just a part of my nature. The Talmud states: As soon as someone achieves a good thing, he wants to double it.

498530.title: Brothers – Part 2: The Brother in New York
498530.description: Rabbi Chazkel Besser of Agudas Yisrael of America knew the Rebbe’s brother, Leibel, in Tel Aviv. In 1948, Rabbi Besser moved to New York, and Leibel sent family pictures with him to give to his mother, Rebbetzin Chana.
path: Brothers – Part 2: The Brother in New York

498532.title: Mothers for Peace
498532.description: The Midrash explains that in Egypt the Jews were not united as a people. But with each passing day after the Exodus, they became more unified. And when they finally reached Mount Sinai, they encamped “as one person, with one heart.” It was then that G-d entrusted them with His Torah, “whose ways are all pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.”

498533.title: Noda Beyehudah
498533.description: “G-d is known in Judah, His Name is great in Israel. His Tabernacle was in Shalem, and His dwelling place in Zion. (Psalms 76:2, 3)

498534.title: To Influence All
498534.description: To influence all the Jewish People is a big task. Nevertheless, every Jew has the power to do so, because he acts with the help and blessing of G-d Almighty Himself.

498535.title: He Meant Business
498535.description: Dov Zlotnik, Professor of Rabbinic Literature at the Conservative Movement’s Jewish Theological Seminary, once delivered a sermon on the importance of Family Purity. As he was to discover, for the Rebbe, a good sermon requires a great ending…

522091.title: Seventy Years: A New Beginning
522091.description:
After achieving excellence as a Talmudic scholar, Rabbi Zeira fasted in order to forget the Babylonian Talmud before he began to study the Jerusalem Talmud. How could he have prayed to forget a portion of the Holy Torah?
The answer: Before one proceeds to an entirely new level of service, he must let go of his current frame of reference. For example: As the soul ascends the ladder of heavenly realms, it must forget the experiences of the lower realm, so the memory will not “hold it back” from fully receiving higher revelations.

522092.title: Kos Shel Brachah
522092.description: The Rebbe distributes Kos Shel Brachah, as Chassidim sing a lively Niggun.

522093.title: Inspire the Next Jew
522093.description: Now that you have rediscovered your Jewish identity, find another Jew who has forgotten what he learned in his youth, and share your inspiration with him.

522094.title: “The Little Lantern”
522094.description: Efraim Steinmetz is a businessman from Caracas, Venezuela. He and his wife came to the Rebbe with concerns about their children’s Jewish education. The Rebbe answered with a story from his own childhood.

522096.title: Who Can Be My Mentor?
522096.description:
Torah instructs: “Provide yourself with a mentor.” But how does one know who to choose as a spiritual guide?
The Talmud Tractate Berachos teaches: “A mentor must be like an angel of G-d”. In his code of Jewish law, Maimonides offers a clue to the conduct of an angel: He describes the future world, “when there will be no envy, rivalry, war or hatred,” and concludes: “At that time the righteous will resemble the Ministering Angels.” So to resemble an angel of G-d means, to be free of the corruptions of one’s body.

522097.title: Lubavitch Women’s Organization
522097.description: The Rebbe participates in the annual convention of N’shei Chabad, the Lubavitch Women’s Organization.

522098.title: A Person Must Be Occupied
522098.description: Even an “emeritus” must be occupied and use his time productively – and even to be occupied “a little bit” is not enough for a Jew.

522099.title: Reporting from 770, Part 1: Encounter at Farbrengen
522099.description: Herbert Weiner is the author of Nine and a Half Mystics. In 1955, he was sent by Commentary magazine to report on the activities going on at Lubavitch World Headquarters.
path: Reporting from 770, Part 1: Encounter at Farbrengen

522101.title: Beyond Skin Deep
522101.description:
An address to girls graduating from Jewish High Schools:
The educational goal of every Jewish school is to instill this G-dly awareness within its students, so that it permeates their lives. May your decision to dedicate this summer to educating other Jewish children in this way, be the final step in bringing the Redemption speedily.

522102.title: Nye Zhuritzi Chloptzi
522102.description: Sung by Chassidim as they traveled to the town of Lubavitch to visit the Mittler Rebbe, the words allude to their hopeful yearnings: When they reach the Rebbe, they will drink from “the well of Torah and Chassidism,” and lack nothing.

522103.title: Charity
522103.description: A number of meetings where the Rebbe urges individuals to make charity a part of their daily lives.

522104.title: Reporting from 770, Part 2: Alone with the Mystic
522104.description: Herbert Weiner is the author of Nine and a Half Mystics. In the mid-1950s, he scheduled his first private audiences with the Rebbe, intending to interview him for a series of articles.
path: Reporting from 770, Part 2: Alone with the Mystic

522106.title: Vacationing in Torah
522106.description: Summer vacation must be utilized to grow in one’s Judaism.

522107.title: Halachic Rulings Regarding Israel
522107.description: The Rebbe asks several senior Rabbis to address the Farbrengen – to issue Halachic rulings that the Land of Israel belongs to the Jewish People.

522108.title: Individual, but Universal, Guidance
