522108.description: The most important guidance is stated clearly in G-d Almighty’s Torah: “If you will follow My statutes, if you will go in the way of My Mitzvos, then I will bless you in all your needs.”

522109.title: It’s 4:00 AM. Do You Know Where the Rebbe Is?
522109.description: The Rebbe and Rebbetzin arrived to America on the 28th of Sivan – June 23, 1941. Rabbi Mottel Sharfstein was a student in 770 during the 1940s. He recalls the first time he heard from his teacher about the Rebbe.
path: It’s 4:00 AM. Do You Know Where the Rebbe Is?

531038.title: A Rebbe Does Not Depart
531038.description: Today is the anniversary of the passing of my revered father-in-law, the sixth Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn, on 10 Shevat, 5710 (1950). It is an appropriate time to view this 40-year period in a larger perspective.

531039.title: Gimmel Tammuz
531039.description: A collection of beautiful footage from over the years of the Rebbe’s leadership. Selections from an address about a Jewish leader’s eternal presence and influence in the life of every Jew.

531040.title: Only an Emissary
531040.description: Thank you for supporting the Shluchim in your area. The “thanks” is actually from G-d Himself – I too, am merely an emissary relaying His message that every Jew must help one another, and fulfill his duty to the world, by increasing in Judaism, righteousness and justice.

531041.title: Handing the Match
531041.description: Yehuda Avner served on the personal staff of five Israeli Prime Ministers. In 1977, after meeting with President Carter at Camp David, Menachem Begin sent him to report to the Rebbe.

531043.title: The Meaning of Freedom - Part 1
531043.description: The Stalinist regime that imprisoned my father-in-law, the Rebbe, in 1927, was then a superpower. Despite that, he defied his oppressors. He did not budge an inch in anything that jeopardized his principles. Even at the train station, about to be exiled, he declared publicly: “Only our bodies, not our souls, were sent into exile.” And indeed, his defiance led to his release.

531044.title: Nyet Nyet Nikavo
531044.description: A song in Russian: “G-d is One, His name is One, besides Him there is no one.”

531045.title: Only One to Fear
531045.description: A blessing for all the children of your school, who sing “Nyet Nyet Nikavo”. This song should give you added strength in learning Torah and fulfilling Mitzvos.

531046.title: Caring for Soviet Jewry
531046.description: At the time that the Soviet Union began to open its doors, Shoshana Cardin served as Chairman of NCSJ, the National Conference on Soviet Jewry.

531048.title: The Meaning of Freedom – Part 2
531048.description: When my father-in-law, the Rebbe, was freed in Leningrad, he stated: “It was not myself alone that G-d redeemed, but every Jew, even those who are Jews in name only.”

531049.title: General Yechidus
531049.description: An audience with overseas visitors, Bar Mitzvah boys and Bat Mitzvah girls, and grooms and brides.

531050.title: Charity in the Knesset
531050.description: Install a charity box near your seat in the Knesset. May G-d perform charity with the Jewish People, and may we merit, together with Moshiach, the true Knesset – as in the days of our Sages of old.

531051.title: Camp Memories
531051.description: Meir Lieberman was a camper in Gan Israel, New York in the summer of 1960. He had never heard of the Rebbe before, but apparently, the Rebbe knew of him.

531054.title: Daily Study of Maimonides
531054.description: The daily study of Maimonides’ works is becoming increasingly widespread. The Mishneh Torah, his Magnum Opus that codifies Jewish Law, serves to guide all Jews through the intricacies of Jewish observance. It is not geared for scholars alone. It guides “small and great alike,” as they pursue their life tasks.

531055.title: Campers Visit the Rebbe
531055.description: Campers from Gan Israel, New York visit the Rebbe in honor of the Yahrzeit of his father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson.

531056.title: A Full Heart
531056.description: Torah says, “Love G-d with all your heart.” When you go in for your heart test, they will find only good things, and a heart filled with love of G-d. Give one dollar to charity when you go in for the exam, and give the other to charity when you leave. May you always give charity in good health.

531057.title: Scientific Analysis
531057.description: Professor Herman Branover is a renowned physicist, who received not only spiritual guidance from the Rebbe, but scientific guidance, as well.

541721.title: Learning Never Ends – Part 1
541721.description: Students benefit from the guidance and supervision of their educators for only a limited number of hours a day. The environments in which children spend much of their after-school hours, whether at home or on the street, exerts a strong influence that is often in conflict with the values they absorb at school. School administrations often overlook this fact.

541722.title: Sheyibaneh
541722.description: Cantor Moshe Teleshevsky leads the singing of Sheyibaneh.

541723.title: 3-Dimensional Security
541723.description: May G-d bless you to ensure the security of Jews – and their spiritual security, as well.

541724.title: Astronomically Impossible
541724.description: Rabbi Yosef Goldstein, an educator and author of the children’s audio-cassette series, Story Time with Uncle Yossi.

541726.title: Learning Never Ends – Part 2
541726.description: In his or her free hours after school, a child should not be left to fend for himself against the untoward influences that often surround him. Even well-intentioned individuals who are concerned about education sometimes wait until a teenager finds himself in trouble, and then their concern focuses on how to cope with yet another young “threat to society.”

541727.title: Tisha B’av Morning
541727.description: The Rebbe’s Minyan at 770 on Tisha B’av morning.

541728.title: More Candles, More Light
541728.description: The Shluchim need people to offer their personal time and help, besides their financial assistance. Women and girls also play a tremendous role in the Mitzvah campaigns, especially in encouraging all Jewish women and girls to light Shabbos and Festival candles.

541729.title: Three Millimeters Off
541729.description: Rabbi Dov Levanoni is the author of The Temple in Jerusalem, and an expert on the Holy Temple. His book is based on the scaled model of the Second Temple which he built, and for which he received “a little help” from the Rebbe.

541731.title: A Living Will
541731.description: When someone passes on, the bond they share with their loved ones below is not severed. Family and friends alive in this world can continue to bring the soul joy and happiness.

541732.title: Reb Levik’s Niggun
541732.description: Chassidim sing “Reb Levik’s Niggun”, a favorite tune of the Rebbe’s father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson.

541733.title: The King will be Happy
541733.description: I give each of you a second dollar for the King of Morocco. It will be a good idea to build another Chabad House in Morocco, and certainly the King will be happy about it.

541734.title: Children, Be Strong!
541734.description: In 1939, the Rebbe’s father was exiled by the Soviet government to a remote region of Kazakhstan. At the end of his sentence, he and his wife traveled to the closest large city, Almaty, Kazakhstan. Leibel Raskin and his family were there to greet and assist them upon their arrival.

541736.title: Policekid
541736.description: An address to children: We are commanded to appoint judges and policemen in all our cities. A judge of Torah law teaches people how to live their lives happily and productively. The policeman's task is to maintain law and order and to keep bad influences away.

541737.title: L’chaim for New Institutions
541737.description: The Rebbe distributes L’chaim in honor of recently opened institutions.

541738.title: Beyond Prosecution – Protection
541738.description: May G-d Almighty bless you to protect all the people of New York, and especially in your district of Brooklyn – but by protecting them! I am not so interested in prosecuting people, as much protecting as many people as possible.

541739.title: Sephardic Recordings
541739.description: Mr. Joseph Cayre is a business leader and a prominent member of the Sephardic community.

548432.title: Six Hundred Thousand Times Four, Equals One
548432.description: Assembled here together, in a tangible demonstration of unity, is a diverse range of people: businessmen from every walk of life, and scholars who specialize in various realms of Torah study.
path: Six Hundred Thousand Times Four, Equals One

548433.title: Krias Hatorah
548433.description: The Rebbe is called to the Torah. Overseas guests recite Hagomel.

548434.title: The Closest Time, the Dearest Place
548434.description: Despite events in the Middle East, the days leading into Elul should not be categorized as “difficult days.” To the contrary – at this time of year, G-d is even closer to every single Jew, and especially to the Jews in the Land of Israel.
path: The Closest Time, the Dearest Place

548435.title: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn
548435.description: Dr. David Luchins served on the staff of US Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan for twenty years. In 1983, he attended a retirement party for Congresswoman Shirley Chisholm of Crown Heights, where she revealed the identity of a most important mentor.

548437.title: The Call of the Shofar
548437.description: The Talmud teaches that on Rosh Hashanah G-d asks His people to sound the shofar in order to make Him their King, and to “remind” Him of their meritorious past.

548438.title: K’siva V’chasima Tova
548438.description: At a children’s rally in the weeks leading up to Rosh Hashanah, children sing a joyous Niggun: “May you be written and inscribed for a good and sweet year”.

548439.title: Shatnez and Redemption
548439.description: Blessings in your work to ensure that garments in Israel are Shatnez-free. But may we soon merit to use Shatnez properly in the third Holy Temple. A double portion of blessing for everything in the Land of Israel.

548440.title: A Mission in Australia – Part 1: Torah is Not Overseas
548440.description: Thirteen year-old Shmuel Gurewicz arrived with his family to Australia in 1949. He was among the first students of the Tomchei Temimim Yeshiva in Shepparton, Australia. But he had “bigger” plans…
path: A Mission in Australia – Part 1: Torah is Not Overseas

548443.title: Serving with Distinction
548443.description: Soldiers spend most of their time training and carrying out missions. Periodically, they assemble at a parade, where their performance is checked, and medals are awarded.

548444.title: Maamar – Erev Rosh Hashanah, 5740
548444.description: Chassidim sing the Maamar Niggun in preparation for a Chassidic discourse.

548445.title: Secure Embassies
548445.description: With your encouragement, Mezuzos were put up on a number of Israeli embassies where you served as Ambassador. Your name “Meir” means “to shine”. May your Mazal shine, and use your influence to have Mezuzos put up in as many places as possible.

548446.title: A Mission in Australia – Part 2: Go Back Tonight!
548446.description: Living in Australia during the early 1950s, young Shmuel Gurewicz wished to study abroad in a more established Yeshiva. The Rebbe instructed him to remain in Australia, to spread the light of Torah to others there. Some time passed, and Shmuel decided to try again…
path: A Mission in Australia – Part 2: Go Back Tonight!

548448.title: Sacred Nourishment
548448.description: Torah teaches: “You are what you eat.” The holy books tell us that non-Kosher food desensitizes the person, G-d forbid, and instills cruel traits within him. How crucial it is then for Jewish food to be Kosher to the highest standard!

548449.title: Selichos
548449.description: 24-25 Elul, 5736 • September 19-20, 1976 Selichos with the Rebbe in 770. Chassidim sing a Niggun composed by the Rebbe’s maternal grandfather, to the words: “May the Merciful One, Who answers the poor, answer us. May the Merciful One, Who answers the broken-hearted, answer us.”

548450.title: New Year Blessings
548450.description: New Year’s blessings – for every letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

548451.title: Head Held High
548451.description: Shortly after her engagement, Chana Sharfstein had an audience with the Rebbe. To her surprise, the Rebbe asked if she was planning to wear a Shaitel after her marriage. But that wasn’t the only surprise in store for her.

548453.title: Blessings and Advice for the New Year
548453.description:
Thank you to all who conveyed their good wishes for the New Year. May G-d’s promise be
fulfilled: "I will bless those who bless you."
It is difficult to answer individual questions during these months of Elul and Tishrei. But when
a person truly connects with his inner Divine Soul, G-d illuminates his mind and heart with
the wisdom to make the right decision.
path: Blessings and Advice for the New Year

548454.title: Hataras Nedarim
548454.description: On the day before Rosh Hashanah, the Rebbe recites Hataras Nedarim - Annulment of Vows.

548455.title: Communicating for History
548455.description:
If you will write an article asking Jewish leaders to march in solidarity in Crown Heights, it
should only mention the positive goal of such a demonstration; it should not resurrect, or
immortalize in print, negative events of the past.

548456.title: Yom Kippur in the Air Force - Part 1: Operation Greenland
548456.description: A few days before Yom Kippur in 1964, a sudden request came to 770 from a Jew who worked on a US Air force base in Greenland, to send a Shliach there to conduct the Yom Kippur services. Rabbi Shmuel Lew was called to duty.
path: Yom Kippur in the Air Force - Part 1: Operation Greenland

548458.title: Days of Awe, Days of Joy
548458.description:
The first ten days of the year, beginning with Rosh Hashanah and ending with Yom Kippur,
are called "the Ten Days of Repentance." But the commentaries liken the seven days between
Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur to Chol Hamoed - as if they were intermediate days of a
joyous Festival. How can these days of awe be joyful days at the same time?
path: Days of Awe, Days of Joy

548459.title: Yahrtzeit of Rebbetzin Chana
548459.description:
On the 25th Yahrtzeit of his mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson, of righteous memory, the
Rebbe leads the prayers, addresses the Chassidim, and distributes a gift for the New Year.

548460.title: An Extra Sweet Year
548460.description: In case it has been decreed upon a person to turn to others for help this coming year, it should already be fulfilled now, by receiving this sweet cake.

548461.title: Yom Kippur in the Air Force - Part 2: Mission Accomplished
548461.description:
Rabbi Shmuel Lew continues recounting his Yom Kippur mission. Just one day before he was
to leave for Greenland, the Rebbe’s mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson, suddenly passed
away.
path: Yom Kippur in the Air Force - Part 2: Mission Accomplished

548463.title: Joseph, the Righteous
548463.description:
On the sixth day of Sukkos, Joseph visits every Jew. Joseph spent most of his long life in the
immoral environment of ancient Egypt. He was second-in-command to Pharaoh, and was thus
in constant contact with the local population. Yet, from among all his holy brothers, the sons
of our forefather Jacob, only Joseph is called "Joseph the Righteous;" his righteousness and
virtue were even more pronounced, given the immoral place in which he was forced to live.
And the society did not ostracize him for his righteousness; in fact, the righteous manner in
which he lived his life won him the admiration of all the Egyptians around him.

548464.title: Arba Minim
548464.description:
On the day before Sukkos, elder Chassidim receive the Four Species in the antechamber to
the Rebbe’s office.

548465.title: Kfar Chabad and Brooklyn - Healthy Competition
548465.description: New York State Assemblyman Dov Hikind visits the Rebbe. "If you were so impressed by Kfar Chabad, why not model your district here in New York after it. It will be a welcome competition. Don’t worry, Jews are accustomed to accomplishing difficult things."
path: Kfar Chabad and Brooklyn - Healthy Competition

548466.title: Courage Under Oppression
548466.description:
In spring of 1944, the Rebbe’s parents were stranded in Kazakhstan, having just completed
five years of Soviet-imposed exile. Mrs. Rochel Lipskar and her family lived a few hours away,

548469.title: Torah Scroll for Jewish Unity
548469.description:
We have just completed writing the first Sefer Torah for Jewish Unity, and are about to
commence writing the second one. When we join the last letter of this scroll, Lamed, to the
first letter of the next scroll, Bet, it creates the Hebrew word "Lev - heart." Torah is the heart
of our people, and it unites us all.

548470.title: Kos Shel Brachah
548470.description: The Rebbe distributes wine from his Kos Shel Brachah.

548471.title: Torah for its Own Sake
548471.description:
Rabbi Chaim Yaakov Goldwicht, Rosh Yeshiva of Kerem B’Yavneh visits the Rebbe.
"In your son’s case, he should not leave his full-time Torah study to take up a paid position.
He should continue to learn Torah for its own sake, not for personal gain."

548472.title: The World's Blueprint
548472.description:
In 1961, Rivkah Blau was Vice-President of Yavne, one of the first Orthodox student
organizations on American college campuses. In a private audience, the Rebbe asked Rivkah
and her friend numerous questions on the realities of Jewish outreach in university. As it
turned out, her friend came with some questions of his own.

574969.title: A Competition That Unites
574969.description: The Rebbe addresses a children's rally: The subject of your new contest is Jewish Unity. The present month, Cheshvan, is when King Solomon and the Jewish People completed the First Holy Temple. It is an auspicious month for Jews to unite together to merit the Third Temple which we will build with Moshiach.

574970.title: Children's Rally
574970.description:
Coordinators of the children’s rally receive rolls of dimes from the Rebbe, to distribute to the
children for charity.

574971.title: Investing in Charity
574971.description:
I am very happy to hear about your pledge of one million dollars to the Jewish school. May
G-d bless you that next time you will pledge twice as much, and G-d will provide for you five
times more.

574972.title: Behind the Miracle
574972.description:
After the first El Al plane was hijacked to Algiers, the story began to circulate of the Rebbe’s
advice to Ariel Sharon not to board that flight. Rabbi Zev Segal decided to corroborate the
story with the Rebbe himself.

574974.title: On Faith, Part 1
574974.description:
Classic Torah sources teach two conflicting ideas when it comes to “Trust in G-d”:
On the one hand, a person is commanded to rest assured that G-d will deliver him from any
predicament, in a way that will be openly and clearly good. On the other hand, he must joyfully acknowledge that G-d is the source of all good, and that everything He does is good - so the present state is also “good.”

574975.title: “Did You Learn Tanya Today?”
574975.description:
The Rebbe sends a pamphlet of Tanya to one of the photographers at the Farbrengen,
suggesting that he study a bit before photographing.

574976.title: Water from the Rock
574976.description:
May the leader of Israel’s current government be strong like “the Shamir,” which was a
unique creature that could split even the hardest rock. May he break through the “hearts of
stone” around him. May this help spread Torah’s waters throughout Israel.

574977.title: Questions of Faith
574977.description:
Herbert Weiner is the author of Nine-and-a-Half Mystics. During his private audiences with
the Rebbe in the mid-1950s, he raised some questions about the nature of faith in Judaism.

574980.title: On Faith, Part 2
574980.description: All human beings are commanded to believe in G-d. But must they “trust” in Him, as well?

574981.title: 10 Shevat, 5714 · January 14, 1954
574981.description:
Vintage footage of a Farbrengen held on the fourth Yahrzeit of the Rebbe’s father-in-law and
predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Schneersohn of Lubavitch.

574982.title: Blessings and Productivity
574982.description:
When a blessing is given for an endeavor, it should be connected with a physical action,
thereby putting the blessing into effect. All endeavors to build Judaism must be carried out
with absolute maximum effort.

574983.title: Questions of Faith
574983.description:
Herbert Weiner is the author of Nine-and-a-Half Mystics, and served as the leader of a Reform
congregation in New Jersey for forty years. He discussed with the Rebbe Chabad’s unique
approach to reconnecting Jews with their faith.

574985.title: Behind Every Great Jewish Man Is a Great Jewish Mother
574985.description: Sarah, the first Jewish mother, is a shining example of the great power that every woman has over her family and our entire nation. It was Sarah who insisted that Isaac, not Ishmael, continue Abraham’s progeny. It was she who raised Isaac in his formative years, instilling within him the fortitude to stand up to all tests, and to become the second Patriarch of the Jewish People.
path: Behind Every Great Jewish Man Is a Great Jewish Mother

574986.title: 12 Tammuz, 5743 · June 23, 1983
574986.description: The Rebbe gives a bottle of L’chaim to be distributed among participants at the Farbrengen.

574987.title: Interdependence
574987.description:
If you will be healthy, your wife will be healthy and the Shliach will be healthy, then I will be
healthy as well. So from South America you can effect my health all the way here in Brooklyn.

574988.title: Jewish Feminism
574988.description:
Dr. Susan Handelman is Professor of English Literature at Bar Ilan University in Israel. While
working on her PhD in 1977, she came to study in Crown Heights, with some suspicions as
to what she would find to be the woman’s place in Chassidic life.

574990.title: The Shlichus Needs You
574990.description:
In discussing the mechanism of legal agency, Jewish law sees the "principal" working through
the "emissary" in three possible ways:
1) The emissary's final achievement is attributed to the principal
2) The emissary's every action is attributed to the principal
3) The emissary completely embodies the principal.

574991.title: L’chaim for Shluchim
574991.description: The Rebbe distributes bottles of L’chaim to Shluchim and special guests.

574992.title: Partners in the Shlichus
574992.description: Shluchim bring devoted supporters to receive the Rebbe’s blessing.

574993.title: The Rebbe's Son-in-law
574993.description:
During the 1930s, the Previous Rebbe would often visit a health clinic in Paris. On Shabbos,
he would stay at the home of Yankel and Baila Lax. Their son, Berel, was about twenty years
old at the time, and recalls the Rebbe visiting his father-in-law at their home quite frequently.

574995.title: Escorting the Bride and Groom, Part 1
574995.description: When G-d and the Jewish People were "married" at Mount Sinai, there were two "marriage ushers": Moses and Aaron. In commemoration of this, at a Jewish wedding two ushers escort bride and groom to one another. But there is a surprising regulation that demands explanation: a pregnant woman may not serve as marriage usher.
path: Escorting the Bride and Groom, Part 1

574997.title: Planning to Expand?
574997.description:
Many Russian Jews are now moving to your city. So the sooner your new Synagogue building
will be ready, the sooner you will have the need to expand even more.

574998.title: Anatomy of a Miracle
574998.description:
On Shemini Atzeres, 1977, the Rebbe suffered a massive heart attack during the Hakofos
celebration. Dr. Ira Weiss flew in from Chicago to join the medical team treating the Rebbe at
770. Subsequently, he became the Rebbe's cardiologist.

575000.title: Escorting the Bride and Groom, Part 2
575000.description:
At Mount Sinai, Moses and Aaron served as "marriage ushers," escorting G-d and the Jewish
People to one another to unite in an eternal covenant. Chassidic teaching explains that Moses
represented the "masculine" Divine force, and Aaron, the "feminine" Divine force - so from
this derives the custom for a man and a woman to escort bride and groom to the Chupah.
path: Escorting the Bride and Groom, Part 2

575001.title: Wedding
575001.description:
The Rebbe officiates at the wedding of Rabbi Hirshel and Rivkah Chitrik, the second wedding
at which he did so after assuming leadership of the Lubavitch movement.

575002.title: For Your Wedding…
575002.description: The Rebbe blesses and distributes dollars to brides and grooms for their wedding.

575003.title: A Wife’s Nachas
575003.description:
Mrs. Louise Hager was fourteen years-old when she first met the Rebbe's wife, Rebbetzin
Chaya Mushka. Over the years, she developed a close relationship with the Rebbetzin.

575005.title: The Inner Meaning of Yud Tes Kislev
575005.description:
With the Alter Rebbe's release from prison in 1798, he began to teach Torah's secrets in a
way that would brighten every Jewish home, and would permeate the outside world.
path: The Inner Meaning of Yud Tes Kislev

575006.title: Nigun Daled Bavos
575006.description: Chassidim sing the Alter Rebbe's "Niggun of Four Stanzas."

575007.title: Chassidic Kabbalah
575007.description:
Rabbi Simcha Ashlag asks the Rebbe to endorse a proclamation that it is time for every Jew
to study the classical works of Kabbalah.

575008.title: An Encounter with the Alter Rebbe
575008.description:
Rabbi Yehuda Leib Schapiro heard Rabbi J.B. Soloveitchik retell the story of the Alter Rebbe’s
attempt to visit the Vilna Gaon, as it had been passed down through his own family, all the
way back to the Gaon’s chief disciple.
path: An Encounter with the Alter Rebbe

604927.title: Lights, Camera, Action!
604927.description:
An address at the Chanukah Live worldwide satellite hookup at 770:
"Everything G-d created, He created for His glory." The ultimate purpose of science is to
discover new ways to facilitate and increase our ability to serve G-d. This we see clearly here
at this gathering: Jews in every corner of the globe were able to tune in, via satellite, and to
watch as one little child kindled the Chanukah flames. Thus we see an illustration of the fact
that one Mitzvah instantly brings light to the entire world.

604928.title: Children’s Rally
604928.description: The Menorah is lit at 770, and children sing Haneiros Hallalu with the Rebbe.

604929.title: Happy Chanukah - Collage
604929.description: People come to the Rebbe to receive a Chanukah blessing.

604930.title: In the Halls of the Sorbonne
604930.description:
In November 1937, the Rebbe enrolled in the University of Paris, known as "the Sorbonne."
A young man named Moshe Zev Reitzer was studying to become a pharmacist at the
Sorbonne, attending some of the same classes as the Rebbe. Yoel Reitzer is Moshe Zev's son.
path: In the Halls of the Sorbonne

604933.title: "Polishing the Buttons"
604933.description:
My father-in-law, the Rebbe, gave us a mission: "Stand ready to greet Moshiach." "Everything
is already prepared, all that remains is to 'polish the buttons.'"

604934.title: Didan Notzach
604934.description: Chassidim sing “Didan Notzach - Victory is Ours.”

604935.title: Holy Books
604935.description: Rabbis and authors present copies of their new Torah books to the Rebbe.

604936.title: “He'll Find a Way”
604936.description:
With Germany about to invade France, Asher Heber’s father was unsure whether to escape
Paris with his family and leave behind their well-established life. When he consulted the Rebbe
for his opinion, the Rebbe suggested some seemingly impossible advice...

604938.title: A Four-Sided Blessing
604938.description:
In the fifth section of the Torah portion of Vayechi, Jacob's blessings to four of his sons are
grouped together: "A troop marches forth from the tribe of Gad... The tribe of Asher will be
a wellspring of olive oil... Naftali is a swift gazelle... Joseph, a robust grape vine by the
spring…" All four blessings demonstrate vitality and initiative.

604939.title: Funeral of Rabbi Moshe Yitzchak Hecht
604939.description:
The Rebbe joins the funeral procession for Rabbi Moshe Yitzchak Hecht, one of the first
Shluchim of the Previous Rebbe and Rebbe in the United States.
path: Funeral of Rabbi Moshe Yitzchak Hecht

604940.title: The Melting Pot
604940.description:
Mayor of New York, David Dinkins visits the Rebbe:
“May all the nationalities living in New York live side-by-side in peace and harmony. You must
emphasize New Yorkers’ similarities rather than their differences. Every one of them should
support their neighbor, especially in matters of charity.”

604941.title: A Talmud Class to Remember
604941.description:
Rivkah Marelus’s father told her a “memorable” story about a Talmud class the Rebbe gave
in Paris during the 1930s.

604943.title: "This is My G-d"
604943.description:
At the crossing of the Red Sea, the Jews proclaimed, "This is my G-d, and I will exalt Him!"
But the first to recognize G-d's hand were those children born in Egypt during the harsh
decrees. G-d Himself had hidden them away in the fields and sustained them.

604944.title: A Song in Georgian
604944.description: The Rebbe asks a recent émigré from Georgia to sing a traditional song of the Georgian Jews.

604945.title: Our Family in Georgia
604945.description:
Add to all your activities, especially for our friends and relatives in the country of Georgia.
Geographically, they may be far-away, but they are closer to the Holy Land than we are, here
in the United States.

604946.title: Head of the Resistance
604946.description:
As First Secretary in the Israeli embassy in Moscow during the late 1950s, Aryeh Lova Eliav
assisted Chabad's underground network in their mission to preserve Judaism in the Soviet
Union. After completing his post in Russia, he had a private audience with the Rebbe, which
lasted seven hours.

618964.title: To Die for G-d, or to Live for Him?
618964.description:
G-d longs for our physical world to become a dwelling place for Him. This mission can only
be accomplished by a living person. Man's aspiration should never be to "escape" this world,
and certainly never to endanger his own life. Even Rabbi Akiva, who longed his entire life to
give up his life for G-d, did not actively pursue this goal. To the contrary, a person must
preserve and safeguard his life, and devote his entire being toward elevating the world around
him.
path: To Die for G-d, or to Live for Him?

618965.title: 2nd Yahrtzeit of the Previous Rebbe
618965.description:
Vintage film footage of the Farbrengen upstairs at 770 on the second Yahrtzeit of the Rebbe’s
father-in-law and predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

618966.title: What's Money Have to do With It?
618966.description:
When Moses came promising the redemption, attaining the wealth of Egypt was the last thing
on the Jewish People’s minds. All they wanted was to leave exile as soon as possible.
path: What's Money Have to do With It?

618967.title: "How Could He Have Known?"
618967.description:
In April, 1985 the Rebbe instructed Professor Herman Branover to call his contacts in the
Soviet Union and inform them that freedom was closer than they could possibly imagine.

618969.title: "I have Come to My Garden" - Part 1
618969.description:
The Chassidic discourse entitled "Bosi L'Gani" opens with a quote from Song of Songs, where
G-d exclaims: "I have come to My garden…" G-d's Divine Essence originally dwelled in our
world. But a series of unfortunate events caused a decline in the world's spiritual state. It
was through the righteous deeds of Abraham and his descendants, that G-d’s Divine Presence
was finally restored to this world.
path: "I have Come to My Garden" - Part 1

618970.title: Tzomah L'cha Nafshi
618970.description:
"My soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You; as one in a desolate and dry land without
water, so I thirst to behold You in the Sanctuary, to behold Your might and glory." (Psalms
63:2, 3). This song was first taught by the Rebbe on 28 Nissan, 5714 - 1954.

618971.title: Shabbos in the Capital
618971.description:
To be a Shabbos-observant Jew in the Congress would be a great sanctification of G-d’s
name. It will not only inspire Jews to keep Torah and Mitzvos, it will inspire non-Jews as well
to keep the Seven Noahide Laws.

618972.title: It's Not About You
618972.description:
As a young man, Rabbi Aharon Serebryansky lived in Australia, and was among the original
students of the Lubavitch Yeshivah there. When he found himself devoting vast amounts of
time to teaching others rather than to his own learning, he turned to the Rebbe for guidance.

618979.title: "I have Come to My Garden" - Part 2
618979.description:
One might think that he must first perfect himself before he can try to perfect the world. But
Torah commands us to transform this world into a beautiful garden for G-d, and this is a top
priority. There is no conflict here: G-d empowers every person with the ability to
simultaneously elevate himself as well as others - as my father-in-law, the Rebbe, proved in
his own life, and through those who follow in his footsteps.
path: "I have Come to My Garden" - Part 2

618980.title: 42nd Yahrtzeit of the Previous Rebbe
618980.description:
The Rebbe leads the Morning Prayers on the 42nd Yahrtzeit of his father-in-law and
predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

618981.title: A Candle for One, A Light for All
618981.description:
There is an expression: "A candle for one, is a candle for one hundred." If you light one
candle, it provides the needs, of light, for all the people in the room. Go from strength to
strength in all matters of Judaism in general, and especially in something that will influence
a crowd. Then with the same amount of effort you can influence a greater number of people.
path: A Candle for One, A Light for All

618982.title: To Be A Rebbe
618982.description:
Freddy Hager comes from a long line of famous rabbis and Chassidic Rebbes. At his first
private audience with the Rebbe, the Rebbe told him how to carry on the family legacy.

618984.title: Protector of Her People
618984.description:
At the time of the Song of Moses, the Jews were in the midst of a great journey through an
awesome desert. They had yet to reach, conquer and establish a Jewish homeland. By
contrast, at the time of the Song of Deborah, the Jews were already settled in the Land of
Israel. Deborah was called upon to organize a campaign against Canaanite invaders.

618985.title: Address to Jewish Women
618985.description: The Rebbe addresses the Lubavitch Women’s Organization on the main floor of 770.

618986.title: She is a Shliach
618986.description: The Rebbe distributes dollars and blessings to Shluchos.

618987.title: Someone had Spoken to Him
618987.description:
Mr. Bentzion Rader and his wife, Hinda, live in London, England. In 1974, the Rebbe
instructed them to publish a chassidic primer for Jewish women.

629695.title: On Kaddish
629695.description:
"Exalted and hallowed be G-d's great Name." The opening words of the Kaddish are a very
clear declaration, that through reciting Kaddish a person causes G-d's very Essence to become
magnified throughout all levels of creation.

629696.title: End of Shiva for the Rebbetzin
629696.description:
The Rebbe leads the prayers at his home on President Street, on the last day of Shiva for his
wife of sixty years, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, of blessed memory.
“It is customary to elevate the soul of the deceased through a Chassidic Farbrengen. It should
be done beautifully, and should be held here, in the house where she lived.”
path: End of Shiva for the Rebbetzin

629697.title: Women Honor the Rebbetzin
629697.description:
A gift to the Rebbe from an 8th Grade girls’ class, in memory of the Rebbetzin.
“Explain to your class that the Jews were redeemed from Egypt because the women acted
as they should. And "women" means both adults, as well as young girls. Be a shining example
of a what it means to be a good Jewish girl.”

629698.title: Understanding the Shluchim
629698.description:
Mrs. Leah Kahan shares some of the Rebbetzin’s admiration for the Shluchim, which she
heard first-hand.

629700.title: The Divine Presence - Here to Stay
629700.description:
One of the Talmudic signs that Moshiach is soon to arrive is: "Nations will contend with one
another." The lack of peace and harmony in the world in recent times, is more than enough
to provide this sign. Now it is time for man - and G-d - to turn all attention toward making this
world a fully civilized place.
path: The Divine Presence - Here to Stay

629701.title: Placing of the cornerstone at 770
629701.description:
The Rebbe attends the groudbreaking for the expansion of 770.
“G-d created the world from a foundation stone which lies in the Holy of Holies in the Holy
Temple. This teaches us that the foundation of every Jewish edifice - whether a physical
building or a spiritual undertaking - must be built upon the foundation of Torah.”

629702.title: Groundbreaking
629702.description:
Mr. David Chase, Chairman of the Machne Israel Development Fund, invites the Rebbe to the
groundbreaking for the expansion of 770. The Rebbe says: “I will attend if you will say some
words in Yiddish - your mother-tongue. That will be a good start for the new year.”

629703.title: Money or Life
629703.description:
Mr. Peter Kalms lives in London, England. In one of his letters, he explained to the Rebbe the
financial pressures that Chabad institutions were facing there, and that it may compel them
to restrict some of their classes...

629705.title: It's in Your Hands
629705.description:
The lunar year is eleven days shorter than the solar year. Therefore, every two or three years,
an additional month is added to the Jewish calendar, to bring the lunar and solar years back
into alignment.

629706.title: Hupp Cossak
629706.description: Chassidim sing Hupp Cossak, as the Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing.

629707.title: Seize the Moment
629707.description:
The month of Adar is a "successful month." Our sages tell us that in this month, the
"fortune" of the Jewish People is healthy and successful. And this year we have sixty days
- two months of Adar.

629708.title: Downstairs Neighbors
629708.description:
In the mid-1950s, Rabbi Yosef Goldstein and his family lived two floors below the Rebbe and
Rebbetzin, at 346 New York Avenue.

629710.title: Victory in Our Times
629710.description:
An address to children:
Thousands of years ago there lived the wicked Haman, who wanted to do bad to the Jewish
People. But they were not afraid, and they remained loyal to Judaism, to Mordechai and
Esther, and to their teachers who showed them how a Jew should live his daily life.
What connection does Haman have to a Jewish child today?

629711.title: We Want Moshiach Now
629711.description: The Rebbe asks the children to sing the Tzivos Hashem anthem.

629712.title: Marching to Greet Moshiach
629712.description:
Do not be afraid to announce that you are a Chassid. May your children go from strength to
strength in their rank in Tzivos Hashem. The sages tell us that Moshiach has eight names.
May each of your eight children merit to greet him with a different one of his names.

629713.title: A Long-Term Investment
629713.description:
Dr. David Luchins' family joined the Tzemach Tzedek Synagogue in the Brownsville section of
Brooklyn, around 1910. In 1955, when the neighborhood changed, the property was sold for
a large sum. The Rebbe was asked where the money should be spent.

640799.title: From One, Many - Part 1
640799.description: The Zohar teaches that the world was created through the Hebrew letters, with the Torah as its blueprint. In turn, the entire Torah is encapsulated in the Ten Commandments, which is further concentrated in its initial letter, the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet: Alef. This letter alludes to the Creator, Who is one and unique. Through this one solitary letter, G-d constantly creates the multifarious universe with all its myriad components.

640800.title: Nickels - Erev Yom Kippur
640800.description: On the day before Yom Kippur, The Rebbe distributes nickels to children to give to charity.

640801.title: Within You
640801.description:
You must search in your own heart for Judaism, and then bring it from your heart, for it to
activate and direct your entire being.

640802.title: The Path of the Heart
640802.description:
In 1969, Mr. Gordon Zacks was Chairman of the UJA's Young Leadership Cabinet. Shortly
after delivering a keynote address to three thousand communal leaders from across the US
and Canada, he was informed that the Rebbe wished to meet with him - for a “heart to heart”
discussion.

640804.title: From One, Many - Part 2
640804.description:
Those working to free the millions trapped behind the Iron Curtain must not forget to free
themselves, as well.
By taking a staunch moral stance against injustice, the individual fulfills his role in this world and becomes a light unto many.

640805.title: Vayehi Bimei Achashverosh
640805.description:
Chassidim sing a lively Nigun to the opening verse of the Purim Megillah:
“Now it came to pass in the days of Achashverosh - Achashverosh who reigned from Hodu to
Cush, one hundred twenty-seven provinces.”

640806.title: Priorities
640806.description:
Don't wait so long as since I last spoke with you to report good news in spreading Judaism,
especially in the realm of Jewish education. Your main concern must be: What are you doing
to benefit the community?

640807.title: The Path of the Heart
640807.description:
Gordon Zacks concludes the account of his 1970 audience with the Rebbe on the topics of
self improvement and the importance of Jewish education in defeating assimilation.

640809.title: How to Celebrate Moses' Birthday
640809.description:
What is the theme of Moses’ life—and of his birthday, the seventh of Adar? Moses is Torah.
The entire Torah from beginning to end, even the new Torah insights revealed in subsequent
generations, derive from what Moses received at Sinai. So the main thrust and initiative of
this day is growth in Torah.

640810.title: Selichos - Taanis Esther
640810.description:
On the Fast of Esther, a few weeks after the passing of his wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka
Schneerson, of blessed memory, the Rebbe leads Selichos at his home on President Street.

640811.title: They Danced Around the Video
640811.description:
To thank G-d for your success, add at least one Jewish educational enterprise in your
community. You are in the “video business.” This past Chanukah, our live satelite hookup
allowed Jews around the globe to join in the lighting of the Chanukah candles. It had a special
impact on all who saw it, especially in Moscow where they danced around the video!

640812.title: A Happy Ending
640812.description:
Joe Cayre, businessman, philanthropist and co-founder of Good Times Home Video, shares
some personal business advice he received from the Rebbe.

640814.title: The Night the King Woke Up…
640814.description:
"On that night the king's sleep was disturbed…" Taken literally this verse refers to King
Achashverosh. But the Midrash explains a deeper dimension: "The sleep of the King of the
universe was disturbed" - G-d Himself "woke up."
path: The Night the King Woke Up…

640815.title: Purim “Masquerade”
640815.description: Children in Purim costume pass by the Rebbe to receive dollars to give to charity.

640816.title: A Priestly Nation
640816.description:
You are a Kohen, and a rabbi - and a Chief Rabbi. May you become a "Chief Kohen," and may
"the Kohen be seen in Zion." In the meantime, see to double your work in Australia. It
especially depends on you more than other rabbis there, for you are a rabbi and Kohen as one

640817.title: Purim in Berlin
640817.description:
Rabbi Chaim Ciment shares a few stories he heard from Rabbi Joseph Ber Soloveitchik about
his days together with the Rebbe in Berlin.

652819.title: Knowing the Unknowable
652819.description:
Moses could not fathom what procedure could possibly purify a person who had been ritually
defiled by contact with death, until G‑d granted him a uniquely profound revelation. Although
in exile the ritual of the Red Heifer cannot be performed, through learning about this mitzvah,
a Jew can purify his body and soul.

652820.title: Nigun "Sheyiboneh"
652820.description:
"May it be Your will, L-rd our G-d and G-d of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be speedily
rebuilt in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah."

652821.title: Jewish Academia
652821.description:
The very first commandment to the Jewish People was to calculate the Jewish calendar -
which requires extensive mathematical knowledge and ability. Even when teaching
mathematics, its essence should be Judaism.

652822.title: A Mother Recalls
652822.description:
Mrs. Rochel Lipskar used to visit the Rebbe's mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson of blessed
memory. On occasion, Rebbetzin Chana would recall the Rebbe's childhood.

652824.title: Clarity of Purpose: Moral Leadership
652824.description:
An address on the Rebbe's birthday, shortly after the assassination attempt on US President
Ronald Reagan's life.

652825.title: Public Torah Reading in 770
652825.description: The Rebbe joins the upstairs Minyan at 770 for the Monday morning Torah Reading.

652826.title: Jewish Singles Events
652826.description:
To create an institute to help Jewish singles meet requires the careful guidance of a rabbinic
authority. He will show you how to avoid the many Halachic problems that can arise. With the
proper rabbinic guidance, you have my blessing to have even more success than you expect.

652827.title: No Child Left Behind
652827.description:
As a rabbinic student at 770, Rabbi Aaron Cousin joined his colleagues in working under the
New York State "Released time" program, which allows Public School students to receive
religious instruction.

652829.title: Clarity of Purpose: Freedom for What?
652829.description:
The assassination attempt on President Reagan's life proves that poverty cannot be blamed
as the true source of crime. Crime comes from a deeper source.
path: Clarity of Purpose: Freedom for What?

652830.title: Nigun "Utzu Eitza"
652830.description:
"Contrive a scheme, but it will be foiled; conspire a plot, but it will not materialize, for G-d is
with us."

652831.title: Follow Your Pedigree
652831.description:
Knesset Member Aharon Abuchatzeira visits the Rebbe:
Continue in the tradition of the holy Abuchatzeiras, and continue to stand strong for the
complete Jewish People, the complete Holy Land and the complete Torah. If you require
miracles to achieve this, the Abuchatzeiras have always had miracles, left, right and center!

652832.title: My Dear Children: An audience with the Previous Rebbe
652832.description:
In 1941, Yehudah Leib Posner, age 13, and his brother Zalman, age 14, were students at the
Yeshiva in 770.
path: My Dear Children: An audience with the Previous Rebbe

652834.title: Clarity of Purpose: Inner Unity, World Peace
652834.description:
The best way to heal illness is through preventive measures. The disease of crime is a reality,
but recognizing that it is real should bring about real change. The education system must
reorient itself to stop this disease before it manifests. We are not calling for a "new" resolution,
but rather a return to the values accepted by the citizens of this country and by all nations.
path: Clarity of Purpose: Inner Unity, World Peace

652835.title: Tanya Distribution
652835.description: The Rebbe distributes Tanyas on his 80th birthday.

652836.title: Life Mimics Art
652836.description:
Artists Vladmir and Gregory Dashevsky present a birthday present to the Rebbe - a painting
they made of the Rebbe receiving an Aliyah to the Torah.

652837.title: The Flashpoint
652837.description: In 1972, Yehuda Avner was a senior diplomat at the Israeli Embassy in Washington.

666117.title: Iron Curtain, World Stage
666117.description:
From the moment G-d took possession of the Jewish People at Sinai, never again can a Jew
be enslaved to another’s rule. The Jewish spirit can never be subjugated as it was in Egypt.
My father-in-law, the Rebbe declared: "Only our bodies, not our souls, were sent into exile."

666118.title: Matzah Distribution
666118.description: On the eve of Passover, the Rebbe distributes Matzos for the Seder.

666119.title: Remembering the Exodus
666119.description:
Rabbi Meir Grunberg, Av Beis Din of Igud Harabbanim visits the Rebbe:
We do not make a blessing on the recitation of the Haggadah at the Seder, because we have
it in mind during the Shehechiyanu during Kiddush...

666120.title: A Contract with G-d
666120.description:
Rabbi Zev Segal served as Rabbi of the Young Israel of Newark for fifty years, and was
president of the Rabbinical Council of America. Through his work, he visited Jewish
communities across the globe.

666122.title: Father, Where Are You?
666122.description:
The purpose of exile has been explained with a parable: G-d hides from us, like a father hides
from his son - in order to evoke the son's deepest desire to find his father and be close to him
again.

666123.title: Nigun “Yiddalech Shreit”
666123.description: “Rebuild the Temple speedily in our days. Jews, shout out loud: How long must we wait?”

666124.title: G-d's Word, In Your Hands
666124.description:
Rabbi Moshe Stern, Debreciner Rav, visits the Rebbe.
"The word of G-d," according to the Talmud, refers to two things: "The End Time" - the
coming of Moshiach, and also "Torah law." So connect the two interpretations, and bring
Moshiach! Publish a Halachic ruling that the Redemption must already come. The Talmud
itself rules that all 'end times' have passed.

666125.title: Revolutionaries
666125.description:
Rabbi Yisroel Meir Lau was Chief Rabbi of Israel from 1993 to 2003. He had his first private
audience with the Rebbe in 1974, shortly after the Yom Kippur War.

666127.title: Make It Count
666127.description: There are Mitzvos that are linked to specific days or weeks throughout the year, but the only Mitzvah linked to an entire month is during the month of Iyar – the Counting of the Omer. This is a lesson for all year round: A person must continuously grow in matters of holiness, always seeking new ways to take on more Mitzvos.

666128.title: Birthday of the Rebbe Maharash
666128.description:
Evening Prayers on the birthday of Rabbi Shmuel of Lubavitch, the Rebbe Maharash.
“In matters of goodness and holiness, every Jew must strive to incorporate the Rebbe
Maharash's approach of "Lechatchila Ariber" - to not be satisfied with anything less than
‘Over and Above’…”

666129.title: Just Visiting?
666129.description:
When you visit Peru, find the Chabad Shliach there and assist him in the way that only a
visitor can. Sometimes a visitor can help more than someone who has been living in a
community for many years.

666130.title: A Mission to Lithuania
666130.description:
In 1966, Rabbi Yosef Krupnik was a student at the RJJ Yeshivah on the Lower East Side.
From his teacher, Rabbi Shaya Shimonowitz, he heard a story about the Rebbe in Europe.

666132.title: Respect
666132.description:
The Talmud tells us that 24,000 students of Rabbi Akiva died because “they did not treat one
another with respect.” But the plague ended on Lag BaOmer, which means they had remedied
their actions and began to treat each other with the appropriate level of esteem.

666133.title: Commemorative Coins
666133.description:
The Rebbe distributes a commemorative coin in honor of the Rebbe Maharash, whose birthday
is during the month of Iyar.

666134.title: Solving the World's Problems
666134.description:
Whenever there is a dispute between Jews, everyone loses out. The way to resolve issues is
not by attracting attention and raising additional issues. Don't press to find the solution to
every issue on the first day. Leave something for Moshiach to solve.

666135.title: A Friend's Memory
666135.description: Efraim Steinmetz's father knew the Rebbe in Paris during the 1930s.

675631.title: Never Alone
675631.description:
G-d has promised to redeem us from exile. G-d Himself could have chosen to remain in the
Heavens, separate from the exile, and from afar direct events to finally lead to our redemption.
But Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai tells us otherwise: “Every place where the Jewish People are
exiled, the Divine Presence is together with them.”

675632.title: Lag B’omer Parade
675632.description: The Rebbe participates in the 1976 Lag B’omer Parade.

675633.title: Build Upon the Past
675633.description:
You have not been writing me as often as you once did. But the main thing is, even if you are
not writing, that your Jewish activities grow and not remain static. May you and your rabbi
have Nachas from each other.

675634.title: “Think Good, and it will be Good”
675634.description:
In 1979, Mr. Freddy Hager was a diamond dealer in London, England. Business was slow, and
he came to the Rebbe for advice.
path: “Think Good, and it will be Good”

675636.title: “Armed” Forces
675636.description:
Every Jewish boy and girl is chosen by G-d to be His “soldier”. Their duty is to banish the Evil
Inclination, and influence the entire world to follow the Good Inclination alone.

675637.title: Nigun “Ki Elokim”
675637.description:
“G-d will redeem Zion and build the cities of Judah, and they will dwell there and possess it.
The descendants of His servants will inherit it and those who love His name will establish
themselves there.” (Psalms 69: 36-37)

675638.title: Focus Your Influence
675638.description:
With all the good work you do for Russian Jewry worldwide, your main focus must be to help
those in your own country of Australia. After all their struggles under communism, may they
find peace and tranquility there.

675639.title: Returning to Torah - Part 1
675639.description:
In 1962, Dr. Yaacov Hanoka was a physics student at Pennsylvania State University. After a
group of rabbinic students visited his campus for Shabbos, he was intrigued to learn more
about Judaism. His Hillel rabbi arranged a private audience for him with the Rebbe.

675641.title: Why G-d Gave Us So Many Mitzvahs
675641.description:
“G-d desired to bring merit upon the Jewish people; therefore He gave them Torah and
Mitzvos in abundance.” G-d is certain that we will use the great opportunity He offers us to
make Him proud. Thus laden with a treasure-load of good deeds, good words and good
thoughts, we prepare ourselves to receive the Torah—in all its richness—on Shavuos.
path: Why G-d Gave Us So Many Mitzvahs

675642.title: Nigun “Atah V’chartanu”
675642.description:
“You have chosen us from among all the nations; You have loved us and found favor with us.
You have raised us above all tongues and made us holy through Your commandments. You, our
King, have drawn us near to Your service and proclaimed Your great and holy Name upon us.”
(From the Festival Prayers)
The Rebbe taught this song on Simchas Torah 5721 - 1960

675643.title: Tightrope Diplomacy
675643.description:
Senator Joseph Lieberman visits the Rebbe:
There are so many changes happening in the Middle East - and so soon - that it is very
difficult to make predictions. Decide each day's policies according to the developments of
that day, even if newer developments require a new response.

675644.title: Returning to Torah - Part 2
675644.description: Dr. Yaacov Hanoka continues the account of his first year studies at 770.

675646.title: Torah Light
675646.description: How Purim emphasizes the feminine aspect of Torah, which was missing until then.

675647.title: “Cup of Blessing”
675647.description: Havdalah after Shavuos. The Rebbe distributes the wine of the After-blessing.

675648.title: Receiving the Torah
675648.description:
Rabbi Simcha Elberg of Agudas HaRabbanim and Agudas Yisroel visits the Rebbe:
For Shavuos, my father-in-law, the Rebbe would say, “May you receive the Torah joyfully and
internally.” But with the name “Simcha” you have joy all year round!
Is all well with your wife? Remember: at Sinai, the Torah was told first to the women and only
afterwards to the men.

675649.title: Family Memories
675649.description:
Rabbi Sholom Ber Butman recalls his childhood memories of the Rebbe in Paris, 1947, when
the Rebbe flew there to greet his mother after she escaped Russia.

690693.title: All of Torah in Your Hand
690693.description:
Maimonides writes in the introduction to his Code of Jewish law that if one studies the five
Books of Moses and goes straight to studying his code, he will know all of Jewish law, of both
the Written and Oral Torah. This means that the scope of Maimonides’ codification is beyond
anything that ever preceded or followed it!
path: All of Torah in Your Hand

690694.title: Tzama Lecha Nafshi
690694.description:
“My soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You; (as one) in a desolate and dry land without
water, so (I thirst) to see You in the Sanctuary, to behold Your might and glory.” (Psalm 63)

690695.title: Completion of Rambam
690695.description: A collage surrounding the celebration on completing the sixth study cycle of Mishneh Torah.

690696.title: Family Memories
690696.description:
Rabbi Sholom Ber Butman concludes his childhood memories of the Rebbe’s stay in Paris in
1947. The Butman family was staying at the same home as the Rebbe’s mother after her
escape from Russia.

690699.title: A Trek with G-d
690699.description:
G-d established the authority of Aaron the High Priest by putting the Twelve Tribes to a test:
Each tribe was to bring forth a staff representing its leader and leave it in the Tabernacle
overnight. By morning, Aaron’s staff had miraculously sprouted buds and almonds.

690701.title: Jewish Legislation
690701.description:
Go from strength to strength in your work to champion the needs of the Jewish People in the
New York State government.

690702.title: Under the Talis
690702.description:
The Rebbe records in his diary of 1932 that his father-in-law and predecessor, Rabbi Yosef
Yitzchak of Lubavitch, instructed him to don four pairs of Tefillin every day.
Rabbi Yisroel Gordon was a student in 770 when the Rebbe arrived in America in June, 1941.
He recalls how this secret first became known to American Chassidim.

690704.title: "He, Too, Is Alive"
690704.description:
Torah expects a tzaddik to not be satisfied with his own righteousness; his mission is to
influence his fellow Jews to follow G‑d’s path, and to help them become in turn sources of
inspiration to others as well.

690705.title: Panim at the Ohel
690705.description:
Just hours before Rosh Hashanah, the Rebbe brings requests for blessings received from
around the world to the resting place of his father-in-law and predecessor, Rabbi Yosef
Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

690706.title: A Personal Response
690706.description:
Time does not permit a written response to every letter I receive. But my personal response
to all is: I will mention it at the resting place of my father-in-law, the Rebbe; and may G-d
help you in all that you need.

690707.title: My Job Description
690707.description:
Dr. Yitzchak Block is Emeritus Professor of Philosophy at the University of Western Ontario.
In the mid-1950s, he accompanied a group of college students to a private audience with the
Rebbe.

690709.title: An Envoy On High
690709.description:
Although I cannot reply individually to each and every letter, let it be known that they are all
brought to the resting place of my father-in-law, the Rebbe. Just as he served his flock before,
the Rebbe continues to serve from On High. He arouses Divine mercy upon the Jewish People,
ensuring that all requests brought to his resting place will be fulfilled through G-d’s “full, open,
holy, generous hand.”

690710.title: Shacharis in the Rebbe’s home
690710.description:
The Rebbe leads the Morning Prayers at his home on President Street, in the year following the
passing of his wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, of blessed memory.

690711.title: The Tribe of Levi
690711.description:
The task of the Tribe of Levi is to bring all Jews to be “drawn close to serve God.” May it be
fulfilled through you and all your colleagues: “he who achieves one hundred, desires two
hundred.” If this is said in regard to material pursuits, how much more so does it apply to Torah
and Mitzvos.

690712.title: Where Art Thou?
690712.description:
Herbert Weiner is the author of Nine and a Half Mystics. He interviewed the Rebbe twice during
the 1950s, and corresponded with him in the years that followed.

702082.title: Working the High Circles
702082.description:
When it appears to a person that he is a minority standing against the jungle of the world, he
has the example of my father-in-law, the Rebbe: One lone individual who stood against a
ruthless, powerful regime - and triumphed, for he had G-d on his side.

702083.title: Bris Milah for Soviet Jewry
702083.description:
Reb Avraham Genin, a member of the underground network of Chabad Chassidim in the Soviet
Union, visits the Rebbe.

702084.title: Operation Exodus
702084.description:
May G-d help you to do “more than your best” in providing for the special needs of the Russian
Jews who can finally leave the Soviet Union.

702085.title: Diplomacy
702085.description:
Rabbi Avraham Korf is head Shliach of the State of Florida. He shares some instructions he
received from the Rebbe in how to balance groundbreaking Shlichus with respect for existing
institutions.

702087.title: A Partner in Creation
702087.description:
An address to counselors going off to work at summer camp:
The Mishna states: “All that G-d created in His universe, He created only for His glory.” The
Baal Shem Tov teaches that G-d continues to re-create all of creation at each and every
instant. Simultaneously, man is granted the ability to reveal G-d's “glory” within it.
And it is the duty of the camp counselors to instill this sense of purpose in their
campers in all that they do.

702088.title: “Niggun Yud-Beis Tammuz”
702088.description:
Chassidim sing a Niggun traditionally sung on the anniversary of the Previous Rebbe’s release
from prison in 1927.

702089.title: A Healthy Appetite
702089.description:
I will not be happy if your Shliach’s appetite to achieve is satisfied. Give him what he needs
now, and he should continue to ask you for more in the future!

702090.title: Seven Hours Straight
702090.description:
Rabbi Nochum Avraham Yakobovitch was in Paris during the Rebbe’s stay there in 1947. He
was present one Shabbos when the Rebbe was studying alone in the synagogue.

702093.title: United, We Stand
702093.description:
Exile and the Jew are complete opposites! A Jew is the “only son” of G-d, King of kings. And
a prince - especially the only son of the King of kings - has only one place fit for him: by his
father’s side. Why then, were the Jewish People exiled from their Father’s palace?

702094.title: Haftarah
702094.description: Watch how the Rebbe reads the special Haftarah on the 17th of Tammuz.

702095.title: Unified Effort
702095.description:
Rabbi Schnitzler, the Tshaber Rav of Jerusalem, visits the Rebbe:
“I only give over what others have taught before me. If someone is able to add to it, by all
means - anything to hasten Moshiach’s arrival!”

702096.title: The Stamp Collection
702096.description:
Mr. Hirsh Katz recalls some of the Rebbe’s personal guidance to him as a youth. His father,
Reb Yankel Katz, was a major supporter of Chabad in America, whom the Rebbe termed, “a
good friend.”

702098.title: The Moment Exile Began
702098.description: The exile started with a single event, and the children have the power to end it.

702099.title: “We Want Moshiach Now”
702099.description:
Chassidim sing a tune of the Rebbe’s underground Chassidim in Russia to the words “We Want
Moshiach Now.”

702100.title: Defensive Driving
702100.description: For protection on the road, every car should have in it a few holy books and a charity box.

702101.title: Consistency
702101.description:
Rabbi Ephraim Sturm served as Executive Vice President and Chief Executive Officer of the
National Council of Young Israel from 1956 to 1992. In the early 1960s, he read an alarming
statistic about the assimilation rate of Jewish Orthodox students in American colleges.

712298.title: Ad Mosai? Until When?
712298.description:
Concerning the future Redemption, the prophet declares, “I will offer thanks to You, G-d, for
Your wrath,” for at that time, the good hidden in all mankind’s suffering will be made clear.

712300.title: Seek the Positive
712300.description:
It is not appropriate for a Jew to wish the nations of the world un-well, by threatening them
with Divine retribution. A Jew must emphasize only the positive: the great blessings G-d will
bestow upon them for allowing Jews to live in peace.

712301.title: Millions of Hostages
712301.description:
Mr. Bentzion Rader shares a private audience he and his wife had with the Rebbe, at which
they discussed the Rebbe's views about Aliyah and demonstrations for Soviet Jewry.

712304.title: “Levi Yitzchak”
712304.description:
An address to the campers of Gan Israel New York, on the Yahrzeit of the Rebbe’s father,
Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson:
The primary purpose of my father’s self-sacrifice was the education of Jewish children under
communist oppression.

712305.title: “Reb Levik’s Niggun”
712305.description:
Chassidim sing a favorite Niggun of the Rebbe’s father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson, of
righteous memory.

712306.title: Family Acquaintances
712306.description:
A Jew from Yekatrinaslov visits the Rebbe. His father was a Shochet for the Rebbe's father
and was arrested and exiled by the communists along with him.
An elderly Jew visits the Rebbe. As a child, he assisted the Rebbe's parents during their exile
in Kazakhstan.

712307.title: Change of Plan
712307.description:
Rabbi Moshe Herson is Head Shliach of the State of New Jersey. As a student at 770 from
1955 to 1959, he would spend his summers visiting remote Jewish communities.

712309.title: Universal Mission
712309.description:
“G-d did not create the world for there to be chaos, but for peaceful civilization.” This unified
purpose for mankind lies at the heart of the Seven Noahide Laws, which preceded even the
Giving of the Torah.

712310.title: Farbrengen
712310.description:
Special footage of a Farbrengen at 770 on the 94th Yahrzeit of Rabbi Shmuel of Lubavitch,
the Rebbe Maharash.

712311.title: The Path of the Righteous Gentile
712311.description:
Senator Luis Alberto Lacalle de Herrera of Uruguay visits the Rebbe during his presidential
campaign:
May G-d Almighty bless you to have good news, and to use your influence for the benefit of
many. Give this dollar to charity, a commandment accepted by all the people of the world.
path: The Path of the Righteous Gentile

712312.title: Jewish Science
712312.description:
In 1961, Dr. Velvel Greene joined NASA’s Exobiology program. He had his first private
audience with the Rebbe in the mid-1960s.

712314.title: Education: Sensitivity without Compromise
712314.description:
It is rare for all students of one age group to be on the same academic level in their learning.
Dividing the students into smaller classes - one more advanced than the other - creates a
healthy incentive for all the students to grow.

712315.title: “Kesivah V’Chasimah Tovah”
712315.description: The Rebbe distributes dollars at his home on President Street, a week before Rosh Hashanah.

712316.title: To Be a Chassid
712316.description:
If, as you say, you believe in a Rebbe’s power, then be a Chassid. And see to it that your
children are Chassidim as well. Much success!

712317.title: Jewish Science
712317.description:
Dr. Velvel Greene worked in NASA’s Exobiology program searching for life on Mars. He
continues the account of his first private audience with the Rebbe in the mid-1960s.

724781.title: A Month to Prepare
724781.description:
Throughout the month of Elul, the Jewish people has a collective task: to prepare itself to be
inscribed and sealed for a good and sweet year. Indeed, there is a Jewish custom to wear
white on Rosh Hashanah eve, to express the certainty that all will be inscribed in the Book of
the Righteous. Clearly, then, the preparation for this must also be with unity.

724782.title: Nigun “Sholosh Tenuos”
724782.description:
Chassidim sing the “Nigun of Three Stanzas.” The Baal Shem Tov, the Maggid of Mezritch and
the Alter Rebbe each composed one stanza of this meditative song.

724783.title: Commissioned Articles
724783.description:
Mr. Shaul Schiff of the Israeli “Hatzofeh” neswpaper visits the Rebbe:
The impression I get from your recent writing is that your work is not decreasing, G-d forbid,
but is also not increasing. You must double your achievements! This dollar is not a bribe for
you to write more about me, but to write more on all the other Jewish matters...

724784.title: A Guarantee and a Miracle
724784.description:
Mr. Joe Cayre and his brothers founded Good Times Home Video. He shares an episode
involving himself and one of his brothers.

724786.title: Why We Say Selichot
724786.description:
The Midrash relates that when Moses foresaw that the Holy Temple would be destroyed and
Jews would be unable to offer sacrifices in atonement, he asked G-d: “What will we do
then?” G-d replied: “Jews should gather as one group to recite Selichos, and I will pardon
them.”

724787.title: Maamar
724787.description: The Rebbe delivers a Chassidic discourse.

724788.title: The Chassidic Brotherhood: Lubavitch and Ger
724788.description: Prominent Gerer Chassidim visit the Rebbe.
path: The Chassidic Brotherhood: Lubavitch and Ger

724789.title: Rabbi Engineer
724789.description:
Mr. Yaakov Hardof is an electrical engineer, and founder of Amperon Electronics and
Soundsystems and Interconcept Incorporated. In 1957, he spent close to two hours with the
Rebbe discussing... engineering!

724791.title: The Beinoni
724791.description:
Tanya opens with a Talmudic passage: “Every Jew, before he is born, is administered an oath:
‘Be righteous, and be not wicked’” -- if it is not possible for you to achieve the level of the
righteous, at least do not be wicked; be a ‘Beinoni - intermediate.’ This is followed by an
extensive discussion defining the spiritual level and service of the Beinoni - that “he has never
sinned, and never will sin…”

724792.title: The Selichot Prayers
724792.description: Selichos at 770 on the morning before Rosh Hashanah.

724793.title: Giving and Receiving
724793.description:
The Biala Rebbe, Rabbi Yaakov Yitzchok Rabinowicz, visits the Rebbe:
We mustn’t “find excuses” for G-d when Jews have difficulties with their livelihood. Beseech
- and demand - that He help. If Jews give charity before prayer, it will bring all good things.

724794.title: Rabbi Engineer
724794.description:
Mr. Yaakov Hardof continues the account of his 1957 audience with the Rebbe, when the
Rebbe asked him to explain an engineering breakthrough of the time: the transistor.

724796.title: Divine Service on Two Fronts
724796.description:
Our Forefather Isaac never stepped foot outside the Land of Israel. His life was spent in the
Land where all G-d’s blessings converge and radiate to the rest of the world.
Joseph, on the other hand, faced material and spiritual challenges in Egypt. But despite all
odds, he became ruler of the empire.
The life of every Jew reflects both the life of Isaac and the life of Joseph.

724797.title: Nigun “U’vyom Simchaschem”
724797.description:
The Rebbe instructs Chassidim to sing the verse: “On the days of your rejoicing, on your
Festivals and on Rosh Chodesh, you shall blow the trumpets for your ascent-offerings and your
peace sacrifices, and it shall be a remembrance before your G-d.” (Numbers 10:10)

724798.title: Torah Businessman
724798.description:
Instead of devoting all your time to Torah study and helping your Shliach, continue your
business also. You will then show an example of a successful businessman who has set times
for Torah study every day - and is happy about it!

724799.title: Fatherly Concern
724799.description:
Mrs. Esther Goldman shares a heartwarming story of the Rebbe’s concern for a young
expecting mother.

748959.title: The Art of Sublime Needlework
748959.description:
Mishna, Tractate Mikvaos: If a needle is placed on the step leading down to a Mikva, and a
person passes a wave over the needle; the needle becomes ritually pure.
A needle is used to stitch two fabrics together to create a garment. Spiritually speaking, the
task of every Jew is to connect — to sew — physicality to G-dliness.

748960.title: Selichos
748960.description: Selichos at 770 in the week before Rosh Hashanah.

748961.title: “Roll-over” Blessings
748961.description:
All Jews should have a good and complete year. You should have two-in-one, to compensate
for last year, which was lacking… When a Jew receives material blessing from G-d, he gives
back spirituality to G-d, through charity.

748962.title: To Honor His Mother
748962.description:
In 1960, Rabbi Yosef Wineberg began to deliver Tanya lessons over the radio in New York. The
Rebbe's mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson, was fond of his broadcasts. When she passed
away in 1964, he asked the Rebbe for permission to honor her memory in a special way...

748964.title: Hakhel Is for Children Too
748964.description:
An address to children on Sukkos in the year of Hakhel:
During the year of Hakhel, Jews make every effort to assemble together. Jewish children are
specifically included in this Mitzvah in the Torah, and you must serve as an example to others.
Even though the Holy Temple is not yet rebuilt, you must prepare yourselves in similar fashion,
gathering to hear words of Torah and resolving to implement Torah's teachings.

748965.title: Lekach
748965.description: The Rebbe distributes “Lekach,” honey cake, on the eve of Yom Kippur.

748966.title: You Only Need to Want It
748966.description:
Chief Rabbi of Tel Aviv, Rabbi Yisrael Meir Lau, visits the Rebbe:
Take advantage of your time as Chief Rabbi of Tel Aviv; I hear that you will become Chief
Rabbi of Israel within the next two years. If I can convince you that it’s for you, it will most
probably materialize — but you have to truly want it.
path: You Only Need to Want It

748967.title: The Story Behind the Story
748967.description:
Rabbi Yisroel Meir Lau tells the “story behind the story” of the Rebbe’s foresight regarding
his position in Israel’s Chief Rabbinate.

748969.title: Three Pillars
748969.description:
In discussing the essence of prayer, Maimonides explains that whenever a Jew is in need of
anything, he is obligated to pray. But what gives a human the right to ask and expect his
needs from G-d?

748970.title: Motzaei Simchas Torah
748970.description: A collage celebrating Motzaei Simchas Torah with the Rebbe.

748971.title: Torah and Charity, Inseparable
748971.description:
In addition to all the tremendous charitable work you do, you must have set times for Torah
study, because charity and Torah study go hand-in-hand.

748972.title: Entry Exam
748972.description:
Rabbi Chaim Nachman Kovalsky was a student of Rabbi Yechiel Yaakov Weinberg, author of
the Halachic responsa, Sridei Eish. He shares a story he heard from Rabbi Weinberg about the
Rebbe in Berlin.

748974.title: When Do the Good Times Start?
748974.description:
"G-d placed Adam in the Garden of Eden to work and protect it." The Talmud explains that
toil is not a consequence of sin, but rather G-d's original intention for mankind.
path: When Do the Good Times Start?

748975.title: “Nyeh Zhuritsi Chlopsi”
748975.description:
Sung by Chassidim as they traveled to the town of Lubavitch to visit the Mittler Rebbe, the
words of this Nigun allude to their hopeful yearnings: When they reach the Rebbe, they will
drink from “the well of Torah and Chassidism,” and lack nothing.

748976.title: Don't Wait for Me
748976.description:
This dollar is a small amount, but it symbolizes a much larger sum. On every dollar is written,
“In G-d We Trust.” All of us will trust in G-d Almighty, and He will help us realize and “cash in”
all this trust. You are able to do your activities more than I, and you can sometimes advance
much more — or much better — than I can.

748977.title: Science and Faith
748977.description:
In 1950, Rabbi Yehuda Leib Posner was a student at 770. He received some coaching from the
Rebbe on how to approach the topic of “science and faith.”

759715.title: Don't Wait for the Committee!
759715.description: A person is allotted time on this planet appropriate to his life-mission.

759716.title: Visit by Israel’s Chief Rabbi
759716.description: Sefardic Chief Rabbi Mordechai Eliyahu visits the Rebbe.

759717.title: Yeshiva: True Jewish “Settlement”
759717.description:
Rabbi Amnon Sugarman, Rosh Yeshiva of Yeshivat Hesder of the Golan Heights, visits the
Rebbe:
Much success in studying G-d’s Torah and applying His law, including that the Land of Israel
belongs to the Jewish People. The main thing is that your Yeshiva be enduring, as the word
“Yeshiva — settlement” implies.

759718.title: Leaving Paris
759718.description:
Rabbi Sholom Ber Levine shares the account of the Rebbe and Rebbetzin’s departure from Paris,
as told to him by the Rebbetzin herself.

759720.title: A Match Made in Heaven—and on Earth
759720.description: After his binding on the altar, Isaac was considered “a pure offering,” never to leave the Holy Land; Rebecca, by contrast, was born of the Diaspora, “a rose among the thorns.” She was to be brought up to the Land of Israel to be united with Isaac.
path: A Match Made in Heaven—and on Earth

759721.title: Nigun “Ach Tzaddikim”
759721.description: “Indeed, the righteous will extol Your Name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.”

759722.title: G-d Believes in Israel
759722.description:
G-d places free choice in the hands of Israel’s Jews to choose a course of action, because He
believes in the Jewish People that ultimately they will choose the path of Torah. Then the
Torah, the People and the Land will all be complete.

759723.title: To Save a Life
759723.description:
Mendel Notik worked in the Rebbe and Rebbetzin’s household during the 1970s. He shares a
story he heard from the Rebbetzin about a “campaign” of the Rebbe to save Jews in Nazioccupied
France.

759725.title: To be Near, Move Far
759725.description:
My father-in-law, the Rebbe endeavored to disseminate Torah and Mitzvos to even the most
remote corners of the earth. But if one could benefit more Jews closer to home, why invest
so much effort to reach one single Jew or one Jewish family?

759726.title: Highlights of Kinus Hashluchim 5748
759726.description: Highlights from the 1987 International Conference of Shluchim with the Rebbe.

759727.title: Embrace Your Chassidic Heritage
759727.description: Don’t rely on the fact that your grandfather was a Chassid; you should be a Chassid as well!

759728.title: The Rebbe Insisted on Registering as a Jew
