759728.description: Rabbi Menachem Tiechtel was a refugee in Southern France during the Nazi occupation. He shares a story about the Rebbe that he learned during that time.
path: The Rebbe Insisted on Registering as a Jew

759730.title: Make Like a Tree, and Grow!
759730.description:
“Man is a tree of the field.” The Sages of the Talmud apply this verse to the Jew. Torah is the
core of a Jew’s being, and Torah must effect his actions so that he bears good fruits — good
deeds. But when we say that a Jew must be “fruitful,” first and foremost he must reproduce
his own essence.
path: Make Like a Tree, and Grow!

759731.title: Nigun “Uforatzta”
759731.description:
From G-d’s blessing to Jacob, “And you shall spread forth to the west, to the east, to the north
and to the south.”
These words became a slogan for the Rebbe’s call to reach every Jew, wherever he may be.

759732.title: To Build, or not to Build?
759732.description: The Rebbe advises individuals in their synagogue building projects.
path: To Build, or not to Build?

759733.title: First Farbrengen at 770
759733.description:
Rabbis Dovid Edelman, Hershel Fogelman and Yehuda Leib Posner were students at 770 in
1941. They describe the first Farbrengen the Rebbe held after arriving safely to America from
war-torn Europe.

779153.title: Twilight
779153.description:
Now that we stand two weeks before Chanukah, it is time to raise some points as to the
nature of the Chanukah campaign:
The Chanukah Menorah is kindled at twilight. “Twilight” represents a dual state: on the one
hand, there is darkness; but at the same time, the sun is still fully there, albeit obstructed.

779154.title: Farbrengen
779154.description: Vintage footage of the Rebbe’s Yud Tes Kislev Farbrengen in 1965.

779155.title: Protecting the Beauty of the Jewish Woman
779155.description:
Much success in forming a Jewish choir. Make it clear that it is a mens’ and boys’ choir.
Explain that Torah maintains that a woman’s voice is an expression of her beauty; in order to
protect that her beauty not be "free for all," the choir is being organized in this way.
path: Protecting the Beauty of the Jewish Woman

779156.title: Rationalist Acting Above Reason
779156.description:
Dr. Yitzchak Block is Emeritus Professor of Philosophy at the University of Western Ontario.
Upon the Rebbe’s instructions, he disregarded his desire to avoid academic conferences. One
time, however, the Rebbe seemed to go too far...

779158.title: Second Impressions
779158.description:
The Talmud asks: “How does one sing the bride's praises to the groom? The House of
Shammai holds: Describe her as you see her” — praise her beauty only if she is beautiful…
“The House of Hillel holds: Always say, ‘what a beautiful and graceful bride!’”

779159.title: Nigun “Samach T’Samach”
779159.description:
“Grant abundant joy to these loving friends, as You bestowed gladness upon Your created
being in the Garden of Eden of old.” (From the Seven Blessings for a Wedding Feast)

779160.title: Crown Heights Memories
779160.description:
New York City Police Commissioner Benjamin Ward visits the Rebbe
Your name, Benjamin, in Hebrew means “son at my right side.” May G-d bless you to always
be on the right side — and to use it to full capacity.

779161.title: The Rebbe Taught a Young Woman the Meaning of Love
779161.description: Mrs. Chana Sharfstein recalls one of her first private audiences with the Rebbe, as a young woman in her early twenties, when the Rebbe asked her about her prospects for marriage (1954).
path: The Rebbe Taught a Young Woman the Meaning of Love

779163.title: Exile + 1 = Redemption
779163.description:
Hebrew, the Holy Tongue, is utterly precise. In Hebrew, “Exile” is called “Golah.” But this very
word also hints the path to redemption. By inserting the letter Alef, the word “Golah — Exile”
becomes “Geulah — Redemption.”

779164.title: Nigun “Daled Bavos”
779164.description: Chassidim sing the Alter Rebbe’s “Nigun of Four Stanzas.”

779165.title: A Rabbinic Tradition
779165.description:
You come from a long line of rabbis, so don’t change the family tradition. Become a rabbi
without giving up your current livelihood.

779166.title: Not Quite What the Doctor Ordered
779166.description:
On the night of Shemini Atzeres, 1977, the Rebbe suffered a heart attack during the Hakafos
celebration. Dr. Ira Weiss was part of the medical team that treated the Rebbe at 770 over
the next month and a half. He recalls the Rebbe’s first Farbrengen following the heart attack.
path: Not Quite What the Doctor Ordered

779168.title: Minority Rules
779168.description:
When a Jew celebrates Chanukah, he may be confronted: “You Jews are so few compared to
the nations of the world. Yet you hold fast to your customs and commandments, ignoring what
the billions of non-Jews around you think and do… Wherein lies your strength to stand in the
face of such odds?”

779169.title: Chanukah Rally
779169.description: Children’s rally at 770 on the last night of Chanukah, 1987.

779170.title: What Comes First: The Money or the Pledge?
779170.description:
Although you only pledged a quarter million dollars to charity, don’t be afraid to commit to half
a million. G-d can make you wealthier. “Toil, and you will succeed.”
path: What Comes First: The Money or the Pledge?

779171.title: Making Aliyah: a Multifaceted Decision
779171.description:
In the early 1970s, Mr. Peter Kalms planned to move his family from England to Israel. Before
making the move, he visited the Rebbe to receive his blessing.

796358.title: The Tzaddik Lives
796358.description:
The Talmud states about our forefather, Jacob: “As long as his children are alive, he, too, is
alive.” When we live the teachings and mission of the Rebbe, our bond to him becomes everstronger,
and in the words of the Talmud, “he too, is alive.”

796359.title: “L’chaim”
796359.description: The Rebbe distributes bottles of L’chaim for Jewish communities in the Land of Israel.

796360.title: Keep the Presses Rolling!
796360.description:
The Torah commentary you are publishing must be a complete set. A Torah scroll is invalid
unless it has every verse from the beginning to the end. Your commentary should follow the
example of the Written Torah.

796361.title: A Gentleman and a Scholar
796361.description:
In 1947, the Rebbe flew to Paris to escort his mother to the United States after her escape
from the Soviet Union. While there, he visited a small Yeshiva outside Paris where Rabbi Yaakov
Holtzman was a student. Later, in New York, he worked in the Rebbe’s household.

796399.title: “Jacob Our Father Never Died”
796399.description:
The Talmud states: “Our forefather Jacob never died. From where do we know this? From the
verse: ‘Fear not, Jacob… for I will save you from afar and your seed from their captivity’ —
just as his seed is alive, he too, is alive.” But why only Jacob? Don’t Abraham and Isaac live
forever as well?

796400.title: Niggun “Rachamana”
796400.description:
“May the Merciful One, Who answers the poor, answer us. May the Merciful One, Who
answers the broken-hearted, answer us. (From the Selichos liturgy)

796401.title: Jewish Land, Jewish Observance
796401.description:
The Arabs’ desecration of the Temple Mount has been going on already for decades. The Jews
in Israel must stop standing by watching idly. They must re-focus their attention on what is
most important: the Jewishness of the Jewish Land.

796402.title: Choosing a Thesis
796402.description:
Dr. Susan Handelman is Professor of English Literature at Bar Ilan University in Israel. Trying
to decide on a topic for her doctoral thesis, she decided to ask the Rebbe’s opinion.

796404.title: The Responsibility of Freedom
796404.description:
After over fifty years of persecution, Soviet Jews have come out whole in their Judaism and
with children following in their ways. Having served G-d with such sacrifice for over a halfcentury,
one might argue that they have done their fair share — now it’s time to relax a bit…

796405.title: President Street
796405.description: The Rebbe speaks with photographer Levi Freidin outside his house on President Street.

796406.title: A Charity Organization with Money?
796406.description:
The fact that your oganization has financial challenges is a good sign. It proves that yours is
a worthy cause that devotes all resources toward its mission.

796407.title: The Bottom Line
796407.description:
Rabbi Shimon Goldman's father-in-law, Rabbi Yochanan Gordon, was head of the Gemillas
Chesed Shomrei Shabbos interest-free loan fund for over twenty years. The Rebbe sets a high
bar for how to measure the fund’s success.

796409.title: Maimonides - Not for Scholars Only
796409.description:
All Jews should unite through Torah, by studying the same subject in Torah at the same time.
Since Torah's practical laws are relevant and comprehensible by Jews of all backgrounds, we
suggested a cycle of daily study of Maimonides’ Mishneh Torah.

796410.title: Niggun “Yeilchu Mechayil”
796410.description:
“They go from strength to strength; they will appear before G-d in Zion. See our shield, O G-d,
and look upon the face of Your anointed one.” (Psalms 84:8,10)
This Niggun was composed in honor of the Rebbe’s 83rd birthday.

796411.title: Letter of Approbation
796411.description:
Thank you for the volume of Mishneh Torah. I don’t issue letters of approbation, because I
would be filling requests all day long... Reprint the blessing I sent you for an earlier volume.

796412.title: No Questions Asked
796412.description: Rabbi Mordechai Ashkenazi shares a personal audience with the Rebbe, where an answer was given to a question had, but not asked.

818257.title: How One Little Candle Changed a Family
818257.description:
The Shabbos candle lighting campaign has yielded far-reaching results. One example from the
many reports we received: A little girl, five or six years old, attended a non-religious school in
Israel. One day, an older girl spoke to her class about the Mitzvah of Shabbos candles. She
taught them the blessings, and gave them candles and candlesticks to take home.
path: How One Little Candle Changed a Family

818259.title: Every Mitzvah is Precious
818259.description:
Every Mitzvah a person performs is a “favor” for G-d, so to speak. Although your father is
upset that he is not well enough to observe certain obligations, emphasize to him that all the
possible good things of this world do not match even one favor he is able to do for G-d.

818260.title: “You’ll be Asking Him Soon…”
818260.description:
Dr. David Luchins’ father, Dr. Abraham Luchins, was a renowned psychologist and an admirer
of the Previous Rebbe, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch. In a private audience, he learned
that the Previous Rebbe was also an “admirer” — of a certain Rebbe-to-be.

818264.title: “To Listen to Me?”
818264.description:
The Alter Rebbe once opened the window and saw a large crowd assembling, expecting a
Farbrengen. He shut the window and wanted to hide. His wife, Rebbetzin Sterna, asked what
was the matter. “A large crowd is gathering! What do they want from me? What do I have
to offer them?” The Rebbetzin responded, “They want to know what you heard from your
Rebbe.” “In that case,” the Alter Rebbe exclaimed, “I will teach them and teach them…”

818265.title: Shacharis
818265.description:
The Rebbe leads the Morning Prayers at 770, on the Yahrzeit of his father-in-law and
predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

818266.title: 40 Years
818266.description:
A collage celebrating Yud Shevat 5750 — 1990, 40th anniversary of the Rebbe’s leadership
of the Chabad-Lubavitch Movement

818267.title: Love that Knows No Barriers
818267.description:
Rabbi Dovid Edelman was a student at 770 during the 1940s. One night, the Rebbe came out
from the study of his father-in-law, the Previous Rebbe, with a fundamental lesson in loving
one’s fellow Jew.

818269.title: Master of the Home Front
818269.description:
Before they entered the Land of Israel, Moses instructed the Jewish People regarding
Shemitah, the Sabbatical Year. He did not preface with instructions regarding the six years
of work, because the purpose of having Israel was not to work the land, but to reach the
blessings of the seventh year, when the Jews could devote themselves to educating their
children in Torah.

818270.title: Kinus Hashluchos
818270.description: The Rebbe participates in the annual International Conference of Shluchos.

818271.title: Lectures on Family Purity, Be Prepared
818271.description:
Consult the counselors of the Lubavitch Women’s Organization for how to get through to
women about the Mitzvah of Family Purity. They arrange lectures on this subject, so they
know the questions people ask and the appropriate ways to answer them.
path: Lectures on Family Purity, Be Prepared

818272.title: "They're Going to Listen to You…"
818272.description: Mrs. Rochel Fogelman and her husband have been Shluchim in Worcester, Massachusetts since 1947. As one of her outreach activities, she would give book reviews for Jewish women’s groups. (1967)

818274.title: An End to Tears
818274.description:
The Baal Shem Tov teaches that with everything a Jew experiences, he must contemplate
what he must learn from it. How much more so when a person loses a loved one, when the
verse itself instructs, “The living shall take to heart.“

818275.title: Kos Shel Brachah
818275.description: Chassidim sing a lively Nigun as the Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing.

818276.title: Peace and Justice
818276.description:
Judge Joseph Fisch visits the Rebbe:
May G-d help you to judge all people justly, and may all your judgments be preventative — not
to punish, but rather to prevent wrongdoing.

818277.title: Motherly Guidance
818277.description:
Mrs. Hadassa Carlebach is an extended cousin of the Rebbe and Rebbetzin. When she arrived
in New York in 1947, they were her only family there.

839497.title: Why Was Gold Created?
839497.description:
An address on the Previous Rebbe's 100th birthday anniversary:
The Midrash teaches that G-d created gold only for the Holy Temple. Why, then, did He place
gold all over the world, where it can also be used for mundane purposes? Similarly, why did
G-d allow His Torah to be lowered from its loftiest heights, to the point that even someone
who seeks to misuse it, can comprehend it?

839499.title: Presidential Move
839499.description:
If Moshiach doesn’t arrive by the time your organization has new elections, may you have a
good president in the Diaspora. When Moshiach does come, the entire organization — including
the president — will relocate to the Holy Land.

839500.title: Month of Good Mazel
839500.description:
Dr. Yaakov Hanoka is a renowned scientist. In 1970, the Rebbe’s advice helped him get “top
dollar” when he had to sell his house.

839502.title: From Riches to Rags
839502.description:
Billionaire Howard Hughes recently passed away. Here was a man who could have done
anything his heart desired. But what kind of a life did he live? Anywhere he wanted to go, he
was afraid of being attacked. Anytime he wanted to eat, he was afraid of being poisoned; if
he wanted to travel, it had to be in secret; even his own aides he suspected of being bribed…
In plain words: His two billion dollars granted him no freedom whatsoever; they made him the
most miserable slave imaginable.

839503.title: Dollars to Children
839503.description: The Rebbe distributes dollars exclusively to children under the age of Bar and Bat Mitzvah.

839504.title: Our Fellow Sailors
839504.description:
A member of the Israeli Navy visits the Rebbe:
The tribe of Zebulun were sailors, while Issachar’s occupation was Torah. But they looked
after each other’s welfare. Since I’m also occupied with Torah, I’m interested in what occurs
with “Zebulun.” Every naval vessel should have a charity box for protection.

839505.title: Directions
839505.description:
Rabbi Avrohom Pinter’s family moved to Crown Heights in the mid-1950s. When his European
grandparents came to visit, they asked for directions from a “simple Jew” who happened to
be passing by on the sidewalk.

839507.title: The Power of Children
839507.description:
Mordechai gathered thousands of Jewish children to study Torah and pray to G-d to save the
Jews from annihilation. Only when the innocent voices of the children ascended On High, did
the Almighty annul the decree and replace it with the opposite — boundless joy.

839508.title: Purim Nigun
839508.description: A Chassidic Nigun traditionally sung to the opening verse of the Purim Megilah.

839509.title: Visit Israel!
839509.description:
You must publicize that you are visiting Israel, because there are Jews who are scared, and
scaring others, about going to Israel. Publicize your trip, and that there’s nothing to fear,
because it is the safest place — the place of the Holy Temple.

839510.title: Tax Advice
839510.description:
Mr. Bentzion Rader was a practicing chartered accountant in London, England for almost
forty years. One time, the Rebbe recommended against the tax advice Mr. Rader had given
to a major philanthropist in England.

839512.title: How You Can Help Others with Passover Needs
839512.description:
The obligations of the month of Nissan already begin thirty days before Passover, when
Jewish communities begin to collect for those in need “wheat money” for the Matzos. This
fund enables them to have the three Matzos required when recounting the story of the Exodus
on Passover Eve.
path: How You Can Help Others with Passover Needs

839513.title: Leaving the Synagogue
839513.description:
After meeting with supporters of the Machne Israel Development Fund in the main synagogue
at 770, the Rebbe requests that the dividers be moved so he can see the Ark before leaving
the sanctuary.

839515.title: “What Do You Mean You’re Stopping?”
839515.description:
Mr. Shimshon Stock was head of a Crown Heights charity fund, “Chevras Simchas Shabbos
V’Yom Tov” for 30 years. He recalls how it all started...

858581.title: Kosher Meditation

858582.title: Mayim Shelanu
858582.description: The Rebbe draws water from a spring in front of 770, to be used to bake Passover Matzos.

858583.title: Maimonides: Father Figure
858583.description:
From Maimonides’ Laws of Personal Conduct one can understand what true Nachas is. Teach
those laws to your son, and may you have true Nachas from him.

858584.title: “Quiet, Please!”
858584.description:
Rabbi Yisroel Gordon was a student at 770 during the 1940s. One time, the Rebbe came down
from his father-in-law, the Previous Rebbe, with a message “all the way from the top.”

858587.title: Today’s Front: Outreach
858587.description:
From the very beginnings of the Chassidic Movement, select students of the Baal Shem Tov
and the Maggid were entrusted with the task to “disseminate the wellsprings of Chassidism
to the outside.” Especially after the Alter Rebbe’s release from prison in 1798, the teachings
of Chassidus were spread far and wide.

858589.title: For Your Birthday
858589.description: A collage of well-wishers greeting the Rebbe upon his birthday. (Collage)

858590.title: See No Evil
858590.description:
Rabbi Moshe Feller is the Head Shliach of Minnesota. In 1972, he invited bestselling author
Herman Wouk to speak at his dinner in honor of the Rebbe’s 70th birthday.

858592.title: Birchas Hachama: Blessing of the Sun
858592.description:
“The Lord G-d is a sun and a shield.” “The Jewish people are likened to the moon.” The union
between man and G-d is formed when a person makes himself a “small luminary,” a reflection
of G-d.
path: Birchas Hachama: Blessing of the Sun

858593.title: Birchas Hachama
858593.description: Birchas Hachama — the Blessing of the Sun at 770 in 1981.

858594.title: Matza Therapy
858594.description:
New York City Deputy Commissioner of Corrections Arthur Sinai visits the Rebbe:
You used the Matza I sent you in a good place and a good time — Passover. Passover is
connected with correction, and to be rid of all worries. May G-d Almighty bless you to be rid
of all worries until now.

858595.title: “Don’t Worry, He’s Coming”
858595.description:
Mr. Freddy Hager lives in London, England. One year, he made an unexpected stop at 770 on
his way to the airport to return to England. It soon became clear that his visit was not
entirely unexpected after all.

858597.title: Why is this Nation Different from All Other Nations?
858597.description:
Every Jew descends from those Jews who were enslaved in Egypt. When G-d freed them, He
freed all Jews of all future generations, including each and every one of us.
path: Why is this Nation Different from All Other Nations?

858598.title: Nigun “Al Achas”
858598.description:
“...How much more so should we be grateful to the Omnipresent One for the doubled and
redoubled goodness that He has bestowed upon us...” (From the Passover Haggadah)

858599.title: Guide the Soldiers
858599.description:
United States Air Force Chaplain Col. Brett Oxman visits the Rebbe:
May G-d Almighty bless you and all the chaplains to go from strength to strength, and to guide
the soldiers in the right way. Please keep me informed when you have additional news.

858600.title: Proud Father-in-Law, Proud Son-in-Law
858600.description:
Rabbi Mendel Feldman was a student at 770 during the 1940s. He recalls some of the mutual
admiration he was privy to witness between the Previous Rebbe and the Rebbe.

878366.title: Fun and Kosher
878366.description:
Today it has become popular to accompany educational materials with illustrations, including
depictions of animals. In such cases, it is appropriate to use pictures of only Kosher animals.
Similarly, when a child is given an animal toy, it should resemble a Kosher animal.

878367.title: Kos Shel Brachah, Hakhel
878367.description:
The Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing.
“Much success in fulfilling the special mission of this year of Hakhel — to gather and unite
every Jewish man, woman and child.”

878368.title: An Emissary to the Citizens of Poland
878368.description: Mr. David Chase visits the Rebbe before visiting Poland. "Spread good news to both Jews and non-Jews, for a Jew is obliged to benefit all people. Don't underestimate your appointment — I appointed you long ago as my Four Star General."
path: An Emissary to the Citizens of Poland

878369.title: Faith is Contagious
878369.description:
Mr. David Chase shares how one little request from the Rebbe changed his entire life — and
the lives of others.

878371.title: Ask Not What G-d Can Do For You…
878371.description:
Torah teaches that the whole world was created for the sake of the Jewish People’s service
of G-d. President Kennedy’s recent establishment of the US Peace Corps serves as a reminder
of a similar call that has been made here…
path: Ask Not What G-d Can Do For You…

878372.title: Dancing in Front of 770
878372.description: The Rebbe encourages Chassidim as they dance in front of 770.

878373.title: Full Jew
878373.description:
A recent Jewish convert visits the Rebbe:
May G-d Almighty bless you to always have good news to report about yourself, about all
your family and about all the Jews of your city. May you have a long happy life as a full Jew.

878374.title: Welcome Home
878374.description:
In the early 1970s, upon the Rebbe’s instruction, Rabbi Laibl Wolf worked as Hillel Rabbi at
the University of Wisconsin-Madison. After encountering many non-Jewish students who
were curious about Judaism and wished to convert, he approached the Rebbe for advice.

878376.title: Second Chances
878376.description:
The lesson derived from Pesach Sheni is: “It is never too late.” Even if one was “impure,” or
on “a distant path”—his situation is not “lost.”

878377.title: Sefiras Ha’omer
878377.description: The Rebbe leads Evening Prayers and the Counting of the Omer on Lag B’omer Eve.

878378.title: Position of Responsibility
878378.description:
Knesset Member Rabbi Eliezer Waldman visits the Rebbe:
If your replacement in the Knesset will be as good as you, then you may leave... But if not,
you have a responsibility to every Jew in Israel to stay on there with even stronger resilience.

878379.title: A Life and Death Matter
878379.description:
On the 13th of Iyar, 1952, the Rebbe’s brother, Reb Yisroel Aryeh Leib, passed away in
England at the age of 42. The Rebbe enlisted Reb Berel Junik in the effort to shield his elderly
mother from the tragic, and potentially devastating, news.

878381.title: Summer Job
878381.description:
The Talmud states: “Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai's sole occupation was Torah.” Rabbi Shimon
was involved with other matters as well, but what was his “occupation”? How was he raised,
how did he raise his students — and how does he raise each one of us who wish to learn from
him? That a Jew’s occupation is Torah.

878382.title: Lag B’omer Parade
878382.description: The Rebbe participates in the 1983 Lag B’omer parade.

878383.title: Education Path
878383.description:
The Rebbe guides young men facing the decision between study at a Yeshiva versus secular
pursuits.

878384.title: Department of Military Intelligence
878384.description:
Mr. Aaron Noach Blasbalg was a member of the board of Poalei Agudat Israel for 25 years. He
recalls a fascinating private audience he and his colleagues had with the Rebbe.

895676.title: Heartbeat of the Family
895676.description:
The success of our people’s mission rests on the Jewish woman. She engages her husband
and children in what they learn and accomplish each day, thereby preparing them for a future
of Torah.

895677.title: Maamar
895677.description: On the day before Shavuos, the Rebbe delivers a Chassidic discourse from his lectern.

895678.title: Hand in Hand
895678.description:
Be more than a help to your Shliach; be his partner.
Your daughter is a Shliach too! She is a good example to all the other children in your camp.

895679.title: A Parent Feels
895679.description:
In 1973, Rabbi Shmuel Kaplan was called upon by the Rebbe to help a teenager at risk. He
shares a touching letter that the youth received from the Rebbe.

895681.title: …Nothing But the Truth, So Help You G-d
895681.description:
Torah is eternal. “Eternal,” by definition, means that at all times and in all places, everything
stated in Torah is true. The Jerusalem Talmud points out that in Hebrew the word ‘Emes —
Truth’ is spelled: Alef-Mem-Tof — Alef is the first letter of the alphabet, Tof is the last letter
of the alphabet, and Mem is the middle letter. This signifies that truth is that which is
consistent from beginning to end without compromise.
path: …Nothing But the Truth, So Help You G-d

895682.title: Kos Shel Brachah
895682.description: On the night after Shavuos, the Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing.

895683.title: Security Reigns Supreme
895683.description:
The Code of Jewish Law rules that it is forbidden to endanger the Jewish nation by giving
away Jewish land. When I urge people in Israel to support a certain political party, it is only
because that party has currently decided to proceed in line with this ruling.

895684.title: “Don’t Tell”
895684.description:
After his marriage, Rabbi Shmuel Lew was studying at the Rebbe’s Kolel for newly married
men, adjacent to 770. It was not until decades later that he discovered who offered to fund
his full-time Torah study while he started a family.

895687.title: The Secret Power of the Nazirite
895687.description:
What is the concept of a “vow” in Jewish law? A person takes an ordinary object, and Torah
tells him: since you are a Jew, G-d gives you the power to connect that which is mundane
with the sacred.
path: The Secret Power of the Nazirite

895688.title: Aliyah
895688.description: The Rebbe is called to the Torah in the upstairs synagogue at 770.

895689.title: Pass It On
895689.description:
Regarding my student’s statement that he gets his spiritual fortitude from me — I merely
pass along what G-d says in His Torah.

895690.title: To Lift Up
895690.description: Rabbi Yosef Wineberg shares a penetrating story, revealing the Rebbe’s own view of himself.

895692.title: Must We Be Convinced That We Need Moshiach?
895692.description:
In Jewish law, when someone converts to Judaism, they are referred to as: “a convert who
converts.” The obvious question: Before he converted, he was not yet a “convert,” he was a
gentile? The commentaries explain that when a person converts it proves that he had a Jewish
spark inside him all along, but he needed the conversion process in order to reveal it.
path: Must We Be Convinced That We Need Moshiach?

895694.title: Necessary Care
895694.description:
So long as your father is still unstable from the stroke, it is appropriate that he stay in the
nursing home with proper medical equipment, and where nurses — or his daughters — will visit
him regulalry. Speak to the Jewish Federation about financial assistance to provide your father
with the best care possible.

895695.title: Worthy of Respect
895695.description:
Rabbi Sholom Ber Lipskar is executive director of the Aleph Institute, which services the
religious needs of Jewish men and women in prison. In 1985, they brought a group of prisoners
to spend a weekend in Crown Heights, where they attended the Rebbe’s Shabbos Farbrengen.

925442.title: My Servants
925442.description:
When it comes to separating Terumah and Maaser one is obligated to give the Levite and
Kohen from the best of the crop. Similarly in a Jew’s daily life: The “finest” hours of the day,
when one is most refreshed and energized, must be reserved for G-d, for Torah and Mitzvos.

925444.title: Eitan the Levite
925444.description:
Your son’s English name, “Ethan,” has already been used for holy purposes, such as when he
has been called to the Torah, so he may add it to his Hebrew name, “Yosef”, and from now be
called, “Yosef Eitan.” Eitan is mentioned many times in the Book of Psalms, as one of the
Levite singers in the Holy Temple.

925445.title: “I’ll Give You Half”
925445.description:
Reb Leibel Zisman has been in the construction and real estate business for almost 50 years.
In June 1987, he was asked to join a building project that had opportunity for enormous profit.

925450.title: Serving His People On High
925450.description:
An address on the Yahrzeit of Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch:
Today we commemorate the passing of the leader of our generation. How, then, can we call
this “a day of merit”?
Everything that occurs in G-d’s world contains an element of good, it only depends on the
individual to contemplate deeply enough to find it.

925451.title: The Ohel
925451.description:
The Rebbe visits the Ohel, resting place of his father-in-law and predecessor, Rabbi Yosef
Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

925452.title: Investing for Peace of Mind
925452.description:
I am not so happy about investing in the stock market, because it does not allow for peace
of mind. Transfer your money — in a way that won’t incur losses — into a safer investment.

925453.title: Lone Voice
925453.description:
Dr. David Luchins served on the staff of US Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan for twenty
years. He reveals the Rebbe’s influence in bringing down the Iron Curtain.

925468.title: Youth Movement
925468.description:
My father-in-law, the Rebbe, published a letter stating a clear directive how to utilize the
events of the 12th and 13th of Tammuz: To unify all Jews — “those who hold Torah dear,
those who safeguard the commandments, even those who consider themselves ‘Jewish’ in
name only.”

925470.title: Your Own Voice in the Senate
925470.description:
Senator Jacob “Chic” Hecht visits the Rebbe:
To be “with” me is not enough, you must be “ahead” of me, because you are the one in the
Senate. But you will have double power — for me and for you!
path: Your Own Voice in the Senate

925471.title: Private Conversation
925471.description:
Rabbi Moshe Herson is Head Shliach of the State of New Jersey. He recalls the Rebbe’s visit
to the Ohel on the first Yud-Beis Tammus after the passing of the Previous Rebbe.

925479.title: Royal Humility
925479.description:
After the episode of the Golden Calf, G-d thanked Moses for breaking the Tablets of the Law.
But why? What was so commendable about breaking them?

925480.title: Aliyah
925480.description: The Rebbe is called to the Torah during the Morning Prayers on Hoshana Rabba.

925481.title: Today I am a Man; Today I am a Woman
925481.description: Bar Mitzvah boys and Bat Mitzvah girls receive the Rebbe’s blessings.
path: Today I am a Man; Today I am a Woman

925482.title: Knowing Chicago's Ropes
925482.description:
Mr. Frank Moscowitz worked in the Chicago public school system for 38 years. In 1969, after
qualifying to become an elementary school principal, he was assigned a school in a high-crime
neighborhood in Chicago’s South Side. He flew to New York to consult with the Rebbe...

942184.title: Applied Kabbalah
942184.description:
An address on the Yahrzeit of Rabbi Isaac Luria, the Arizal
The Arizal revealed the secrets of the Kabbalah in a way unprecedented before his time. Based
upon his teachings, Chasidism further elucidated the Kabbalah, making it relevant and
accessible to all. The Arizal’s Yahrzeit, then, is a most auspicious time to connect to Torah’s
inner wisdom.

942185.title: Shacharis
942185.description: Morning Prayers in 770 on Erev Rosh Hashanah, 1981.

942186.title: A Safe Israel Is a Safe America
942186.description:
Israel’s welfare is in the best interest of the United States, because Israel is the front line
against the Arabs. The Arabs are against the United States no less than they are against Israel
— and perhaps even more so! And it is imperative that there be a strong Israel in order to
inhibit the influence of Syria, Iran, and the other hostile countries in the Middle East.
path: A Safe Israel Is a Safe America

942187.title: Sent Packing
942187.description:
After four years away in Yeshiva, Rabbi Aaron Cousin was planning to visit his family back in
Leeds, England. The Rebbe showed extraordinary interest in his travel plans.

942189.title: One
942189.description:
An address to children at the 1984 Lag B’omer parade
“You shall love your fellow as yourself.” We see this commandment expressed here today
through the great number of Jewish children who have gathered together. Although you come
from different walks of life, you all sit together today, showing esteem for one another, and
resolving together to grow in Torah and Mitzvos.

942190.title: Preparations for the Ohel
942190.description:
As he leaves 770 to prepare to visit the Ohel, the Rebbe distributes coins to children to give
to charity.

942191.title: Responsibility of the Journalist
942191.description: Journalists receive blessings and guidance from the Rebbe.

942192.title: The ABCs of Love
942192.description:
Rabbi Yehuda Leib Posner studied at 770 during the 1940s. In March 1948, he was sent out
by Merkos L’inyonei Chinuch to travel through small American towns disseminating Jewish
outreach material.

942194.title: “Wolf, Wolf”
942194.description:
The Talmud relates that Miriam bas Bilga abandoned Judaism, married a gentile Greek
officer and accompanied the Greeks as they stormed the Holy Temple. She then went and
pounded the Holy Altar with her sandal, crying out: “Wolf, wolf! You consume the Jewish
People’s wealth, but you don't answer them in their time of need!” For this latter deed, the
Sages punished her entire family.

942195.title: Niggun “Sheyiboneh”
942195.description:
“May it be Your will, L-rd our G-d and G-d of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt
speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in your Torah.” From the daily prayers.

942196.title: Simple Prayer
942196.description:
The Kabbalistic Meditations of prayer are certainly important, but most important is that the
simple meaning of our prayers be fulfilled — beginning with our prayers for Moshiach!

942197.title: Your People’s Future
942197.description:
After graduating High School, Mrs. Bassie Garelik planned to attend college. The Rebbe,
however, offered her a whole new perspective on planning for the future...

942199.title: “And the Rebbe Teaches the Small Children Alef Beis…”
942199.description:
The Lubavitcher Rebbes were emphatic that children be taught the Hebrew letters and vowels
separately, and only afterwards how to pronounce them together — for example, to recite:
"Kumatz-Alef — Uh". Each individual letter, vowel and sound was given at Sinai, and therefore,
each must be articulated in its own right.
path: “And the Rebbe Teaches the Small Children Alef Beis…”

942200.title: Reb Levik’s Niggun
942200.description: This lively Simchas Torah Nigun was a favorite of the Rebbe’s father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak.

942201.title: Angioplasty
942201.description: Go ahead with the angioplasty, but the one performing it must be a specialist. It’s better to get these procedures over with as soon as possible—but not on a Friday before Shabbos.

942202.title: Kumatz-Alef — Uh
942202.description:
Dr. Bunim Weinbaum used to tutor Hebrew reading on the side. Here, he recalls how the Rebbe
led him to turn a “side-job” into nothing short of an educational revolution.

959346.title: A Journey Ends; Another Begins
959346.description: The passing of the righteous seems to be a terrible occurrence. Yet the Torah tells us that the passing of the righteous affects salvation throughout the world and we celebrate the anniversary with a joyous gathering.

959347.title: Maariv
959347.description: The Rebbe leads Evening Prayers on the Yahrzeit of his mother, Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson.

959348.title: Fill the Void
959348.description:
The way to memorialize your brother is to replace his performance of Mitzvos, by adding in
Mitzvos of your own.

959349.title: The Schneerson Resolve
959349.description:
Rabbi Mordechai Ashkenazi’s cousin, Reb Nochum Goldshmidt, was close with the Rebbe’s
family when they lived in Dnepropretrovsk, Ukraine. Rabbi Ashkenazi recounts a story he
heard from Reb Nochum about the Rebbe’s father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson.

959351.title: The King Awaits
959351.description: The first Chabad Rebbe offers a parable illustrating G-d’s closeness of every individual during the Hebrew month of Elul.

959352.title: President Zalman Shazar
959352.description:
Israeli President Zalman Shazar at the Rebbe’s Farbrengen, shortly after retiring from the
presidency.

959353.title: New Start
959353.description:
Now that you have returned to the Jewish fold, forget about the mistakes of the past. May
you live many long, good, Jewish years.

959354.title: “Un-expert” Advice
959354.description:
Dr. Velvl Greene is Professor Emeritus of Epidemiology and Public Health at Ben Gurion
University. An original participant in NASA’s Exobiology program, he served as Professor of
Public Health and Microbiology at the University of Minnesota for 27 years.

959356.title: Parenting 101: Teaching to Read Between the Lines
959356.description:
On the very first word of the Torah, “Breishis”, the Talmud comments: “Do not just read it
‘Breishis — In the beginning’, but ‘Bara Shis — He created a foundation.’” The very first step
in the service of G-d is to learn to see beneath the world’s surface, to its “foundation” —
G-d, the Creator.
path: Parenting 101: Teaching to Read Between the Lines

959357.title: Aliyah
959357.description: The Rebbe is called to the Torah.

959358.title: Covenant of Abraham
959358.description:
The Arizal teaches that the parents must choose the name given to the child at the Bris. The
doctor and the Mohel must both agree that the child is strong enough to have the Bris on
time, on the eighth day.

959359.title: The Holy Shabbos
959359.description:
Mr. Jonathan Nelson recounts some of his father’s encounters with the Rebbe during the
1940s and 50s.

959361.title: Guardian at the Gates
959361.description:
The Mezuzah bears witness that the entire home and all that is within it are permeated by the
Torah passages inscribed in the Mezuzah, beginning with: “Hear, O Israel, the L-rd is our G-d,
the L-rd is One”; and concluding with G-d’s promise of Redemption.

959362.title: Niggun Utzu Eitza-Ach Tzaddikim
959362.description:
“Contrive a scheme, but it will be foiled; conspire a plot, but it will not materialize, for G-d is
with us... Indeed the righteous will extol Your Name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.”
Two verses from the daily prayers.

959363.title: All the Amenities
959363.description:
Mr. Ron Nachman, Mayor of Ariel, Israel, visits the Rebbe:
You can double the population of Ariel by launching a publicity campaign. Promote the physical
amenities that the residents will enjoy, in addition to all the spiritual amenities, which are
especially necessary in the Holy Land.

959364.title: “Check Your Mezuzahs”
959364.description:
After suffering a debilitating injury to her back, Mrs. Tzirel Weinbaum received an instruction
from the Rebbe to have her Mezuzos checked...

978207.title: Turn Up the Light
978207.description: A Jew’s purpose is to illuminate all the world around him. To “illuminate” does not mean to change the order of creation; rather, light enables one to discern the true nature and purpose of what already is there.

978208.title: Selichos
978208.description: Selichos at 770 on the Eve of Rosh Hashanah.

978209.title: A Blessing for a "Sweet" Year
978209.description: During the High Holidays, the tradition is to wish each other “a sweet year.” The Rebbe gives a blessing for a sweet new year to someone with a high sugar level.

978212.title: Challenge Seeker
978212.description: A Jew is commanded to serve G-d “with all your heart, with all your soul and with all your might.” If so, one might ask, shouldn’t one always strive for the way that requires the most effort possible?

978213.title: Panim
978213.description: The Rebbe receives petitions for blessing on the Eve of Rosh Hashanah.

978214.title: Standing Before G-d and Man
978214.description: The Rebbe gives instructions and blessings to a cantor who will lead the High Holidays services.

978215.title: Over the Top
978215.description:
Rabbis Yosef Goldstein and Mendel Baumgarten recall a memorable Tashlich on Rosh
Hashanah, 1956.

978219.title: The Rebbe’s Yizkor Speech
978219.description: The unity of all Jews derives from the fact that every Jewish soul is “an actual part of G-d Above.” Therefore, “Jewish unity” is not limited to Jews who are alive, but includes those who have passed on, as well.

978220.title: Nigun “Avinu Malkeinu”
978220.description: “Our Father our King, we have no king but You.” From the Rosh Hashanah liturgy.

978221.title: Living and Giving
978221.description:
May your electric memorial lamp project be successful — but only to memorialize those who
have already passed on. Those who purchase it should live long, happy lives.
May you succeed in G-d’s mission for you to be wealthy and to give charity beyond the letter
of the law.

978222.title: Chivalry on the Upper East Side
978222.description:
Mr. Jules Lassner shares a private audience he and his father-in-law had with the Rebbe, in
which the Rebbe set a “liberating” agenda.
path: Chivalry on the Upper East Side

978224.title: Comparative Study in Jewish Leadership
978224.description:
Each Rebbe encompasses every Jew of his generation, but each also has a unique focus. We
find many stories of the Rebbe Maharash’s unique accomplishments in bringing wayward souls
back to G-d, and his ability to transform a Jew into a full-fledged Baal Teshuvah.

978225.title: The Four Species
978225.description: Hallel and Hoshaanos at 770 on Hoshana Rabba.

978226.title: He Who Blesses, is Blessed
978226.description:
G-d promised Abraham that whoever blesses him and his offspring, is in turn blessed. So in
return for the blessings you give me, G-d puts all else aside, and occupies Himself with blessing
you, amongst all Jews — from His “full, open, holy and generous hand.”

978227.title: “It's Nothing”
978227.description:
Rabbi Chaim Ciment has been a Shliach in Boston, Massachusetts, since 1954. In the late
1970s, he was diagnosed with Ankylosing Spondylitis, a debilitating condition that until today
has no known cure.

1001686.title: The Ultimate Career
1001686.description:
The verse states: “Man was born to toil.” Work gives man the opportunity to “partner with
G-d in the act of Creation.” The Talmud asks: Exactly what kind of “toil” was man created for?

1001687.title: Kos Shel Brachah
1001687.description: The Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing.

1001688.title: Charity Plan
1001688.description:
Despite the current crisis continue to give charity, but be cautious that your charity goes only
to Kosher institutions. Influence all your friends to also give at least ten percent, and if
possible, twenty.

1001689.title: A Father
1001689.description:
Rabbi Dovid Edelman recalls the events of Simchas Torah, 1955, when the Rebbe taught the
Niggun “Darkecha Elokeinu.”

1001691.title: Never “Too Much” Blessing
1001691.description:
The very first command of the Torah is: “Be fruitful and multiply.” Rashi explains: You might
think that having one child is already being “fruitful,” so Torah adds “and multiply.” And to
remove all doubt, the verse continues, “fill the earth and conquer it.”

1001692.title: Nickels to Children
1001692.description:
On his way to hear the Torah reading at the upstairs synagogue at 770, the Rebbe distributes
nickels to children.

1001693.title: Yiddishe Nachas
1001693.description: Blessings and wisdom on the subjects of childbirth and childrearing.

1001694.title: Just What the Rebbe Ordered
1001694.description:
Rabbi Chaim Zev Bomzer is a long-standing member of the Rabbinical Council of America, and
was rabbi of the Young Israel of Ocean Parkway for 40 years. He shares a story about the
Rebbe’s advice to his daughter.

1001697.title: The Heart Lifts the Feet
1001697.description:
Chassidism teaches that the verse, “And Jacob went on his way…” represents the mission
of every Jew as he goes back into the world after Tishrei.

1001698.title: End of Tishrei
1001698.description: The Rebbe sees off the guests who came to New York to spend Tishrei with the Rebbe.

1001699.title: Don’t Be Intimidated
1001699.description:
Newly elected Knesset Member Benjamin Netanyahu visits the Rebbe:
I had much satisfaction from your first speech in the Knesset. Continue along this approach,
for it is the best path to avoid war. You will have to struggle with 119 others in the Knesset,
but surely you won’t be intimidated, because G-d is on this side.

1001700.title: The Patient Knows Best
1001700.description:
On Shemini Atzeres 1977, the Rebbe suffered a massive heart attack during the Hakofos
celebration. Dr. Ira Weiss, a cardiologist, flew in from Chicago to join the team of doctors
treating the Rebbe at 770.

1001702.title: From Noah to the Nazis
1001702.description:
A Jew might sometimes feel that he stands alone against the world around him. So even before
reassuring him that there are indeed many others with him – above all, G-d Himself – we tell
him the story of Noah: There was an entire generation in which there lived only one solitary
righteous individual. But he overcame, and built a new world and a new way of life.

1001703.title: Children’s Rally
1001703.description: Children sing “Utzu Eitza” at a rally in 770.

1001704.title: Polish Pro-Semitism
1001704.description: The Rebbe discusses changing attitudes towards Jews in Poland.

1001705.title: Solidarity
1001705.description:
In 1990, Mr. David Chase opened the Solidarity-Chase Bank in Poland, one of the first private
financial institutions there after communist rule. He received personal instructions from the
Rebbe about rebuilding Jewish life in Poland and improving Polish attitudes towards Jews.

1023078.title: Live in the Moment
1023078.description:
When it comes to a Jew’s mission to better himself and the world, the Evil Inclination tries to
argue: “What’s the rush? What is so urgent? You have a long life ahead of you; there’s plenty
of time to fix things later…”

1023079.title: The Rebbe’s House
1023079.description: The Rebbe leaves his house on President Street for 770.

1023080.title: Partners
1023080.description: A visit by the president and board members of the UJA-Federation.

1023081.title: Spare the Rod
1023081.description:
Rabbi Shmuel Lew, a veteran Shliach and educator, shares a lesson he received from the Rebbe
about disciplining children.

1023084.title: One by One
1023084.description:
As the end of the exile approaches and the Redemption draws near, my father-in-law, the
Rebbe, began to dispatch emissaries to many diverse locations, some of them quite far
geographically.

1023085.title: Nigun “Uforatzta”
1023085.description:
From G-d’s blessing to Jacob: “And you shall spread forth to the west, to the east, to the
north and to the south.” These words became a slogan for the Rebbe’s call to reach every
Jew, wherever he may be.

1023086.title: “Non-Profit Business” as Usual
1023086.description:
Do not be afraid of debt, it is normal for non-profit organizations. May G-d help you pay off
the current debts, and then may you go on to create future deficits through increasing your
activities for Judaism.

1023087.title: “Thousands of Things to Do”
1023087.description: Rabbi Nachman Sudak is Head Shliach of the United Kingdom. He recalls his days as a young rabbinic student at 770, when the Rebbe began to call upon young couples to pick up their lives and move across the globe to reach out to fellow Jews. (Late 1950s)

1023089.title: Light Unto the Nations: Part 1
1023089.description: After being freed from Russian prison on the 19th of Kislev, 1798, the Alter Rebbe wrote a letter describing the circumstances surrounding his liberation. It is striking to see how much emphasis he places on the impact his liberation had on the non-Jews of S. Petersburg.

1023090.title: The Mitzvah Tanks
1023090.description: Mitzvah Tanks line the street outside 770 in the first week after they are launched in 1974.

1023091.title: Charity and Mikva
1023091.description:
Be sure to install a charity box in the new Mikva. Tell all the women that by giving charity
there it will bring blessing to each of them, in addition to the great Mitzvah of using the
Mikva. May they all be blessed with healthy Jewish children.

1023092.title: How Important is it to You?
1023092.description:
In 1975, Mr. Bentzion Rader went on a business trip to Detroit, Michigan. While there, he
met a non-observant Jew whom he convinced to put on Tefillin. After reporting this episode
to the Rebbe, he found himself doing a little soul-searching of his own...
path: How Important is it to You?

1023094.title: Light Unto the Nations: Part 2
1023094.description: Maimonides rules that every Jew was commanded at Sinai to influence all of mankind to observe the Seven Noahide Laws. Therefore, even in a place where not a single Jew seems to live, you must do everything in your power to make that place more civilized, by promoting the observance of the Seven Noahide Laws.

1023095.title: Nigun “Ki Elokim Yoshia Tzion”
1023095.description:
“G-d will redeem Zion and build the cities of Judah, and they will dwell there and posses it.
The descendants of His servants will inherit it and those who love His name will establish
themselves there.” (Psalms 69:36, 37)

1023096.title: One Stone Unturned
1023096.description:
One thing that still must be done for the sake of Israel’s security, is to teach the citizens of
Israel to be the “People of the Land of Israel” – not just to dwell in the Land physically, but
also spiritually.

1023097.title: Check Again
1023097.description:
Rabbi Hersh Kotlarsky, an elder Chassid, shares a personal story about the Rebbe’s medical
advice to his wife before surgery.

1052362.title: How the Mitteler Rebbe Took Chassidism to the Next Level
1052362.description: The teachings of the second Chabad Rebbe, Rabbi Dov Ber, add unprecedented length, breadth and depth to concepts in Chassidic Philosophy – enabling the human mind to achieve even greater union with the Divine wisdom.
path: How the Mitteler Rebbe Took Chassidism to the Next Level

1052363.title: Groom and Bride at Chassidic Gathering
1052363.description: Immediately following their wedding, a bride and groom (Menachem and Devorah Emanuel) join a Chassidic gathering with the Rebbe at Lubavitch World Headquarters. There they recited the Sheva Brachot, the seven blessings recited following the Grace after Meals at the conclusion of the wedding.
path: Groom and Bride at Chassidic Gathering

1052364.title: Blessings to Bride and Groom
1052364.description: Brides and grooms receive the Rebbe’s blessings in anticipation of their wedding day.

1052365.title: Honoring Groom and Bride
1052365.description: Menachem and Devorah Emanuel were married in Crown Heights in 1983. On the day of their wedding, they received an invitation from the Rebbe to hold their first Sheva Brachos at the Rebbe’s Farbrengen in 770.

1052368.title: Chassidic Philosophy: What for?
1052368.description: Chassidic philosophy's four contributions to the Jewish way of life.

1052369.title: A Farbrengen in 1967
1052369.description: Archival footage of a Chassidic gathering ("Farbrengen") with the Rebbe from December 21, 1967.

1052370.title: Religious Rights in Prison
1052370.description: When the prison officials makes it difficult for the Jewish inmates put on tefillin daily, to whom should the prisoners turn?

1052371.title: Bringing Chanukah Light to Prisoners
1052371.description: The Rebbe instructs Rabbi Shabsi Katz, chief Jewish chaplain for South Africa’s prison system, to brighten the lives of prisoners incarcerated in South Africa.

1052373.title: Chanukah Money for the Children
1052373.description: Why we give children money, known as Chanukah gelt, to spend as they wish.

1052374.title: The Rebbe Joins Live Chanukah Broadcast (5752/1991)
1052374.description: The 1991 "Chanukah Live" international satellite hookup, that united Chanukah celebrations held in New York, Paris, Moscow, Melbourne, Hong Kong and Jerusalem.
path: The Rebbe Joins Live Chanukah Broadcast (5752/1991)

1052375.title: Presenting a Menorah to the Rebbe
1052375.description: The Rebbe thanks a Chabad supporter for a Menorah he brought as a gift, and for his assistance in publicizing the miracle of Chanukah.
path: Presenting a Menorah to the Rebbe

1052376.title: Student Revolution
1052376.description:
In 1970, Rabbi Laibl Wolf took up the position of Hillel Rabbi at the University of Wisconsin-
Madison upon the Rebbe’s instruction. At his first private audience with the Rebbe he
received special guidance in how to effectively reach Jewish students on campus.

1052378.title: Seeing Beyond the Seeable
1052378.description: When the protective shield is removed for a split moment, one can glimpse the true reality beneath all the external layers

1052379.title: Distributing Chanukah Money
1052379.description:
At the end of the Chanukah Live children’s rally in 1990, the Rebbe gives coins to be handed
out to the children, and personally hands coins to the phographers of the event.

1052380.title: The Rebbe Encourages Writers
1052380.description: A video collage of authors presenting the Rebbe with their publications, and receiving advice and encouragement.

1052381.title: Letters from Youth
1052381.description:
Rabbi Sholom Ber Levine, chief librarian at the Library of Agudas Chassidei Chabad at 770,
recalls the discovery of the earliest known letter of the Rebbe to Rabbi Yosef Rosen, the
Rogatchover Gaon.

1076647.title: Conquering in Unison
1076647.description: A lesson from the two sons of Jacob, Gad and Joseph.

1076648.title: The Rebbe Leads the Selichot Prayers
1076648.description: On the tenth of the Jewish month of Tevet, the Rebbe leads the customary prayers said on designated days of fasting.
path: The Rebbe Leads the Selichot Prayers

1076649.title: As City’s Population Grows, Growth in Education should Follow
1076649.description: The Rebbe discusses with Aryeh Goral, the mayor of Haifa, Israel, the growth of the city’s population and the relative lack of violence there.
path: As City’s Population Grows, Growth in Education should Follow

1076650.title: Memories of the Rebbe in Paris
1076650.description: Rabbi Moshe Herson shares stories he heard from Alexander Reinin, who was with the Rebbe in France during the 1930s.
path: Memories of the Rebbe in Paris

1076652.title: Not 'Handicapped' But 'Exceptional'
1076652.description: When someone has a physical weakness or lack, it is a sign that the Creator has endowed that person with special powers which enable him or her to overcome and succeed where the ordinary person cannot.

1076653.title: The Melody of V’ata Amarta
1076653.description: The crowd gathered in the synagogue sings a lively Chassidic melody on the eve of the holiday of Hoshana Rabba, prior to the traditional recitation of Psalms.

1076654.title: Reject What is Foreign to Torah
1076654.description: The Rebbe instructs former Prime Minister Ariel Sharon to stay strong in regards to all areas of Torah as pertains to the land of Israel.
path: Reject What is Foreign to Torah

1076655.title: Understanding the Sacrifice
1076655.description: Moshe Levy was a sergeant in the IDF Special Forces during the Yom Kippur War. The unit he led defended the Budapest Outpost, the only Israeli bunker on the Suez Canal to withstand the Egyptian attack. He is one of only forty people to be awarded the Israel Hero Medal.

1076657.title: Five + Five: The Meaning of a Handshake
1076657.description: When one meets, they take one-another’s hand, expressing the fact that they are one. Therefore, before we conclude, I would be honored if I could greet you individually and shake each of your hands.
path: Five + Five: The Meaning of a Handshake

1076658.title: Maimonides' Yahrtzeit
1076658.description:
“On the day that a Tzaddik passes away all his life’s work is revealed – “and effects
salvation throughout the world.” How much more so in regard to Maimonides, who taught
the entire Torah to “young and old alike.”

1076659.title: Jewish Defense Forces
1076659.description:
“When the IDF will be strong, there will be no need for war. The best defense is to scare the
enemy from attacking in the first place. And studying Torah is the best defense, as G-d
promises: ‘Follow My statutes, and I will set peace upon the Land.’”

1076660.title: Calling the Shots
1076660.description:
Major General Yossi Ben Hanan served as Commander of the IDF Armored Corps and of
Israel’s National Security College. He is a recipient of the IDF’s Medal of Courage.

1076663.title: Mission of Kings
1076663.description: Torah states: “Every Jew is a king.” The Mitzvah campaigns especially express this kingship.

1076664.title: “Who Knows One?”
1076664.description: Chassidim sing the Russian version of “Who Knows One?”

1076665.title: Health, Wealth and Happiness
1076665.description: “If you are healthy physically and spiritually, then I will be healthier – it depends on you.”

1076666.title: Laying Down Roots
1076666.description: Reb Shmuel Isaac Popack recalls events after the Previous Rebbe’s arrival in America.

1102138.title: Excerpts from the Rebbe's First Chassidic Discourse
1102138.description:
The sages state that “all sevenths are cherished.” This is the reason, they explain, why
Moses was the one who merited to bring G-d’s Presence into this world—because he was
the seventh from Abraham.
path: Excerpts from the Rebbe's First Chassidic Discourse

1102139.title: Previous Rebbe's Yahrtzeit
1102139.description:
The Rebbe leads Morning Prayers at 770 on the 30th Yahrzeit of his father-in-law and
predecessor, Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak of Lubavitch.

1102140.title: Connections
1102140.description:
“If it has been 40 years since we first met, now you surely have “a heart to know, eyes to
see and ears to hear…” – That’s what Torah says about reaching 40 years. May you have
success also for the 41st year...” “You are a member of the Jewish People, and so we are
connected...”

1102141.title: Ten Minutes to Change Worlds
1102141.description:
As a college student in 1970, Mr. Freddy Hager was in New York, when he was unexpectedly
called in for an audience with the Rebbe.

1102143.title: Addressed at Sinai
1102143.description: As soon as a Jewish baby is born, what G-d declared at Sinai applies to him. All souls of all generations, this baby’s soul included, were present at Sinai when G-d addressed them – in the first person: “I am the Lord thy G-d, Who brought you out from the Land of Egypt.”

1102144.title: Yechidus
1102144.description: The conclusion of a special private audience for guests from Kfar Chabad, Israel.

1102145.title: Medical-Halachic Research
1102145.description: Various pioneers in the field of Medical-Halachic research visit the Rebbe.

1102146.title: Tearful Departure
1102146.description: Mrs. Fruma Junik’s husband, Rabbi Berel Junik, was a member of the Rebbe and Rebbetzin’s household in New York. In 1953, the Rebbetzin traveled to Europe.

1102149.title: Woman’s Wisdom
1102149.description:
To carry out the holy and life-critical mission of the Jew requires wisdom and understanding
– which G-d granted the Jewish People by giving them His Own wisdom, the Torah, as a
guide. Through Torah, Jews are the “Wise and understanding nation.” But Torah draws a
distinction within Jews themselves: “Greater understanding was granted to woman than to
man,” enabling them to perceive better and deeper, and to apply this perception in daily life.

1102150.title: Rebbetzin's Yahrtzeit
1102150.description:
On the 2nd Yahrtzeit of the Rebbe’s wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, the Rebbe offers financial
assistance to all official Chabad institutions from the Chomesh Fund established in her name.

1102151.title: Good Jew
1102151.description:
“Give this to charity especially for becoming a good Jew. You have G-d’s promise of help, for
‘G-d helps one who helps himself.’”

1102152.title: No Doubts
1102152.description: Mrs. Bassie Garelik, one of the Rebbe's emissaries in Milan, Italy since 1958, shares a letter she received from the Rebbe during a time when she was doubting her abilities as the Rebbe's representative

1102154.title: Engineering Light
1102154.description:
Many manuscripts of Maimonides’ Commentary to the Mishna show an illustration of the Holy
Menorah in which each decorative goblet on the Menorah’s branches face upward. But
Maimonides’ own handwritten sketch of the Menorah shows the exact opposite: They face
downward.

1102155.title: Nigun “Anim Zemiros”
1102155.description:
“I shall sing hymns and weave melodies, for my soul longs for You. My soul desires Your shelter,
to know all Your mystery.” The Rebbe taught this Niggun on Simchas Torah, 1961.

1102156.title: A True Home
1102156.description:
“May your nursing home be a true home for all the people there until Moshiach comes – with
joy and happiness.”

1102157.title: Waiting for Shlichus
1102157.description:
Rabbi Avraham Korf is head Shliach of the State of Florida. He recalls some of the Rebbe’s
instructions to him as a young rabbinic student in Crown Heights during the 1950s waiting to
go on Shlichus.

1130174.title: Joy Breaks Through
1130174.description:
All of Torah and Mitzvos must be done joyously. Maimonides writes that a Jew must strive to
emulate King David, who literally “hopped and danced before the L-rd.”

1130175.title: Niggun Simcha
1130175.description: With electrifying energy, the Rebbe leads the Chassidim in a lively Niggun.

1130176.title: Time to Confess
1130176.description:
Reform Rabbi and author of Nine and a Half Mystics, Herbert Weiner, visits the Rebbe:
“I believe you can now confess openly that you are an Orthodox Jew, and that you always
were an Orthodox Jew even during those years that you were making speeches in a Reform
temple.”

1130177.title: The Two-Page P.S.
1130177.description:
Reform Rabbi Herbert Weiner maintained a relationship with the Rebbe over the years, after
having interviewed him twice in the 1950s. His interviews with the Rebbe are published in his
book Nine and a Half Mystics.

1130179.title: Who Should Teach the Children?
1130179.description:
The Midrash relates that when Mordechai learned of Haman’s wicked plot, he immediately
gathered 22,000 Jewish children to study Torah with them. This caused a commotion on
High, eliciting Divine mercy.

1130180.title: Purim Morning
1130180.description: Morning Prayers on Purim at the Rebbe’s home on President Street.

1130181.title: Charity – the “Cure-All”
1130181.description: The Rebbe instructs that charity be given as a source of blessing in all matters

1130182.title: In-reach
1130182.description:
Mr. Shimshon Stock headed the Chevra Simchas Shabbos V’Yom Tov charity fund for thirty
years. As a teenager in the 1940s, he studied at the Lubavitcher Yeshiva in Crown Heights,
Brooklyn. During that time, he was privileged to study one-on-one with the Rebbe.

1130184.title: The Children Come First: “Light, Joy, Gladness, Glory”
1130184.description:
Today, a myriad influences try to pull children in the wrong direction… But through our
honest effort, even those who “bowed to the statue” and “indulged in the royal feast” – their
children will study Torah, and the parents, too, will share in Torah’s light.
path: The Children Come First: “Light, Joy, Gladness, Glory”

1130185.title: Torah Dedication
1130185.description:
A new Torah dedicated in honor of the Rebbe’s wife, Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, is brought
out during the Morning Prayers at 770.

1130186.title: In Haifa, Reach the Depths
1130186.description:
Mr. Aryeh Goral, Mayor of Haifa, Israel, visits the Rebbe:
Elijah declared: “Do not dance on both sides of the fence.” That is even worse than idolatry.
Therefore, today too – decide once and for all that the Land of Israel is not like other lands!

1130187.title: End the War Now!
1130187.description: Dr. Elliot Udell, the Rebbe’s podiatrist, relates how he requested of the Rebbe to write a prayer that the Gulf War end in a week’s time, so that the holiday of Purim could be joyously celebrated.

1130189.title: Find a Mentor
1130189.description:
I recently publicized a heartfelt request that everyone “Make for themselves a mentor,” and
to encourage others to do the same. Even if you think you don’t need one, Torah commands
that you appoint a mentor for yourself.

1130190.title: Evening Prayers
1130190.description: Evening prayers at 770 following a meeting of the Machne Israel Development Fund.

1130191.title: Collective Chaplain
1130191.description:
Your son-in-law is the only US Army chaplain stationed at his base at the present time. Let him
have his good influence on the Jewish soldiers there, and on the non-Jewish soldiers as well
– as Maimonides writes: At Sinai, the Jewish People were commanded to teach non-Jews
about the commandments that apply to them.

1130192.title: First Impression
1130192.description:
Rabbi Heschel Ryzman, a Torah scholar and author of numerous Torah works, studied at the
Lubavitcher Yeshivas in Warsaw and Otwock, Poland during the 1930s. He recalls the first
time he saw the Rebbe.

1161497.title: Celebrating the Connection
1161497.description: The Rebbe’s 75th birthday: Today’s gathering is not about a private individual. It is only that I had the good fortune to be able to help others to grow in Torah and Mitzvos, to assist and encourage them to the best of my ability…

1161498.title: Birthday Blessings
1161498.description:
Chassidim offer a communal blessing to the Rebbe on his 88th birthday. The Rebbe distributes
a Chassidic discourse.

1161499.title: Birthday Gifts
1161499.description:
Visitors offer their good wishes and “gifts” to the Rebbe in honor of his birthday, the Eleventh
of Nissan.

1161500.title: One Little Apostrophe
1161500.description:
Dr. Velvel Greene was an original participant in NASA’s Exobiology program searching for life
on Mars. The Rebbe used to ask him for regular reports on his scientific research.

1161502.title: The Cantonists
1161502.description:
During the time of the Tzemach Tzedek, Kronstadt was a fortified city near S. Petersburg.
Among the soldiers stationed there were a number of “Cantonists” – young Jewish men
kidnapped from their parents by the Czarist regime and conscripted for 25 years or more in
the Russian army.

1161503.title: Niggun “V’hi She’omdoh”
1161503.description:
“This is what has stood by our fathers and us: For not just one alone has arisen against us
to destroy us, but in every generation they rise against us to destroy us; and the Holy One
blessed be He, saves us from their hand!” (From the Passover Haggadah)

1161504.title: Cup of Elijah
1161504.description: Artist Michel Schwartz presents the Rebbe with a hand-crafted silver Cup of Elijah.

1161505.title: “It’ll Be Good for Him”
1161505.description:
Dr. David Luchins is Chair of the Political Science Department at Touro college. He dicusses
the roots of his family’s 4-generation-connection to Chabad.

1161507.title: Passover – Calling All Citizens!
1161507.description:
Passover is ‘The Festival of Our Freedom.’ The Festival itself calls out: “Listen, Jews – we
must be free!” The verse states: “There shall be one law for the Passover sacrifice – for you,
the convert and the native-born.” Allegorically speaking, ‘native-born’ refers to the ‘true
citizen’ of a country – one who thinks that his country is the greatest. A Jew must recognize,
however, that he is “Jerusalem-born” – no matter where in the world he is.

1161508.title: Kos Shel Brachah
1161508.description:
The Rebbe distributes wine from the cup of the After-blessing upon the conclusion of
Passover.

1161509.title: Easier in Israel
1161509.description:
World-renowned psychologist Dr. Reuven Feuerstien visits the Rebbe:
“It says in Likutei Torah that in Israel, a Jew achieves with one day of the Festival, what it
takes us, here, two days. Good tidings for all your activities inside and outside of Israel.”

1161510.title: The Alter Rebbe’s Parade
1161510.description:
Rabbi Yitzchok Dovid Groner was Head Shliach of Australia for 50 years. As a student at
770 during the 1940s, he organized a children’s parade during the Intermediate Days of
Passover.

1161512.title: Lamplighters
1161512.description:
A Chassid once asked the Rebbe Rashab: “What is a Chassid?” The Rebbe Rashab answered:
“A Chassid is a lamplighter.” Asked the Chassid, “What if the lamp is in a desert?” The Rebbe
responded: “He must go and kindle the lamp, so that the person will see that he is in a desert.”
“And what if the lamp is at sea?” “In that case, he must remove his garments and jump into
the sea to light the lamp.”

1161513.title: Niggun “L’chatchila Ariber”
1161513.description: Chassidim sing a favorite Niggun of Rabbi Shmuel of Lubavitch, the Rebbe Maharash.

1161514.title: Politicians for Redemption!
1161514.description:
Knesset Member Benjamin Netanyahu visits the Rebbe:
“Since we last met many things have progressed. What hasn’t changed, however, is that
Moshiach hasn’t come. There are still a few hours left in the day, so try to bring him today!”

1161515.title: “Joyful Mother of Children”
1161515.description:
A new couple had moved in next door to the Kazens in Cleveland, Ohio. Little did they know,
miracles were about to happen...

1180674.title: Moshiach-Times: Future Lifestyles
1180674.description:
Maimonides concludes his code of law, the Mishneh Torah, by describing the era of Moshiach
as a time of peace, abundance and enlightenment. All luxuries will be readily available, and yet
they will be esteemed in man’s eyes as the dust. As such, we will devote ourselves totally to
the study of Torah.

1180676.title: Roadmap
1180676.description:
The Mayor of Ariel, Israel visits the Rebbe:
“Tell the people in Israel to publicize everywhere that all the rumors that Israel will give back
land have no basis in reality. These rumors are the cause of intifada, for they give the message
that there is something to gain through violence. Israel will remain whole, and Moshiach will
soon add the rest of its lands, peacefully and pleasantly without any battles.”

1180677.title: A Very Jewish Enterprise
1180677.description:
In the early 1950s, Mr. Sheldon Rudoff brought a group of teenagers from the Young Israel of
Crown Heights for a private audience with the Rebbe.

1180682.title: Moshiach-times: Seeing with New Eyes
1180682.description:
Maimonides concludes his code of Jewish law, the Mishneh Torah:
“In the Era of Moshiach… there will be no occupation in the whole world except to know
G-d alone. Therefore, the Jews will be great sages, knowing the hidden matters and grasping
their Creator to the full extent possible for man – as it is written, ‘For the knowledge of G-d
will fill the earth as water covers the sea.’”

1180683.title: Lag B’omer Coins
1180683.description:
At the conclusion of the 1990 Lag B’omer Parade, the Rebbe gives out specially minted coins
engraved with the verse, “How good and how pleasant it is when brothers dwell together in
peace.”

1180684.title: Review, or Re-Study?
1180684.description: Each time one begins a Torah study cycle anew, it is not enough to review — one needs to find new dimensions.

1180685.title: Humor and Wit
1180685.description:
On occasion during the 1950s, Rabbi Yisroel Gordon served as the Rebbe’s driver. He recalls
some of the wit and humor that he witnessed.

1180687.title: On the Giant’s Shoulders
1180687.description:
An address to children on Lag B’omer, Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai’s Yahrzeit:
We’ve gathered together on a joyous day, a day which Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai called, “the
day of his rejoicing.” He requested that all Jews rejoice on this day, in his times, and in all
generations to follow.

1180688.title: Lag B’omer Parade
1180688.description: Vintage footage of the 1967 Lag B’omer Parade.

1180689.title: Upsherin
1180689.description: Parents bring their three-year-old sons to the Rebbe for their Upsherin, first haircut.

1180690.title: Birthday Quiz
1180690.description:
Rabbi Mordechai Ashkenazi is rabbi of Kfar Chabad, Israel. In the Spring of 1958, around the
time of his 15th birthday, he had his first private audience with the Rebbe.

1180692.title: The Difference Between Faith and Trust
1180692.description:
There are certain principles that are so central to the foundation of the United States that they
were engraved on its coins and printed on its currency – two fundamental principles: “In G-d
We Trust” and “E Pluribus Unum – Out of many, one.”
path: The Difference Between Faith and Trust

1180693.title: Make Peace
1180693.description: As Chassidim sing a Nigun, the Rebbe signals to two people to shake hands and make peace.

1180694.title: On the Money
1180694.description:
“On the US dollar is inscribed: ‘In G-d We Trust.’ Belief and trust are completely different. A
person can believe one way, and act another. Trust is to give oneself over entirely to G-d.”

1180695.title: Term Paper: The Chassidic Society
1180695.description:
In 1972, Mrs. Chana Sharfstein wrote a term paper about the Lubavitch movement for her
sociology class at Brooklyn College. After receiving an A, she gave it to the Rebbe, who
returned it to her with two pages of corrections in his own handwriting.

1203572.title: Ladies First
1203572.description: When G-d told Moses how to prepare the Jewish people to receive the Torah on Shavuos, He instructed him to speak to the women first, for it was the women’s commitment that would inspire the rest of the Jewish people at the time of the giving of the Torah—and down through the ages.

1203573.title: Children’s Choir
1203573.description:
A children’s choir leads the Chassidim in the singing of Niggunim, as the Rebbe distributes
wine from the cup of the After-blessing.

1203574.title: Husband-Wife Partnership
1203574.description:
To say you can’t do anything without your wife is speaking negatively about yourself, but to
speak of the increase in good that you can achieve together, there is certainly no limit!

1203575.title: The Term Paper: Autobiographical Notes
1203575.description:
In 1972, Mrs. Chana Sharfstein wrote a term paper about the Lubavitch movement for her
sociology class at Brooklyn College. After receiving an A, she gave it to the Rebbe, who
returned it to her with two pages of corrections in his own handwriting.

1203577.title: Was Moses Being Bribed?
1203577.description: When Moses refused to offer an answer to a question—and why.

1203578.title: Morning Prayers
1203578.description: Vintage footage of Morning Prayers at 770 during the mid-1960s.

1203579.title: On the Straight and Narrow
1203579.description:
You needn’t “bribe” me for my blessings by mentioning that you support Lubavitch. If I were
to accept bribery, “Bribery blinds the eyes of the wise,” it would be out of my hands… But
if you will double your actions, you will be blessed with double blessings.

1203580.title: From Brooklyn to Cairo
1203580.description:
Mr. Yisroel Katzover is a senior journalist who covered the IDF for several decades for
numerous Israeli newspapers and media channels. Through the years, he consulted and
received much advice and guidance from the Rebbe.

1203582.title: Independent Jewish Children
1203582.description:
When it came to the Menorah in the Holy Temple, the commandment was to light it anew
every day; and to light it, as Rashi says, “until the flame could rise up on its own.”

1203583.title: Niggun “We Want Moshiach Now”
1203583.description: The Tzivos Hashem anthem is sung for the Rebbe for the very first time.

1203584.title: From Down Under to Up and Above
1203584.description:
One hundred years ago Australia was a detention camp. But now it’s become just the
opposite. And it depends on the Jews living in Australia to show a living example for a real
Jewish environment.
path: From Down Under to Up and Above

1203585.title: A Sun Sets, A Sun Rises
1203585.description:
For 42 years, Rabbi Yoel Kahan led the team of scholars who memorized and transcribed the
Rebbe’s addresses. He arrived in New York from Israel to study at 770, right after the
passing of the Previous Rebbe.
path: A Sun Sets, A Sun Rises

1203587.title: A Letter from On High
1203587.description:
When my father-in-law, the Rebbe, was compelled to leave Russia, he enjoined his Chassidim
not to lose heart, for he would remain as close to them as aways. And so it was: the Rebbe
accomplished from abroad what must normally be done by someone who is physically present.

1203588.title: “If His Children are Alive, He, too, is Alive”
1203588.description: An excerpt of a talk from the Rebbe on the 35th Yahrzeit of his father-in-law and predecessor.
path: “If His Children are Alive, He, too, is Alive”

1203589.title: Moshiach Now!
1203589.description:
It is not enough to “bring Moshiach” – for that we already have the promise of G-d Almighty.
It is our job to bring him as soon as possible.

1203590.title: Turning the Wheels
1203590.description:
Mr. Efraim Ilin was born in Kharkov, Ukraine in 1912. In 1951, he built Israel’s first automobile
assembly plant, Kaiser-Frazer of Israel.

1224746.title: You Have to Ask for Moshiach
1224746.description:
There are those who question: “Why do you speak so much about bringing Moshiach?” “Why
